jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Paper.io 2
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io2.

Role

• Build and implement F2P systems that enhance player engagement and revenue, with a focus on progression, monetization, live events, and in-game economies.

• Take full ownership of specifications, timelines, and outcomes, ensuring smooth execution and high-quality delivery.

• Utilize A/B testing, retention metrics, and player data to refine and optimize features post-launch. Identify strengths, address weaknesses, and iterate for continuous improvement.

• Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and analysts to ensure seamless feature rollouts. Maintain clear documentation, resolve technical challenges, and make strategic trade-offs to deliver the best possible player experience.

• Prioritize development efforts under tight deadlines, balancing speed and quality to maximize impact.

• Stay ahead of industry trends by monitoring competitors, analyzing market innovations, and rapidly adapting best practices.

Profile

• Experience as PM, Product Owner, Game Designer, or Live Ops/Product Manager

• Strong understanding of F2P mobile game mechanics

• Able to write clear specs and align teams

• High standards. We need someone who pushes the product forward and challenges weak ideas

• Experience on a successful live game

• Experience with competitive systems, leagues, rankings, seasons, battle passes, character collection, or upgrade systems

• Experience on casual, hybridcasual, io, or mass-market games

• Good understanding of IAP monetization, not only ads

• Has seen what great live games do, for example Brawl Stars, Clash Royale, Monopoly Go, Stumble Guys, Subway Surfers, etc

• AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

Benefits

• Best-in-class compensation

• Other benefits according to the country you reside

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Exchange
jobs.description:
Company Description

Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 130 countries.

At Cint, we are committed to innovation and are rapidly expanding our portfolio of data solutions to power the next generation of insights. We are looking for passionate, results-oriented leaders to join us on this journey.

Job Description

The Role

Join our Product Team as a Senior Product Manager. You’ll craft the strategic roadmap and steer the delivery of our Demand services. This role, based in the EU/UK, requires collaboration with our US teams during CET hours and can be remote or attached to one of our existing engineering offices.

We're on the hunt for skilled product managers who have a unique blend of deep technical understanding, customer obsession and a love for solving product problems. With countless potential features to bring to life in Cint, seize the opportunity to be the decision-maker on one of the most impactful domains within Cint.

What You Will Do

• Own the Vision: Develop and promote a product vision for your part of Cint’s Exchange. We make long term investments with large payoffs for success, see the future and articulate it.

• Tell the Story: Masterfully articulate the "why" behind your product strategy. Bring complex customer and technical problems to life, inspiring and aligning senior leadership and the broader organization around your vision.

• Execute with Excellence: Conduct thorough opportunity assessments, backed by data and customer research, to validate assumptions and prioritize initiatives. Author clear, comprehensive product requirements and partner with R&D leadership to navigate complex technical trade-offs.

• Partner to Win: Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across R&D, Data Science, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Marketing to ensure cross-functional alignment and a successful go-to-market.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

• Proven Product Operator: You have a proven track record of launching, operating and scaling complex products, platforms, or services from concept to market or transforming existing products for their next stage of growth.

• Customer-Obsessed: You are an expert in translating customer problems from the ResTech and data space into clear, well-structured product requirements, backed by data and qualitative insights.

• Technical Expertise: You have direct experience managing the full lifecycle of API and UI driven products and can also clearly demonstrate shipping high quality experiences. Demonstrated knowledge, experience and interest in how LLMs and modern coding stacks challenge long held verities would be a strong plus.

• Exceptional Communicator: You possess outstanding written and verbal communication skills and are seen as an expert storyteller. You can effectively partner with senior leadership and are skilled at managing complex stakeholder maps.

• Remote First: Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment.

Why Join Us?

• Strategic Impact: You will be driving the foundation of Cint's current and future success.

• Innovation: You will be on the cutting edge of ResTech and data technology, solving novel problems with a world-class R&D team.

• Global Reach: Cint is a global company with a distributed, flexible, and collaborative culture.

• Ownership: We empower our product team. You will have the autonomy and accountability to make a measurable impact on the business.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

• We uncover rich perspectives across the world

• Success happens together

• We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

• We’re pioneers in our industry

• Our curiosity is insatiable

• We bring the best ideas to life.

We Do What We Say

• We’re accountable for our work and actions

• Excellence comes as standard

• We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

• We learn from each other’s experiences

• Stop and listen; every opinion matters

• We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a rapidly scaling US gaming and consumer technology company to hire a Senior Product Manager who will play a key role in shaping and scaling its product experience through its next phase of growth.

The business operates a high-monetization consumer platform combining sports prediction gaming, social competition and mobile game mechanics. Its experiences bring together sports fandom, competitive gameplay and progression systems, creating new ways for fans to engage, compete and win through their sports knowledge.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, fast-growing business and work closely with its founders and cross-functional teams, driving product development, user engagement and monetization across its core gaming experiences.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and drive the product roadmap across multiple gameplay verticals.

• Translate user insights, player feedback, and market trends into clear product requirements.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, data, and operations.

• Drive experimentation and iteration through A/B testing and product analytics.

• Optimize core product metrics including DAU, retention, conversion, ARPU, and LTV.

• Ensure cohesion across free-to-play progression systems, fantasy gameplay, and sweepstakes mechanics.

• Monitor competitors across DFS, social casino, and sports gaming to identify opportunities for differentiation.

• Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure alignment with U.S. sweepstakes and gaming regulations.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in product management for mobile games, consumer apps, or sports/gaming platforms.

• Proven track record of shipping and scaling impactful mobile features.

• Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear product direction.

• Deep user empathy and passion for building engaging consumer experiences.

• Ability to balance short-term growth opportunities with long-term product development.

• Interest in sports, competition, and social gaming.

Nice to Have

• Experience with F2P economies, progression systems, or live-ops mechanics.

• Exposure to fantasy sports, sweepstakes models, or real-money gaming ecosystems.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing and retention optimization.

• Understanding of game design mechanics around prediction, rewards, and competition.

Why This Opportunity
You'll be joining at a pivotal stage of growth, contributing directly to the evolution of a product that brings together sports fandom, social competition, and mobile gaming progression. With major sports partnerships and a scalable sweepstakes model already in place, this is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful product challenges and help build a category-defining platform.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

What you'll do

What You Own

• The product decisions for your team's area of the blp platform: what gets built, in what order, and why.

• The outcomes your team is accountable for, not the output.

• Discovery: understanding the users and customers in your area deeply enough that you can make most decisions yourself, and knowing which decisions need evidence first.

What You Shape With Us

• The product strategy for your area, in partnership with product leadership and the domain experts.

• How the product organization works as it scales: intake, prioritization, and the operating rhythm. We are actively iterating these, and we want the people doing the work to shape them.

• The standard for product management at blp, which is still being set.

Who You Work With

• Your stream-aligned team.

• Other SATs and the platform teams.

• Customers and key users directly.

• Founders and domain experts, who hold a lot of the accumulated product knowledge in this space.

What you'll bring

Required

• Track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

• Entrepreneurial judgment. Comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

• Experienced in product discovery.

• Can hold a position with engineers, with sales, and with executives, and can say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

• Fluent English.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

A plus

• Enterprise ERP or finance exposure.

• Experience with AI or agentic products in production, particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings.

• German, given our customer base.

What you'll get

• Real ownership. What gets built in your area is yours, from strategy through outcomes.

• A product org still taking shape. Real room to shape how it works, not just execute within it.

• Direct access. To founders, domain experts, and the customers you're building for.

• An empowered model. A seat in it, working with strong engineering and design partners.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Advisor Experience
jobs.description:
We are looking for...

Easor is a financial management platform that connects entrepreneurs and accounting firms. Over 15,000 businesses across Finland, Sweden, Spain, and Italy run their invoicing, payments, and accounting on our software. We listed on Nasdaq Helsinki in March 2026.

We are 145 people, 80 of whom work in product development in Finland and Spain. We are investing heavily in product practices, craft, and team structure to match the ambitions of an independent product company. This role is part of that effort.

The Role

You will be the Senior Product Manager for Advisor Experience, the team that serves the accounting professionals who run their client work on Easor. Together with the squad whose goal is to maximize the value delivered to business owners, your team is on the mission to make accounting effortless for everyone, so business can focus on what really matters.

Our mission is simple to say and hard to do maximise profit for accounting offices. Every hour an accountant spends on manual work is margin lost. Your job is to find that lost margin and win it back, through workflows that remove work, automate it, or make it billable.

You work in a stream-aligned product team with a designer and engineers, based in Spain. You report to the Director of Product.

What You'll Do

• Shape the product strategy and roadmap for Advisor Experience together with your team and Easor's product leadership.

• Manage discovery and delivery for mid-to-long-term goals independently, where done means validated, not shipped.

• Collaborate with accountants and accounting office owners to identify where their time and margin leak, and determine what makes their business more profitable.

• Establish product KPIs, value drivers and tracking for advisor solutions, instrument them, and steer decision-making based on these metrics.

• Redesign ways of working around AI, and shape how AI takes manual work off accountants' desks.

What We Are Looking For

• Independent operator. You have owned a product area through full cycles. You decide what to build next and prove it was the right call.

• Evidence-driven. You end product arguments with data or a test, not with opinion. You are comfortable building measurement where none exists.

• Commercially sharp. You think in your customer's P&L. You can tell which feature makes an accounting office money and which one just looks nice.

• Workflow obsessed. You love watching professionals work and finding the steps that shouldn't exist.

• Strong collaborator. This role lives on the seams between your team, other domain teams, and real accounting offices. You bring them together.

• Deep in the domain, or fast to get there. Accounting workflows, our competitors, what makes a firm profitable. Domain expertise is an asset, not a prerequisite.

Experience in an international, multi-office and remote setting is a plus. Experience in financial, accounting, or another regulated software domain is a plus.

English and Spanish fluency required.

Practicalities

• The gross annual salary is 45000-60000 €/year depending on experience and country specific employee benefits.

• Flexible working setup with weekly visits to our office

• Modern office in Coruña and Barcelona

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager , you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

• Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs

• Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences

• Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales

• Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies

• Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation

• Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements

• Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting

• Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

• Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game

• Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development

• Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision

• Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels

• Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Pass)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top :1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Check our open-source projects here.

The ID Team

The ID team owns three of Proton's most strategically important products: Proton Pass (password manager), Proton Authenticator , and SimpleLogin (alias and identity protection) — serving millions of users from individuals to businesses managing credentials at scale.

We're looking for a Senior PM to lead the next stage of these products. Product at Proton sits at the intersection of Engineering, Growth, Data, and Design — your job is to grow engagement and retention by shipping experiences users love, while driving the freemium model that sits at the heart of how we grow. You'll set direction across Pass, Authenticator, and SimpleLogin, not execute someone else's roadmap.

What You'll Own

• Define and drive the product roadmap for Pass, Authenticator, and SimpleLogin — from strategic vision through delivery — in close collaboration with senior leadership.

• Own the metrics that matter: active usage, user engagement, retention, revenue, and B2B conversion. Set the bar, track it, and course-correct fast.

• Identify and ship novel product features that expand the value proposition to new user segments and deepen defensibility against well-resourced competitors.

• Lead cross-functional execution across engineering, design, growth, and marketing — remove blockers, maintain velocity, and keep teams aligned on priorities.

• Anticipate growth ceilings before they hit. Define scaling strategies that go beyond pure product work — including infrastructure, tooling, and customer engagement platforms.

• Drive market research, competitive analysis, and direct customer feedback loops to ensure product decisions are grounded in real user needs.

Who You Are

• 6–10 years of product management experience in B2C or B2B SaaS, with a track record of successful product and major feature launches.

• Analytically rigorous: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed decisions without losing sight of user intuition.

• Experienced in product-led growth and freemium business models — you understand the mechanics of conversion, retention, and expansion revenue.

• A sharp eye for UX — you can tell good design from bad, and you won't ship experiences that fall short.

• Able to go deep with engineers: you understand technical trade-offs, participate meaningfully in architecture discussions, and earn credibility through substance, not title.

• Demonstrated experience building or scaling B2B product lines — you know what enterprise buyers need and how that differs from consumer.

Nice to Have

• Experience in online privacy, security, or identity products.

• Familiarity with cryptographic concepts relevant to user data protection.

• Prior experience with a freemium model scaling into mid-market or enterprise.

What We Offer

• Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.

• Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.

• Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.

• Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.

• Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.

• Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.

• Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.

• Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.

• Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

• Compensation range: Paris/Barcelona: 60,000 - 95,000 EUR gross annually*

• Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Amenitiz is the all-in-one software behind 15,000 independent hotels in Spain, Portugal, France and Italy. In 2026 we shipped more than ever: POS, Ami and Conversations, fiscal compliance in five countries, and integrations with OTAs, revenue management systems and POS providers.

Our product surface grew faster than three PMs can carry. You'll be the fourth, and you'll own a part of it end to end: from the opportunity, to the code, to hotels using it and paying for it.

How PMs work here

Our PMs open the repo. They prototype with Claude Code in days, ship fixes and small changes themselves, and bring engineers the hard problems with a working prototype in hand.

They spend hours every week with hoteliers: on calls, on visits, in the Care queue. They read their own data in SQL and Mixpanel. And a release is only the start: a feature is done when hotels use it and we can see it in the numbers.

What you'll own

• One initiative from our 18-month product plan, from idea to adopted, measured hotel by hotel

• The adoption number for everything you ship

• A set of hotels you know by name, and the partnerships your initiatives need

• Launch enablement for Care, Onboarding, Account Management, Sales and Marketing

Your first year

• Month 3: your own changes in production, and a prototype in front of real hotels

• Month 6: your first major release live, with an activation target set before launch and tracked from day one

• Month 12: an initiative that measurably moved revenue for a set of hotels, and the next 6-month roadmap for your area, written by you

You have

• 5+ years as a PM in B2B SaaS, including an initiative you built from scratch and the adoption or retention number it moved

• Software you built and shipped yourself: prototypes with Claude Code or similar, and fixes merged to production. You can show us something real users used

• Real time with customers, especially small-business owners, and the instinct to bring back what they'd pay for

• Experience defining activation, reading the funnel yourself and fixing drop-off in the product

• Full professional English

• A base in Barcelona, or the will to move here: we work office-first from Plaça de Catalunya

Bonus points

• A background in hospitality, travel, payments or compliance

• Spanish, French, Italian or Portuguese

• LLM or agent features in production

• Experience running a big product surface with a small team

Why join

• Own a chapter of an 18-month plan, at 15,000 hotels in four countries

• Build with AI the way most PMs only read about

• Join a team of four PMs where every one of them ships

• Work with a direct line to our CPO and CEO

• Live and work in Barcelona

Our process

• A 30-minute call with Talent Acquisition

• 60 minutes with Marco Riedl, our CPO

• A 90-minute working session where you build: you get a real initiative 48 hours ahead (prep takes under 4 hours), prototype part of it live with Claude Code, and show how you'd measure its adoption

• 45 minutes with the team

• 45 minutes with our CEO

You'll hear from us after every step, whatever the outcome.

Job Description

About the Team : Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies. About the Role

Dow Jones is hiring a Senior Product Manager to help shape how AI shows up across our product portfolio. This role will help build the AI experiences across both consumer products (WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch) and our professional information products (Factiva, WSJ Pro, Oxford Analytica, Dragonfly). You will partner closely with the internal teams that build our AI agent and orchestration platform, our search platform, and our personalization platform to ensure the experiences you ship consume reusable services rather than one-off implementations. Most importantly, you will represent the end user (whether a subscriber on their morning commute or an analyst building a client briefing) in the AI roadmap to ensure our work represents something that adds value to their lives.

The role sits on the GenAI Experiences team and reports to the Director of Product Management.

You Will

• Own the AI experience roadmap for one or more surfaces across the portfolio, with success measured against retention, engagement, and demonstrable user value, not shipped feature count.

• Translate the specific jobs of our users (consumer subscribers, financial analysts, risk and legal professionals, researchers) into AI experiences that do the work, save the time, or reveal insight they could not surface on their own, and ship them on reusable shared capabilities rather than hand-built per product.

• Partner with the internal platform teams to bring your users' requirements into the shared capability roadmap, and run the experimentation and measurement discipline that lets us tell retention-grade stories about AI impact.

You Have

• 7+ years of product management experience, preferably with at least 2 years shipping AI-powered products in production (using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent-based or retrieval-based systems).

• Experience owning a consumer, B2B, or enterprise product that serves a well-defined user, ideally one where retention or engagement is the north-star metric.

• Working fluency in modern AI product patterns: retrieval and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design, plus comfort reasoning about tradeoffs across model, prompt, data, and orchestration layers.

We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. • Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.

• Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.

Operating as an AI-native Product Manager

• Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.

Collaborating across teams

• Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.

• Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.

What will set you up for success in this role?

• Strong product thinking and a user-centric mindset, paired with the commercial instinct to connect product decisions to business outcomes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across both commercial and technical audiences.

Exceptionally data-driven

Deep understanding of customer economics

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About The Role

• Understand our business, our customers, our market and the data of our product, in order to delight our customers and achieve Fever’s goals.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Work smart, have fun and make an impact!

EcoVadis is the leading provider of business sustainability ratings . Our solutions are backed by an international team of experts and powerful technology. We analyze data and build sustainability scorecards that give companies actionable insights into their environmental, social and ethical risks.

Why apply to EcoVadis? Be a part of the global sustainability change in business. Grow your career. Work with extraordinary people. Feel valued for your contribution.

Learn more about our team and culture on EcoVadis careers page.

Job Description

As a Senior Product Manager for one of our Strategic Use Cases, you will own that use case end-to-end — from the customer problem and the data it depends on, through prototype, roadmap and launch, to the outcome in the market. You will work alongside senior engineers and product experts to define the ambition, understand requirements and launch innovative new products.

This is a builder role, not a coordination role. We're looking for a high-agency generalist who prototypes before they debate, uses AI to move at a different speed, engages customers directly, and takes full ownership of outcomes — not output.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own the vision: Set and drive the aligned, end-to-end vision for your use case (regulatory due diligence, human rights due diligence, decarbonization or resilience)— what the customer experience should be, where the gaps are, and the sequence from parity to leadership.

• Understand the market: Understand the technical requirements of your use case, and how other competitors and customers are currently solving it. Take inspiration from everywhere, including partner discussions, conferences, webinars and other resources.

• Engage customers directly: Spend real time with buyers, program owners and co-development accounts. Validate problems and solutions first-hand; and build interest from customers and prospects.

• Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools to build working demos, spin up lightweight services and test your own assumptions before committing engineering. Show the team what's possible by doing it, not describing it.

• Drive the build forward: Work alongside engineering to unblock and drive the build forward, working across multiple areas of the product and platform, collaborating with other tribes and squads whilst executing independently or in partnership.

• Partner on go-to-market: Work hand-in-hand with the Strategic Use Case Leads and commercial teams to land what you build.

• Own the outcome: Define the measures of success, hold yourself and the circle to them, and lead clean persist / pivot / stop decisions.

Who You Are

• A generalist builder at heart — you move fluidly between strategy, data, prototype and GTM, and you'd rather build a rough thing that teaches you something than debate a perfect thing that doesn't.

• An AI-native operator — AI is woven through how you work: discovery, analysis, prototyping, instrumentation and communication.

• Customer-obsessed — you get your conviction from talking to real customers, not from the building.

• Biased to speed — you move decisively with incomplete information, tell reversible decisions from irreversible ones, and update fast when you're wrong. Strong opinions, loosely held.

• Comfortable without full control — part of your use case's scope and experience will always be owned by other squads. You see managing that, as the craft.

• Mission-driven — you want your work to help guide all companies toward a sustainable world, and to help EcoVadis lead the market in getting there.

AI fluency we hire for

We expect you to operate at the AI-Fluent to AI-Native end of the spectrum: you don't just use AI for one-off tasks, you reconstruct core PM workflows around it — agents configured with your product context, personas and prior research; machine-testable acceptance criteria; reusable workflows you share with the squad. At the top of this ladder, the PM shifts from feature author to outcome orchestrator — concentrating on strategic trade-offs and novel bets while agents carry more of the discovery and synthesis.

Qualifications

• Typically 10+ years experience, including a track record owning a meaningful product area end-to-end in B2B enterprise SaaS, with real business and customer outcomes to point to.

• Enough technical fluency to build — you can prototype with AI tooling, LLM APIs and a scripting language (Python / JavaScript or equivalent) without waiting for engineering to validate every idea.

• An AI-native way of working that's already part of how you operate, not an aspiration.

• Comfort operating in a regulated, data-rich, sustainability or risk domain — or the curiosity and speed to get there fast.

• Sharp problem framing and communication — you walk into the room with a recommendation, not an open question, and you make engineering and design faster by reducing ambiguity.

• Be fluent in English (as our primary working language).

Additional Information

In return for your expertise, we offer:

• Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment

• Flexible working hours

• Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing

• Access to professional mental health support

• Referral bonus policy

• Learning and development

• Sustainability events and community involvement

• Peer recognition program

• Employee-led resource groups

• Hybrid work organization (2 office days per week)

• Remote work from abroad policy

• Meals and Transportation Vouchers (Coverflex card)

• Dental Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance + Private Health Insurance

• Paid employee volunteer day

• Paid moving day (1/year)

• Time off: 1 Community Service Day + 1 Personal Day

• Summer Hours in July and August (36 hours per week)

• Hybrid Monthly Allowance for electricity and Internet

Our hiring team looks forward to reviewing your resume, in English, with a guaranteed response to every application. A new job with purpose awaits you!

Don’t meet all criteria? Please apply anyway. We welcome diverse candidates and want to assess your skills and potential contribution to EcoVadis, regardless of your background.

Can the hiring process be adjusted to suit my needs? Yes. We want all candidates, including people with disabilities, people with long-term health conditions, and neurodiverse applicants, to feel confident demonstrating their potential. If you require adjustments, such as interview questions in advance, please inform the hiring team.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Products
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Every great learning experience at Preply starts with great data. Our data product team builds foundational data products from governed, reusable data models and semantic layers. They power analytics, AI (classic ML and LLMs) and the necessary context for agentic products, helping Preply drive growth, innovate faster and become a truly AI-native company.

We’re a new function with a greenfield mandate, working alongside a high-calibre product and engineering organisation, and you’ll be the first product manager dedicated to shaping what we build and in what order.

What You’ll Be Doing

Ownership: Shape and build the foundational data products for a fast-growing learning platform and marketplace, and modernise our data foundations and data platforms so every team can build on data that is trusted, governed and AI-ready.

Strategy and roadmap: Decide which data products to build and in what order. Spot opportunities with business and product teams, especially those that build our data moat, and make sure the data we build gets adopted and used.

Partners: Work hand in hand with analytics engineering, data science, engineering, product, finance and business teams.

Success: Prove the return on our data products by showing how they drive company and product outcomes and business performance.

What You Need To Succeed

• Experience in a senior product role, with proven experience building data products.

• Demonstrated business impact from data products, backed by tangible examples.

• Strong product craft: you plan and run an agile product process, build roadmaps, define metrics, coordinate stakeholders and make complex trade-offs with sound judgement.

• Experience working with data engineers or analytics engineers.

• A track record of driving adoption through compelling, high-quality data products that people choose to use, and of demoing new ways to use data that unlock new products and business experiences.

• Working knowledge of SQL, data governance tools and modern data platforms.

Nice to have

• Experience leading data modernisation transformations.

• Experience building company-wide agentic analytics

Why you'll enjoy working at Preply:

• An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com

• Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development

• A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance

• Attractive relocation package for those not in Barcelona to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub

• Access to free mental health support platforms

• Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health

• The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)

Our Principles

• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

• Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

• Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

• Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

• Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

• Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

• Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

• Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

• One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
jobs.description:
About The Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

• Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

• Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

• Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

• Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

• Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

• Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

• Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

• Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

• Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

An ideal candidate has

• 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

• Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

• Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

• The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

• Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

• Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

• A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

• Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

• Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

• Hopper covers the cost of employee premiums for private medical and dental coverage

• Hopper also offers private life and accident coverage

• Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

• Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

• Unlimited PTO

• Hopper offers a monthly cash allowance for gym memberships and to cover home office expenses

• Carrot Cash travel stipend

• Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

• Open communication with management and company leadership

• Small, dynamic teams with massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, Co

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments & Finance
jobs.description:
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, London, or Dublin.

This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.

You’ll own Payments & Finance: the systems behind how we manage credit lines, financial exposure, risk, and complex payment requirements across our Stays business.

You’ll run it as a full business and product domain . You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.

The problem underneath is complex. We extend credit to clients, manage financial risk across growing transaction volumes, and handle different payment rules for different partners. How do you make all of that scalable, reliable, and commercially sustainable as the business grows?

What makes it interesting for you

• You can move extremely fast. There’s very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.

• You own the path to the outcome. You’ll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.

• You get hard financial infrastructure problems. Credit exposure, risk, ledgers, and complex payment flows all need to work together as transaction volumes grow.

• You’ll help build Nuitee’s product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we’re building one, and you’ll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

The kind of problems you’ll work on

• How do we manage credit lines and financial exposure as transaction volumes grow, reducing risk without limiting business growth?

• How do we support complex client-specific payment requirements, including virtual cards, charging rules, and payment timing, without creating operational complexity?

• How do we make ledgers, financial workflows, and payment operations more scalable, reliable, and automated as the business grows?

This role fits if you

• Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.

• Understand financial systems and payment flows, especially credit, ledgers, risk management, or financial exposure.

• Can work closely with Finance and Risk teams, understand complex financial processes, and turn them into product decisions.

• Are comfortable working closely with engineering on technically complex products.

• Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.

• Can balance commercial opportunities, customer requirements, and financial risk, and are willing to go deep into the underlying business mechanics.

Fintech, payments, or credit experience matters more to us than travel experience.
Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.

If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Paper.io 2
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

Role

• Build and implement F2P systems that enhance player engagement and revenue, with a focus on progression, monetization, live events, and in-game economies.

• Prioritize development efforts under tight deadlines, balancing speed and quality to maximize impact.

Profile

• Strong understanding of F2P mobile game mechanics

• Able to write clear specs and align teams

• High standards. We need someone who pushes the product forward and challenges weak ideas

• Experience on a successful live game

• Good understanding of IAP monetization, not only ads

• Has seen what great live games do, for example Brawl Stars, Clash Royale, Monopoly Go, Stumble Guys, Subway Surfers, etc

Benefits

• Best-in-class compensation

• Other benefits according to the country you reside

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI/ML
jobs.description:
ClickHouse is the fastest-growing database in the OLAP space, and AI is reshaping how developers and enterprises interact with their data. From ClickHouse Agents and AI Functions to the Remote MCP Server, LibreChat, and Langfuse, AI/ML capabilities are rapidly becoming a core pillar of the ClickHouse Cloud experience and a key growth vector for the platform.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own core areas of our agentic analytics experience. You will work at the intersection of large language models, developer tooling, and high-performance analytics, shaping how organizations let agents query, reason over, and act on their data. This is a high-ownership role: you will drive products from discovery to launch with autonomy expanding as fast as you build confidence and context.

What will you do?

• Roadmap Ownership: Own the roadmap for key surfaces of the agentic analytics portfolio, from discovery through launch and iteration, and ensure they are best-in-class in the analytics database space.

• Customer Discovery: Talk to users constantly — developers, data engineers, and platform teams deploying agents against production data — and turn their feedback into crisp priorities.

• Product Quality: Define and prioritize features that improve agent accuracy, latency, cost, and trust. Instrument the product with evals and observability (Langfuse) so that quality is measured.

• Market & Competitive Intelligence: Track the competitive landscape and translate it into positioning, differentiation, and gaps to close.

• Go-to-Market Partnership: Partner with marketing, sales, and developer relations on pricing, packaging, launch content, and field enablement.

• Communication: Write clearly and often, including public-facing content that explains what we built and why.

What You Bring Along

• 3+ years of product management experience in developer tools, data infrastructure, or ML/AI products

• Hands-on familiarity with LLMs and agentic workflows: you have built or shipped something with them

• Comfort with SQL and analytical databases; you can query your own product data without waiting for someone else

• Strong written communication and the ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, and go-to-market

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

• Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

• Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

• Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

• Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

• Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

• Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

• Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

What You Bring

• 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

• Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

Nice to haves

• Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

• Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

• Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Financial Services Ops
jobs.description:
Your role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead Financial Services Ops , the squad that turns compliance, risk, and operational needs into product. Your internal customers are the Compliance, Operations, Risk, and Fraud teams that keep Spendesk’s payment licence running, together with the four Financial Services squads building cards, wallets, and transfers for end customers.

Today, those teams pull product and engineering time from across Financial Services. A regulatory change, a manual operational workload, or a risk alert can become a new P0 on another squad’s roadmap. Your role is to absorb that demand, turn it into one prioritised backlog, and build the tools and workflows that help compliance and operations scale without slowing the rest of Financial Services down.

The squad already owns KYC and AML, including company onboarding, representative verification, ongoing transaction monitoring, and the migration of our transaction monitoring system. The scope is broader than KYC and AML: you will own the internal platform between Spendesk’s regulated entity and the products built on top of it.

What You’ll Own

• Onboarding and KYC: company and representative verification, document collection, and time-to-activation.

• AML and monitoring: transaction monitoring, alert handling, and the transaction monitoring system migration.

• Operations tooling: back-office tools, case management, and dashboards that replace manual work.

• Risk and fraud controls: controls, limits, and the signals Risk and Fraud teams need to act.

• Regulatory intake: one entry point and one priority order for regulatory and operational requests across Compliance, Legal, and the Financial Services squads.

• Infrastructure vendors: identity verification, monitoring, and BaaS partners across the EU, UK, and US.

What You’ll Do

• Define the platform strategy and roadmap so it serves Financial Services business goals and regulatory obligations.

• Replace the current competing-P0 model with a single intake and prioritised backlog agreed by Compliance, Operations, and the Financial Services squads.

• Rebuild company onboarding to reduce time-to-activation, improve document completion, and remove manual rework.

• Lead the transaction monitoring system migration with Engineering and Compliance.

• Build internal tools and dashboards that help Operations scale without adding headcount at the same pace.

• Define and instrument metrics that do not exist yet, including time-to-activation, file completeness at KYC entry, cost per manual case, straight-through processing rate, and engineering time spent on internal requests outside your squad.

• Act as the bridge between Product and Compliance, so regulation is designed in rather than patched later.

• Evaluate and manage identity, monitoring, and infrastructure vendors.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment.

• Experience building products for internal users, such as back-office, operations tooling, platform, or infrastructure products.

• Comfort working with regulation. You do not need to be a lawyer, but PSD2, AML directives, compliance policies, and conversations with an MLRO should be familiar territory.

• Analytical rigour: you define success metrics, instrument what is not measured yet, and use evidence to prioritise.

• Clear, natural communication. You can explain a regulation in plain language, build trust with Compliance, Operations, and Engineering, and negotiate scope without losing substance.

• The resilience to work effectively in a changing environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with KYC, KYB, AML, or transaction monitoring.

• Experience owning onboarding or identity verification flows with measurable outcomes.

• Experience leading a vendor migration or infrastructure integration, such as a BaaS, card processor, or monitoring provider integration.

• Experience working across EU, UK, and US regulatory contexts.

• Fluency in French or Spanish.

About Spendesk

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk gives employees a simpler way to spend and finance leaders the visibility and control they need across company spend, including multi-entity structures.

Spendesk supports more than 200,000 users across companies including PayFit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt, and Yousign. The company has offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Germany, and puts community at the heart of its mission.

For more information: www.spendesk.com/press

About Our People And Culture

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to thrive and grow. Liberation is at the core of how we work: we empower Spendeskers to take ownership, navigate ambiguity, and seize opportunities. Our international team spans more than 35 countries, with a shared commitment to curiosity, kindness, and tackling challenges with a positive mindset.

About Our Benefits

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth, with benefits to match:

• Flexible on-site and remote policy.

• Latest Apple equipment.

• Access to Moka.care for emotional and mental health wellbeing.

• Great office snacks.

• A positive team to work with every day.

We also offer location-specific benefits, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships.

Diversity and inclusion

At Spendesk, we are committed to fostering an environment where differences are encouraged, supported, and celebrated. We are building our culture for everyone, with everyone, and welcome people from all backgrounds.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.
