OLX is looking for a Principal Product Manager to drive high-impact, zero-to-one initiatives across our Real Estate business (otodom.pl, imovirtual.com and storia.ro). This is a builder role focused on creating new value - not a people-management role. It's well-suited for someone who thrives on building new things, moving fast, and navigating a complex organisation to turn ideas into impact.

You'll lead 2–3 special initiatives in parallel, each scoped over 6–24 months. These could range from developing AI-driven capabilities and new monetisation models to building new product features that drive growth. We're hiring for mindset, not a fixed checklist.

You'll join the product leadership team and contribute to strategic direction across the area. The focus is on building, pushing, and delivering new value, complementing a team that excels at running and optimising the core business.

This role reports to the Director of Product and can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland. Remote work is possible within these countries.

What You'll Do

• Lead zero-to-one initiatives from concept to market validation to scaled delivery - own the vision, strategy, and execution.

• Build with AI as a daily lever - prototypes, agent-augmented workflows, AI-powered discovery and experimentation.

• Run lean experiments to prove product-market fit fast, with minimal bureaucracy.

• Present and defend your concepts to senior stakeholders - building alignment through evidence and conviction.

• Navigate a matrixed organisation: identify opportunities to move quickly, build coalitions, and drive progress without waiting for perfect alignment.

• Own the business case: connect product decisions to revenue and margin impact.

• Raise the bar for product craft across the team - set the standard through your work, share methods and examples, and act as a role model for what high-quality product thinking looks like in practice.

What We're Looking For

• 8+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of building and launching new products from zero to one - not just optimising what exists.

• AI native - you build with AI in your personal and professional life.

• Entrepreneurial DNA - uncomfortable with "business as usual," driven to create new value.

• Fast and execution-driven - moves at pace, ships quickly, and creates momentum rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

• High product craft - rigorous discovery, lean experimentation, strong narratives, data-driven decision-making.

• Strong executive presence - able to defend a concept to senior directors and build alignment.

• Business and financial acumen - unit economics, P&L thinking, ROI-informed decisions.

• Ability to drive multiple initiatives in parallel with minimal oversight.

• Marketplace or two-sided marketplace experience is a plus.

• Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.

• Willingness to travel approximately every two months.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Employer of Record
jobs.description:
About RemotePass

RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries. Recognised as one of G2's Top 100 Fastest Growing Software Products, we're on a mission to break down geographical barriers and create a world where exceptional talent can thrive anywhere.

From hiring and onboarding to payroll, compliance, and financial services, we give organisations everything they need to build high-performing global teams, and give workers worldwide access to opportunities that were once out of reach.

We're backed by world-class investors including EBRD Venture Capital, 500 Global, Endeavor Catalyst, BECO Capital, Wamda Capital, 212 VC, Oraseya Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Access Bridge Ventures.

About The Role

Employer of Record is the core of our business. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our EOR product end to end and make it the best in the market. You'll sit in the Product & Operations team with a direct line to the CEO.

This role is about depth and craft, not a big title. You'll own the full employee lifecycle, from quotes and onboarding to compliance, benefits, and offboarding, along with the internal tooling and AI agents that run behind it.

We're also moving our product organisation from delivery-led to discovery-led, and EOR leads that shift. The scope is real from day one.

What You'll Do

• Own the full EOR lifecycle. Quotes, onboarding, contracts, country compliance, benefits, changes during employment, and offboarding. Know where it breaks today, and fix it

• Set the roadmap. Decide what gets built and what doesn't, and defend those calls

• Lead discovery. Spend real time with customers, prospects, employees, and our operations teams, and set the standard for discovery-led product at RemotePass

• Turn noise into direction. Distil CS escalations, ops pain, sales objections, prospect calls, and support tickets into a clear, prioritised view of what matters. Make your reasoning visible so the business knows where it stands

• Go deep on countries. EOR runs on a mix of our own entities and in-country partners, each with its own rules. Turn employment law, compliance requirements, and country-specific flows into product that works at scale

• Build the machinery behind EOR. Own the internal platforms and AI agents behind EOR operations, including onboarding and contract automation, compliance checks, ops workflows, and support tooling, so operations can scale without adding headcount

• Drive execution across time zones. Connect product, engineering, operations, and go-to-market, and work closely with Payroll where EOR and payroll meet. Drive outcomes without waiting for a room to walk into

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in product, with hands-on ownership of EOR, HR tech, or complex B2B workflow products such as onboarding, compliance, or operations platforms

• A track record of shipping and scaling a product built on real operational complexity, ideally through a growth phase

• Strong discovery skills: you form your own view from customers and data

• Hands-on with AI, both as a product surface and as a working tool

• Comfortable going deep into employment law, compliance requirements, and country-specific processes

• Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams across time zones

Nice to Have

• Direct experience at an EOR, PEO, or global payroll provider

• Experience building internal tooling or automation for operations teams

You'll Thrive in This Role If

• You'd rather form your own view than work from a backlog handed to you

• You like making calls in a fast, direct, low-process environment

• You care as much about the machinery behind the product as the customer-facing surface

Benefits

Why Join RemotePass?

• Own our core product line, end to end

• Work directly with the CEO and have a real voice in shaping the product organisation

• Equity grant on top of competitive compensation

• Profitable, and still scaling fast. We reached profitability in 2025 and just raised a $17.4M Series B led by EBRD, with 500 Global joining. You get the pace of a scale-up with the stability of a business that works

• Real global scale. We support 35,000+ workers in 150+ countries and have processed over $800M in cross-border payroll for companies like Logitech, Tata Group, and Careem

• Big bets ahead. We're expanding across Europe and the US, building financial products for distributed teams, and investing heavily in AI. There's a lot to build, and room to grow with it

• Remote-first, for real. We don't just sell remote work, we live it. Work from anywhere

• Inclusion matters. We value different perspectives and empower everyone to bring their authentic self to work

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, API & Billing
jobs.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

The largest nonprofits don’t just use Fundraise Up anymore. They build on it.

Enterprise customers connect us to their CRMs, data warehouses, mobile apps and in-house tools. Canvassing vendors, F2F agencies, P2P and OEM partners process donations through our API, and donation volume through it has grown roughly 5x in a year. You’ll own this surface end to end. You’ll set the API strategy, then relaunch and scale the API so every new product ships with it from day one. You’ll also expand the payment methods donors can use around the world. This is a technical role with a business goal: a strong API is a direct path to more money reaching the causes our customers serve.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the API strategy and roadmap end to end. This covers the Public API, webhooks and events, the P2P API, write and bulk operations, versioning, limits, idempotency and key security.

• Turn the integration needs of enterprise customers and key partners into platform capabilities that work for every customer, not one-off customizations.

• Build the Partner API Program from scratch, including onboarding, access, documentation and success metrics. Also own the no-code and data connectors partners rely on: Zapier, Make.com, n8n and data warehouse exports.

• Drive API parity by partnering with New Products teams, so P2P, Tap to Donate, Gift Cart and every future launch ship with API and event support at launch.

• Act as the product counterpart for enterprise customers and the go-to-market team on integrations, through discovery calls, technical requirements and Customer Advisory Board sessions.

• Own developer experience (portal, docs, SDKs, observability) and the metrics behind it: donation volume through the API, active integrations, time to first successful call and webhook delivery rate.

• Expand how and where donors can pay, as a smaller, adjacent scope. This includes local payment methods and geographic coverage, recurring payment retries, payment infrastructure, DAF giving and compliance.

• Use AI as a default tool, not an experimental one. At Fundraise Up, we expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work. That means finding where AI can change the shape of problems in API and platform product work, from research and specs to prototypes and data analysis, and growing your fluency as the tools evolve.

Skills And Qualifications

• 5+ years in Product Management in B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years owning a public API, an integrations platform or a payments product.

• Hands-on technical fluency with REST, OpenAPI, webhooks, OAuth and API keys. You read API docs and make test calls yourself.

• A track record with enterprise customers and technology partners, turning the requirements of a specific integration into platform capabilities.

• Comfort working with go-to-market teams and running customer interviews. You bring technical depth and business judgment together.

• Daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor for research, specs, prototypes and data analysis.

• Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

• Payments experience, such as Stripe, local payment methods or recurring billing.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Get excited by an under-built product area where the strategy is yours to write.

• Think in contracts. Hundreds of integrations depend on what you ship, so stability and predictability are features to you.

• Hear one customer’s blocker and see the capability the whole customer base needs.

• Size an opportunity in dollars before you build it, and own the result after you ship.

• Are as comfortable debating idempotency with engineers as walking an enterprise customer through a roadmap.

• Prototype and test things yourself instead of waiting for someone else to.

• Say what you think, invite pushback and change your mind when the data says so.

Please note that final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Gross Total Compensation

€5.900—€6.500 EUR

Perks & Benefits

• 23 days of vacation, 14 public holidays, and 5 fully paid sick days.

• Private health insurance for you and your family.

• Mental health support with therapy sessions for you and your partner.

• Sports reimbursement to help you stay active and feel your best.

• Fully remote work.

• Generous home office stipend to set up a comfortable, productive workspace.

• Coworking reimbursement for days when you'd rather work alongside other people.

• Annual professional development stipend to support your growth.

• English learning programs to help you communicate with confidence across our global team.

• Charitable giving program with company matching for your donations to registered non-profits.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

• Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.***

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

A donation made at a gala shouldn’t sit in a different system from one made online.

In-Person Giving brings Fundraise Up’s fast, connected giving experience into physical fundraising moments, starting with Tap to Donate and Giving Station. As a hands-on Product Manager reporting to the Director of New Products, you’ll decide where the product goes next. That means improving what exists today, and deciding on evidence how far to expand into ticketing, galas, and complex fundraising events. All of it builds on one connected platform rather than another isolated event tool. This is an individual contributor role. It is not a people-management, event-planning, or sales role.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the In-Person Giving product thesis and a sequenced roadmap. Turn customer research, market evidence, and commercial context into clear calls on what to build, integrate, partner on, defer, or leave out.

• Drive discovery directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, donors, and GTM partners. Map full workflows before, during, and after an event, and separate real adoption blockers from expectations set by incumbent event platforms.

• Own delivery end to end with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA. That covers requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records, and staying close to QA and post-launch issues.

• Design for real event conditions: staff-led and self-service flows, mobile and optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume peaks, and operational recovery. Reuse existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.

• Partner with the Peer-to-Peer team so shared capabilities are built once, not twice.

• Launch through early access programs (EAPs) with clear entry criteria, success measures, and scope. Align Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on commitments and readiness.

• Own outcomes after launch. Connect product evidence to adoption, workflow completion, GPV, retention, and operational cost, then make an explicit recommendation: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

• At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, spec quality, and data exploration, without handing over product judgment.

Skills And Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on Product Management experience in a software product company, including independent end-to-end ownership of a customer-facing B2B SaaS product area with Engineering and Design.

• A track record of taking a new product or a meaningful expansion from an ambiguous problem through launch, adoption, and measurable customer and business results. You can explain your own decisions, not only the team’s output.

• Experience working directly with business customers, Sales, and CSM on enterprise requirements and commercial commitments, while keeping a coherent product direction.

• Strong judgment in narrowing a large problem space to a focused release using customer evidence, product data, and commercial context, and in explaining what you chose not to build.

• Experience with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships. You own the operational edge cases and data accuracy, not only the main user flow.

• Clear written communication across product direction, requirements, metrics, and decision records.

• Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken

Nice to Have

• Experience building for US enterprise customers and working with US go-to-market teams.

• Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, or auctions.

• Experience with mobile apps, contactless payments, or hardware-enabled workflows.

• Experience in fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex environments.

• Experience launching a new product area through a beta or EAP.

• Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, or SQL.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

• Would rather work out what should be built than receive a finished roadmap.

• Move forward without full certainty, and change course when the evidence says so.

• Measure progress in customer and business outcomes, not features shipped.

• Can say no to a customer request, explain why, and keep the relationship strong.

• Align people through clear writing and candid trade-offs rather than escalation.

• Want hands-on product ownership, not people management, event planning, or project coordination.

• Care that the product helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more for their missions.

jobs.title: Principal Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us. 💫
Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. 🌱 Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.

The Challenge 🧩
As a Growth Product Manager , you’ll play a key role in accelerating Wallapop’s user growth by owning the strategy and roadmap for acquisition and activation. You’ll collaborate with engineers, designers, analysts, and marketing specialists to optimize the user journey from signup to the first 3 successful transactions.
You’ll drive product-led growth through data-driven experimentation, improving funnel conversion, and aligning closely with our marketing teams across paid and organic channels.

What You Will Do 👇

• Lead the growth strategy for user acquisition and activation across Wallapop’s app and web platforms.

• Design, run, and analyze experiments to improve engagement at every stage of the journey — from registration to the first transaction.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, and marketing to deliver high-impact growth initiatives.

• Partner with the Head of Acquisition to align marketing performance (SEO, SEM, Google Shopping) with in-product experiences that drive long-term activation.

• Leverage data and insights to identify and remove friction points in the onboarding and listing/buying flows.

• Define and monitor key metrics including activation rate, conversion rate, cost per activated user, and repeat transaction rate.

• Cultivate a culture of experimentation , utilizing A/B testing, cohort analysis, and iterative product improvements.

• Communicate learnings and results across product, marketing, and leadership teams to ensure shared goals and transparent progress.

What We’re Looking For 🔎

• Experience: Extensive experience in Product Management, with a focus on growth, activation, or conversion optimization.

• Experimental Mindset: A proven track record of driving measurable growth through data-informed experimentation and journey optimization.

• Collaborative Leadership: Experience working effectively within cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, designers, and marketers.

• Marketing Fluency: A solid understanding of how organic and paid channels (SEO, social, app campaigns) intersect with the product experience.

• Communication: Excellent storytelling skills; the ability to influence and align stakeholders around data-driven decisions.

• Tooling: Familiarity with A/B testing tools and analytics platforms (such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Looker).

• Mission-Driven: A genuine interest in marketplaces, user behavior, and sustainable consumption.

What Would Be A Plus 🚀

• Experience in marketplace or e-commerce environments, especially involving supply/demand dynamics.

• Technical background or a high degree of comfort collaborating closely with engineering teams on architectural trade-offs.

• Understanding of user segmentation, CRM automation, or retention marketing.

Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals.
Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone.

• Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year

• Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day

• Private Health Insurance with Alan

• Flexible working hours + intensive Fridays

• Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check)

• Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office

• Generous referral Program & Charity Donation

• Bonus for weddings & newborns

• Wallapop Renta (Tax income support)

• Monthly product advantages (Wallapop Club)

• Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises

• Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll

• One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office

• Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable

• 26 holidays per year

• TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows)

What does the hiring process for this position look like? 👀 **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.**
Intro Call - run by talent acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. This usually takes 45-60 minutes.
Expertise Interview - run by the hiring team, focus on the required core skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Case Study Submission - you will be assigned a task to submit within 5 up to 7 days where you will be able to showcase your expertise / technical skills required for the role.
Case study Interview - You will present the case study to showcase your product expertise. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Stakeholder Interview - run by relevant stakeholders reflecting the reality of the context of the role, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Product Lead (Bestplay)
jobs.description:
Job title: Senior Product Manager / Product Lead (Bestplay)
Location: Barcelona, Spain
Employment type: Full-time

About Bluetile

Bluetile makes high-velocity casual and hybrid-casual mobile games, and runs Bestplay, a leading play-to-earn app. Our games have passed 350 million installs worldwide, with several titles regularly in the US top 20 charts. We do it with a team of fewer than 60 people.
We build complete new games in two to four months and ship major features in weeks, not quarters. We use AI across game art, software development, live ops and analytics. Bluetile is part of the Nazara Technologies Group, and we’re entering our next phase of fast growth.

The role

Bestplay is one of the top play-to-earn apps in the world, with millions of downloads and a fast-growing, highly engaged user base, run by a small, efficient team. We’re hiring product leaders, from senior product manager up to director, to be core operators on Bestplay.
You’ll own the execution and results of major product features and domains, with a strong focus on growth, monetisation and live operations. This is a hands-on role: you’ll look at A/B results, configs and tickets yourself.

What you’ll do

• Own product domains end to end: turn high-level roadmap goals into shippable features, and be accountable for their commercial performance and speed of execution

• Move the metrics: track and improve revenue, retention, LTV and conversion through pricing models, rewarded mechanics, UX improvements and constant A/B experiments

• Run live ops and engagement: design and run in-app events, promotions and reward surges that improve D1, D7 and D30 retention and build daily habits

• Own UX quality: design user flows and wireframes in close collaboration with designers and developers

• Cover the whole product in a lean team: contribute to community engagement, player and customer support feedback, data tracking improvements, and anti-hacking and abuse prevention

• Study the market: regularly play competitor and adjacent apps to find mechanics and improvements worth taking

What we’re looking for

• 4+ years of product management in high-volume consumer mobile apps, rewarded platforms or mobile games

• A strong commercial and numbers mindset: confident with conversion funnels, payout and reward margins, A/B test statistics and daily dashboards

• Accountability for business metrics and revenue, not just sprint management

• A hands-on approach: you’re happy to build wireframes, investigate fraud patterns, read user tickets and work directly with engineers

• A good understanding of gamification and retention: streaks, progress bars, reward pacing and the psychology of engagement

• An interest in sustainable consumer app retention and reward economics (this role is not focused on crypto, tokens or NFTs)

We’re open to people from senior product manager up to director level.

Nice to have:

• Experience with offerwalls, rewarded play loops, payout economies or partner tracking

• Exposure to fraud prevention, bot detection or anti-abuse in high-volume consumer apps

How we work

• Autonomy and ownership: we expect a lot of ownership and accountability, and what matters is what you deliver. There are no mandatory office days

• Fast impact: what you want to change in the product one day can ship the next day or the next week

• Hands-on, small team: we have few managers and no layers of coordinators, and everyone stays close to the details

• Flat and organic: we’re a start-up, not a corporate. There are no fixed levels or formal growth meetings, and people who show impact take on more

• High expectations: the flexibility comes with high expectations, and it isn’t the right environment for everyone

jobs.title: Ecommerce Product Manager
jobs.description:
¿Cuál será tu misión?
Buscamos un/a Ecommerce Product Manager que lidere la estrategia y evolución de nuestro producto digital, siendo responsable de identificar oportunidades de mejora, definir prioridades y establecer el roadmap de nuestra plataforma ecommerce.
Tu misión será conectar las necesidades del negocio con las de los usuarios, tomando decisiones basadas en datos, analítica y experimentación para impulsar el crecimiento del ecommerce, mejorar la experiencia de usuario y maximizar los resultados del negocio.
Serás la persona responsable de definir qué debemos mejorar o desarrollar, por qué y con qué prioridad, transformando las oportunidades detectadas en iniciativas y requerimientos claros para los equipos tecnológicos externos, que serán los encargados de su ejecución.
Actuarás como nexo entre los equipos internos, negocio, marketing, IT y los proveedores tecnológicos, asegurando que las prioridades estratégicas se traduzcan correctamente en soluciones y que las iniciativas implementadas respondan a los objetivos definidos.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?
1. Estrategia de producto y roadmap

• Definir y liderar la estrategia de evolución del producto digital y de la plataforma ecommerce, alineándola con los objetivos de negocio.

• Construir y gestionar el roadmap de producto, identificando oportunidades, estableciendo prioridades y definiendo iniciativas a corto, medio y largo plazo.

• Evaluar y priorizar mejoras, funcionalidades y evolutivos en función de su impacto potencial en el negocio y en la experiencia de usuario.

• Analizar tendencias del mercado, comportamiento de los consumidores y movimientos de la competencia para identificar nuevas oportunidades.

2. Product Discovery e identificación de oportunidades

• Detectar oportunidades de mejora en la experiencia de usuario, los procesos de compra y el funcionamiento de la plataforma ecommerce.

• Identificar necesidades y puntos de fricción de los usuarios a través del análisis de datos, feedback y comportamiento de navegación.

• Proponer nuevas funcionalidades, mejoras de producto y optimizaciones de los principales flujos de la web, incluyendo checkout, navegación y conversión.

• Evaluar oportunidades tanto en la web como en el motor ecommerce y otros posibles canales digitales.

3. CRO y optimización

• Definir la estrategia de experimentación y las hipótesis de mejora mediante metodologías de A/B Testing.

• Identificar oportunidades para optimizar la conversión (CRO), mejorar la experiencia de usuario (UX) y reducir fricciones en el funnel de compra.

• Extraer aprendizajes de las pruebas realizadas y utilizarlos para orientar futuras decisiones de producto.

4. Analítica y toma de decisiones basada en datos

• Ser el/la responsable de la estrategia de analítica digital del ecommerce, asegurando que se dispone de los datos necesarios para tomar decisiones.

• Definir y monitorizar los principales KPIs de producto y negocio

• Interpretar los datos y convertirlos en insights accionables para identificar oportunidades y establecer prioridades.

• Supervisar y validar las implementaciones de analítica realizadas por agencias o proveedores externos, asegurando la calidad y fiabilidad de la medición.

5. Priorización y coordinación con proveedores tecnológicos

• Traducir las prioridades estratégicas del roadmap en requerimientos funcionales, iniciativas y un backlog claro y estructurado para los equipos técnicos.

• Definir y documentar las necesidades de producto, asegurando que los proveedores tecnológicos comprenden los objetivos, el alcance y las prioridades de cada iniciativa.

• Actuar como interlocutor/a principal entre negocio, marketing, IT y los proveedores tecnológicos externos.

• Coordinar y supervisar la evolución de la plataforma, haciendo seguimiento de las incidencias y desarrollos y asegurando que se respetan las prioridades definidas.

• Revisar y validar las soluciones implementadas por los proveedores, comprobando que responden a los requerimientos y objetivos de negocio.

¿Qué buscamos?

• 4-5 años de experiencia en roles de Ecommerce Product Manager.

• JavaScript a nivel medio : base de código suficiente para dialogar de tú a tú con desarrolladores y comprender las implicaciones técnicas de cada decisión.

• Dominio avanzado de GA4 y GTM (medición, tagging, dataLayer, depuración).

• Experiencia con Azure DevOps/Jira (gestión de backlog, tableros, flujos de trabajo).

• Capacidad para priorizar en función del impacto de negocio y traducir requisitos entre perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.

Se valorará:

• Conocimientos de metodologías Agile / Scrum.

• Experiencia previa en el sector travel & hospitality.

• Nociones de CRO y de herramientas de analítica de comportamiento (heatmaps, session recordings).

• Familiaridad con HTML/CSS y con motores de reservas hoteleros.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Contrato indefinido a jornada completa (40hs).

• Salario acorde a la posición y responsabilidades (remuneración fija + %variable acorde con un plan de Dirección por Objetivos).

• Horario de entrada y salida flexible.

• Teletrabajo 1 día/semana.

• Horario intensivo los viernes y vísperas de algunos festivos nacionales (9hs a 15hs).

• Posibilidad de aplicar retribución flexible y disfrutar del Club Benefits Sercotel

• Descuentos Family & friends en hoteles Sercotel

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager performance - Monopoly GO!
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Performance Manager to join our MONOPOLY GO! team in our Barcelona (Spain) Hub on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. As a Senior Product Manager within Live Mini Games Performance, you will own the performance and continuous optimization of some of MONOPOLY GO!’s most important live experiences. jobs.title: Product Manager, Referral
jobs.description:
¿Quiénes somos?
Filmin es la plataforma de streaming de referencia para los amantes del cine en España y Portugal. Cine independiente, documentales para entender el mundo, las series más premiadas, grandes clásicos de la historia del cine y un acceso privilegiado a los festivales de cine más importantes del mundo.

Qué buscamos
En Filmin existimos porque el cine nos cambió la vida.
Tenemos un producto en el que el criterio editorial es el protagonista, y que se complementa con nuestra tecnología y con la comunidad a la hora de cualificar y recomendar qué ver.
Creemos que en esa intersección entre cine seleccionado con criterio, el software y la comunidad existen grandes oportunidades para cambiar la vida a más gente.
Buscamos incorporar un rol de Product Manager a quien le apasione encontrar estas oportunidades, liderar una visión que las articule, y lleve a cabo su ejecución de manera alineada con los objetivos que tenemos como negocio.
Si te interesa el product-led growth , las comunidades y el cine, sigue leyendo.

El equipo
Formarás parte de un equipo de Producto que impulsa la evolución de la plataforma en distintas áreas estratégicas. Tu día a día será colaborativo y trabajarás de cerca con:

• Diseño de Producto: transformando insights de usuarios en experiencias simples, intuitivas y atractivas.

• Desarrollo (Frontend, Backend, Mobile, TVs, QA): definiendo y entregando funcionalidades de manera ágil, escalable y de alta calidad.

• Data: fundamentando las decisiones en métricas claras, validación continua y aprendizajes accionables.

• Customer Experience: garantizando que el producto se adapte a las necesidades y expectativas reales de los usuarios.

• Editorial: asegurando la coherencia y relevancia de los contenidos y mensajes dentro del producto.

• Marketing: alineando los lanzamientos con las estrategias de marca, adquisición, recuperación y retención.

• Stakeholders de negocio: manteniendo la visión del producto siempre alineada con los objetivos estratégicos de la compañía.

Nos movemos en un entorno colaborativo, donde la comunicación transparente, la creatividad aplicada y la mejora continua son algunas de las claves del éxito.

Funciones y responsabilidades

• Definir la estrategia de una vertical de producto digital alineada con fuertes objetivos de negocio, priorizando en el roadmap las iniciativas con mayor potencial.

• Construir y lanzar de manera controlada iniciativas dentro de nuestro ecosistema de software, colaborando de cerca con equipos multidisciplinares (diseño, desarrollo, data, CX, editorial, marca, etc).

• Tomar decisiones que aseguren el impacto buscado, analizando métricas de uso y feedback de usuarios para realizar ajustes de alcance y cambios de rumbo.

• Llevar a cabo investigación generativa y evaluativa para detectar oportunidades de crecimiento y validar soluciones en etapas tempranas del desarrollo de producto.

• Liderar la conversación con responsables de diferentes áreas de la compañía para alinear la estrategia de producto con el resto del negocio.

• Desarrollar y mantener relaciones clave con partners, identificando oportunidades de colaboración que aporten valor al producto y negocio.

Requisitos clave
Habilidades y experiencia profesional

• Experiencia previa relevante en gestión de productos digitales, idealmente en sectores y productos relacionados como video/audio on demand, apps móviles, plataformas OTT o modelos de suscripción B2C.

• Background en tecnología. Conocimientos técnicos para entender arquitecturas digitales, trabajar junto a equipos de desarrollo de software, y construir prototipos o hacer aportaciones al código.

• Dominio de los mecanismos para la creación y desarrollo de programas de loyalty, member-get-member o comunidades.

• Enfoque product-led growth . Experiencia definiendo y ejecutando estrategias PLG y loops de crecimiento*.*

• Liderazgo en metodología de producto. Conocimiento de s hape-up, visión crítica de las metodologías ágiles y la inteligencia artificial y flexibilidad para adaptarlas a un entorno diferente.

• Capacidad de trabajar en entornos cross-funcionales. Colaborar con ingeniería, diseño de producto, marketing y growth, data, legal, CX, etc.

La candidatura ideal…

• Comprende el negocio. Capacidad para entender una cuenta de resultados básica y hacer proyecciones de crecimiento.

• Toma decisiones basadas en datos. Uso de evidencias y datos de comportamiento, negocio y producto (con herramientas como Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Tableau, etc) para establecer indicadores clave, objetivos y priorizar iniciativas.

• Disminuye riesgo haciendo experimentos de bajo coste. Experiencia diseñando y evaluando experimentos A/B.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Contrato indefinido

• Rango salarial de 35-45K €

• Modalidad de trabajo híbrido: 3 días en remoto + 2 días presenciales en nuestra oficina de Barcelona

• Horario flexible

• Jornada intensiva durante los meses de verano y cada viernes

• 23 días de vacaciones anuales + Vacaciones Extra (Filmin Days)

• Oportunidades de Formación

• Una bolsa de 1.440 € anuales para utilizar en beneficios flexibles (Seguro Médico, Restaurantes, Transporte…)

• Actividades/Eventos dentro y fuera de la oficina

Description -

Job Summary

As a Data Product Manager, you are obsessed with crafting personalized customer experiences that build upon your knowledge of the data flow across the customer print hardware and HP Smart ecosystems. You will work in a highly cross functional and dynamic environment to develop ways to leverage real-time data to define customer experiences within the products and through personalized communications. Not only will you define the data products to power engaging experiences, but you will also apply your knowledge of artificial intelligence and machine learning to automate and build new insights and capabilities. Key to this role is a core belief that building trust with our customers is critical and demonstrated by understanding the impact of the latest privacy policies on data capture and usage. You have a strong foundation in analytics and experience with collaborating with product management, engineering and marketing teams. Overall, you love how data can drive delightful and engaging customer experiences and are excited to scale it worldwide.

Responsibilities

• Deeply understand HP’s product and services data ecosystem in order to leverage existing capabilities and define new requirements for future experiences

• Balance the strategy, governance, and implementation of anything data related, and facilitate the conversations between all impacted stakeholders - executives, engineers, analysts, product teams, and external customers.

• Collaborate closely with the CRM, product and service teams to define data and functional requirements to deliver personalized experiences across all communication touchpoints.

• Apply your knowledge of AI and ML to define data products, schemas and models to automate customer experiences that can scale.

• Translate the requirements of large data initiatives into smaller, agile based stories that can be delivered in increments and then working to allocate resources for each initiative.

• Define a roadmap that defines the data requirements for new feature development that incorporates the needs of customers and the business.

• Understand the customer’s experience by continually immersing yourself in feedback and sentiment data to map out data personas and consumer profiles.

Education & Experience Recommended

• Data Science or Engineering Degree

• MBA or business degree desired

• Ideally 10+ years of total experience with 5 years of experience in data product marketing/management

Knowledge & Skills

• Expertise in data science, data manipulation visualization and predictive analysis

• Strong foundation in analytics and metrics, and development of data schemas

• Experience in segmentation and targeting strategies across multichannel ecosystem

• Understanding of current data and privacy policies and how it impacts customer engagement strategies

• Working knowledge and experience with semantic / knowledge graph technologies

• Strong organization skills are a must to ensure that all tasks are completed to the appropriate deadline

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us💫.
Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.

The Challenge 🧩
Drive long-term user value and sustainable business growth by shaping and executing the product strategy for some of Wallapop’s most complex, high-impact initiatives. You will leverage data, experimentation, technical collaboration, and deep user empathy to unlock new marketplace opportunities, elevate product craft, and deliver step-function improvements in user experience.

What You Will Do 👇

• Product Strategy & Vision: Define and execute a long-term product roadmap for high-impact marketplace initiatives, aligning product vision with company goals to drive meaningful user and business outcomes.

• End-to-End Delivery & Collaboration: Lead discovery, definition, and delivery across cross-functional squads (engineering, design, analytics, and business operations) to turn complex challenges into simple, delightful user journeys.

• Technical Collaboration: Partner with engineering leadership to ensure product architecture supports long-term scalability, advocating for foundational improvements that support platform stability and experimentation velocity.

• Experimentation & Insights: Combine quantitative analytics, experimentation (A/B testing), and direct user research to validate hypotheses and make high-confidence roadmap decisions.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate strategic trade-offs, roadmap priorities, and vision clearly across executive leadership and cross-functional teams to build alignment and shared momentum.

• Product Craft & Mentorship: Elevate product management standards across the chapter through active coaching, shared best practices, and collaborative knowledge-sharing.

What We’re Looking For 🔎

• Proven track record of defining product strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes (e.g., conversion improvement, user retention, revenue growth, or marketplace liquidity).

• Ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture, API integrations, and data flows, effectively balancing immediate delivery with long-term technical health.

• Competence in utilizing quantitative data, self-serve analytics, and user research to build structured, evidence-based business cases and product roadmaps.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize high-leverage opportunities, and advocate for user-centric product decisions in complex organizational environments.

• Full professional working proficiency in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences. Spanish is a plus.

What Would Be A Plus 🚀

• Experience integrating emerging technologies (such as LLMs or automation tools) into consumer products or internal workflows to improve user experience and team velocity.

• Prior experience in two-sided marketplaces, e-commerce, or consumer tech platforms

Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals.

Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone.
We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package.

Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits :

• Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year

• Free office meals, lunch selection from different providers

• Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day

• Private Health Insurance with Alan

• Flexible working hours + Intensive Fridays

• Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check)

• Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office

• Generous referral Program & Charity Donation

• Bonus for weddings & newborns

• Wallapop Renta (Tax income support)

• Monthly product advantages (Wallapop Club)

• Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises

• Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll

• One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office

• Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable

• 26 holidays per year

• TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows)

What does the hiring process for this position look like? 👀 **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.**
Intro Call - run by talent acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. This usually takes 45-60 minutes.
Hiring manager call: run by the HM to asses basic fit with the role. This usually takes 30-45 minutes.
Case Study preparation - you will be assigned a task to discuss during the case study interview for the role.
Live Case study Interview - run by the hiring team, focus on the required core skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Stakeholder Interview - run by relevant stakeholders reflecting the reality of the context of the role, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes.
Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

About The Role

As a Lead Product Manager at Labhouse , you will be responsible for leading the product end-to-end , working closely with the CEOs to define, build, and scale our apps. Your mission will be to own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution , with a strong focus on driving revenue growth across our portfolio .

You will take full ownership of the product lifecycle — from ideation and validation to launch and optimization — combining strong product intuition, design sensibility, and analytical rigor . This role requires someone highly autonomous, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven , capable of defining KPIs, building dashboards, and making data-informed decisions.

You'll be responsible for:

• Work closely with CEOs to define new app opportunities and build products from scratch.

• Own the product roadmap of live apps, optimizing core features and improving key KPIs.

• Lead product development end-to-end, from ideation to post-launch optimization.

• Drive revenue growth across products through continuous experimentation and iteration.

• Define and implement KPIs, dashboards, and analytics frameworks to track performance.

• Design and optimize user funnels: acquisition, retention, monetization, and virality.

• Gather and structure user feedback and customer support insights to inform product decisions.

• Continuously benchmark competitors and explore innovative approaches to improve product quality and UX.

• Collaborate closely with design, engineering, and marketing teams to deliver high-impact features.

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, prototyping, and decision-making

About You:

Academic background:

• Ideally, with a technical degree (Computer Science, Data, or Telecommunications Engineering), to feel comfortable building dashboards and working hands-on with data.

What Are We Looking For

• Experience building products from 0 to 1 and 1 to 100

• Experience in mobile development, preferably in mobile apps with subscription-based models, F2P games, or consumer products.

• Strong product sense and design intuition, with the ability to create experiences that drive user behavior.

• Hands-on mindset: not just defining product strategy, but personally driving its implementation and execution to grow revenue.

• Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to define KPIs, interpret data, and generate actionable insights.

• Solid analytical foundation: SQL, statistics, experimentation, and product metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, ARPU). Hands-on experience with analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel)

• Strong project management skills, able to prioritize high-impact initiatives, understand trade-offs, and mitigate risks.

• High level of ownership, autonomy, and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Passion for UI/UX and Apple-like product experiences.

• Good level of spoken and written English.

Communication:

• Solid level of spoken and written English.

• Clear, structured communicator who can simplify complex data into product narratives

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

• Experience building products from 0 to 1.

• Experience working closely with founders or in startup environments.

What we Offer:

• The opportunity to work side by side with serial entrepreneurs who've built and exited at the highest level

• A real path to becoming a product leader, mentored directly by the CEO

• A fast-moving, AI-native environment where shipping beats talking

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Advertising
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe , smart , and environmentally responsible .

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX And See How Far You Can Go.

About the role

Advertising is one of OLX's most important revenue lines - and one of its biggest opportunities. Today, our advertising business spans multiple markets, formats, and platforms, but it needs a product leader who can take it to the next level: from foundational ad-tech infrastructure to new revenue surfaces powered by AI.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the global advertising product end-to-end. This means everything from the ad-core stack (serving, auction, targeting, measurement) to growing revenue beyond listings through self-serve advertiser tools, programmatic demand, and retail-media formats. You'll also shape how advertising integrates into AI-native surfaces — balancing monetisation yield against buyer experience.

This is a role for someone who has built advertising products at scale, understands the programmatic ecosystem, and is excited about using AI to create new advertising experiences. You'll work closely with business and commercial stakeholders to grow revenue, while ensuring our advertising never compromises the trust our users place in the platform.

This role reports to the Head of Product.

What You'll Do

• Own the global advertising product end-to-end: ad-core stack (serving, auction, targeting, measurement) across all marketplaces and platforms

• Drive growth of advertising revenue beyond listings, including self-serve advertiser tools, programmatic demand, and retail-media formats such as sponsored listings, native, and video

• Own integration of ads into AI-native surfaces such as AutoIQ and agentic search, balancing yield against buyer experience

• Define and track advertising success metrics: revenue, fill rate, eCPM, advertiser ROI, buyer experience impact

• Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, and Sales teams to build the product capabilities that unlock revenue growth

• Represent the advertising product at the leadership level, presenting strategy and results to executive audiences

What we're looking for

• Significant product management experience in digital advertising, ad-tech, monetisation, or revenue product at scale

• Proven track record of building and scaling advertising products — programmatic ads, third-party ads, billing systems, or ad-serving platforms

• Experience taking advertising or monetisation products from early-stage to meaningful revenue

• Ability to balance monetisation yield with user experience — making evidence-based trade-offs between revenue and buyer trust

• AI-native: you build with AI, not just use it for productivity. You experiment with AI tools outside of work and bring that curiosity into your product craft

• Zero-to-one: you see opportunities, not just optimisations. You spot problems, build prototypes, and ship

• Comfortable with ambiguity: you don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it

• Strong stakeholder management across commercial, engineering, and executive audiences

Preferred

• Experience with retail media, sponsored listings, native advertising, or video ad formats in a marketplace or e-commerce context

• Familiarity with AI-native product surfaces and how advertising integrates with AI experiences

• Multi-market experience across different regulatory and commercial environments

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement .

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Product Owner (MarTech) - Hybrid
jobs.description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Product Owner (MarTech) to join our Marketing Measurement & Data Activation area in Barcelona at eDreams ODIGEO. This role sits at the intersection of Data, Engineering, Analytics, and Media platforms, ensuring that all customer interactions and marketing activities are accurately captured, measured, and compliant with evolving regulations. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

J oin the world's leading travel subscription platform.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – over 7.7 million Prime members since launching in 2017.

More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions

Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What You Will Do

The Role’s Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Performance Marketing Product Owner in the Marketing Measurement & Data Activation Team you will be in charge of:

• Reporting to the Head of Marketing Measurement & Data Activation, you will define the data-enablement roadmap for each media platform (e.g., Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) and measurement partner (e.g., Appsflyer, Google Analytics).

• You will orchestrate, together with a dedicated engineering team, the implementation of web and app tracking, audience creation, and data feeds for marketing campaigns. You will also collaborate closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure our tracking framework remains fully aligned with GDPR and privacy requirements.

• Define and lead the media tracking and data activation agenda — setting priorities, identifying opportunities, and ensuring robust, timely, and future-proof implementations across all channels and platforms.

• Advise marketing teams on technical feasibility and guide them on how new marketing strategies can be operationalized and measured.

• Define specifications for event tracking across web and mobile (Google Analytics, Appsflyer, GTM, SDKs, Data Layers) and coordinate implementation with the dedicated engineering team.

• Build and manage audience segments across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Criteo, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, and additional DSPs.

• Audit existing tracking implementations for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and establish processes for ongoing monitoring and validation.

• Troubleshoot tracking and tagging issues, working closely with development teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.

• Conduct ad-hoc analyses to detect tracking gaps, quantify business impact, and evaluate the value of new or improved tracking implementations.

• Document tracking setups, audience definitions, and compliance decisions to ensure transparency, scalability, and smooth handover.

• Stay current on new products, features, and best practices across media and measurement platforms.

What you need to succeed:

Good to have

• 3+ years of experience in analytics implementation, MarTech, AdTech, or closely related fields.

• Master’s degree in a technical or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Chemistry, etc.).

• Expertise with implementing conversion tracking across marketing platforms (pixel, CAPI, API/Events, Enhanced Conversions or equivalent), as well as audience setup, product/data feed catalogues, conversion windows, and attribution configurations.

• Strong understanding of web and app analytics fundamentals, including event structures, conversion tracking, and data layer design.

• Experience with the tracking and measurement ecosystems of major media platforms, such as Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, Criteo, and others.

• Exceptional attention to detail with a rigorous approach to accuracy and quality. Problem-solving mindset, with strong troubleshooting and QA capabilities. Proactive, fast learner, and naturally curious about data privacy, tracking technologies, and the evolving marketing tech landscape.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.

• Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.

• AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.

• Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.

What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:

• A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

• Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.

• Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.

• Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

• Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun

jobs.title: Senior Product Growth Manager - Remote
jobs.description:
About Zyte

Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.

This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.

Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.

You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.

Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".

What you'll do

Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.

Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.

Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.

Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.

Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. .

Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.

Requirements

• Proven results driving growth and managing funnels in a B2B SaaS or developer-focused business with a self-serve or PLG motion

• A deep curiosity about how engineers work and adopt tools. You've marketed or built for technical audiences and know that developers don't respond to marketing; they respond to products that respect their time

• Experience with developer tools, APIs, data products or technical audiences

• You prototype your own ideas: you use AI coding tools to vibe-code experiments, mockups and working demos rather than waiting for engineering capacity

• A track record of making websites effective engines for capturing demand and driving funnel activity; you've owned conversion, not just traffic

• Demonstrated success in customer growth and nurture: activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion and churn reduction

• Intelligent, practical use of data: comfortable defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting customers and combining product signals with messaging and human outreach

• Experience working as a product owner or growth PM with engineering and design teams: writing clear requirements, prioritising ruthlessly and shipping iteratively

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you can align marketing, product, CS, RevOps and sales around a shared funnel

• 5-8+ years in growth, growth product management or lifecycle/funnel roles

Nice to have

• You've written production code or contributed to open source

• Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), marketing automation and CRM tooling

• Experience building product-led sales (PQL) motions or platform-to-enterprise upgrade paths

How We'll Measure Sucess

Signup-to-activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue and expansion revenue, funnel velocity and the quality of PQLs handed to sales.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

• Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team

• Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work

• Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe

• Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

You will own the end-to-end customer journey, from initial discovery and website engagement to product adoption, paid subscriptions, and account expansion.
