📣 What will you do in the role? We are looking for a Growth Product Owner that will own a portfolio of screens that shapes how some of the largest projects in the world get delivered.
You will have end-to-end ownership, from scope creation to design prototypes that Engineers can directly pick for build. This ownership ensures you can directly express your vision on what problem to solve fast and efficiently. We embrace human direction and accountability with heavy AI tooling - you will work with new ways today, the way everyone else will be working tomorrow.

• Roadmap : Generate 6-week roadmaps based on the 3-month roadmaps given to you by the head of product.

• Own KPIs: Drive feature adoption, deepen engagement, and improve retention and expansion for your portfolio of screens, with clear targets and regular reporting on how your work moves those numbers.

• Test hypotheses and run experiments: Turn insights into clear hypotheses about activation, adoption or retention; design and run small, measurable experiments (A/B tests, copy/layout changes, onboarding tweaks), analyze the impact, and either iterate, scale, or kill ideas based on the data.

• Product Discovery : Watch sales calls, use Mixpanel, Hotjar, talk with customer success and do competitive analysis to generate new feature ideas.

• Elicit requirements : Establish communication with existing customers, build rapport with their users and elicit requirements for both new and existing features.

• Wireframe and User flows : Use Miro to generate user flows for your new features, along with capturing how users use existing tools to solve their problems.

• Suggest new features and success KPIs : Propose new features using data-driven arguments for them, and present it to the Head of Product.

👓 Who you are
• You have 3-5 years of experience in a B2B product management role with direct ownership of growth metrics such as activation, retention, feature adoption, not just delivery dates.

• Proven track record of running growth experiments (A/B tests, multivariate tests, or iterative launches), and using the results to iterate or kill ideas.

• You know when to say no. Protect the team from low-value work and scope creep

• You are able to work with senior Engineers presenting trade-offs e.g scope vs speed of delivering a feature.

• You earn the engineer’s trust in the teams you have worked with.

• You know how to communicate the same thing to different stakeholders: Engineers, Design, Sales, other Product owners.

• You know how to use data to extract conclusions and hypothesis.

• Experience with Perplexity (or similar) where output has helped shape features/capability

• Degree in Computer Science or other STEM background.

💗We would love if you have
• Previous VC-backed start-up experience

• Experience in working with Data Scientists

• You have learned a new technical domain and shipped features to prove it.

• Created wireframes and designs for your features.

• Experience with Cursor or no-code tools (like Lovable)

• Experience with Figma Make, Claude Design, Impeccable or similar

🤝 Who you will work with
• You will report to the Head of Product.

• We are a product centric company so the Product is the connection of multiple functions. Disciplines you will work and communicate with include: Engineers, QA, Design, other Product owners, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales.

• We’re remote-first, but if you miss the smell of whiteboard markers, we’ve got an office for you (Cyprus).

🏄 What if you’re a partial fit? We prioritise grit, positivity, and drive for growth, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.
Bonus : Figure out which part of this job opening was written by an AI and mention it in the interview.

🌌 Location Spain, Germany, Cyprus, Remote

👨‍👩‍👧 We are
• Hard working but not workaholic

• Explorers. Data is our compass and innovation our destination

• Independent thinkers. We are not afraid of looking where no one else is

• Team players. We believe the whole is bigger than the sum of its parts

• We have strong opinions, weakly held

• Continuously evolving the way we do things. Even our #donut dates

Nodes & Links is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

🌴 Benefits Besides a competitive salary, we are also proud to support you with:

• A team of Noders who are second to none. Yep — the team is that good 🚀

• Equity in Nodes & Links — we are all in this together ✊

• One of the best health insurances out there (international coverage) ⚕️

• Remote work budget, to build your perfect set up (€500 year 1 + €100 year 2) 🏠

• Personal development budget, to keep growing (€1,000 pa) 📔

• Enhanced pension/providence fund (CY) (6% company contribution) 📈

• Annual #workation trip, to work and have fun with your teammates. We've been to Budapest, Crete, Aegina (x2) 💃🏻

• Wedding/Civil Partnerships additional leave of 3 days on us ❤️

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

The opportunity

• Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

• Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

• Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

• Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

• Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

• Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

• Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

• Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

What You Bring

• You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

• Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

• Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

• Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

• Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

• Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

Nice to haves

• Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

• Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

• Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Campaign Pages
jobs.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

A great campaign page doesn’t just tell a story. It turns a visitor into a donor.

Campaign Pages are where nonprofits launch campaigns, tell their stories and convert donors before checkout. They sit close to revenue, next to Checkout Modal and Elements in our Pre-Donation Experience. You will be the one person accountable for the Campaign Pages roadmap, quality and delivery. Your job is to make the product scalable, ready for enterprise customers and a clear driver of revenue, while traffic keeps growing and the product stays stable.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Campaign Pages strategy and a 6–12 month roadmap aligned with Product and Pre-Donation Experience priorities, and explain the reasoning behind decisions to leadership and stakeholders.

• Run continuous discovery using customer, GTM, Support, funnel and competitive signals. Separate one-off requests from systemic opportunities and validate problems before anything gets built.

• Drive delivery end to end with a dedicated Engineering Team Lead, Product Designer and Product Analyst: clear PRDs and edge cases, a backlog that is ready 2–3 sprints ahead, and launches with proper instrumentation.

• Own product health and enterprise readiness, covering conversion, page performance, reliability, publishing issues and support volume. Resolve deal-breakers and churn-risk requests within agreed SLAs.

• Partner with PM Growth on experiments, personalisation and ARPV initiatives. Prioritise incoming hypotheses against your own product data, and carry winning learnings across Checkout, Elements and Campaign Pages.

• Keep Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Support and adjacent PMs aligned. Coordinate dependencies with Platform, Checkout, Gift Cart, Billing and Integrations when work touches shared systems.

• Make sure GTM, Support and CSMs know what is shipping, why it matters and how to explain it to customers.

• At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research synthesis, spec drafting, analysis and communication, with your assumptions and sources made explicit.

Skills And Qualifications

• 5+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS, fundraising, marketing technology, e-commerce or conversion-focused products.

• Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: roadmap, discovery, execution, launch and measurement.

• Strong delivery discipline: you write clear specs, cover edge cases and keep Engineering unblocked.

• Analytical rigour: you use funnels, metrics, support signals and qualitative feedback to prioritise.

• Systems thinking: you can see how a surface connects to checkout, payments, analytics, integrations and GTM workflows.

• A working understanding of growth and experimentation: how hypotheses are generated, prioritised and measured.

• Strong UX sensibility and a good working partnership with Design.

• Hands-on, everyday AI use in product work.

• Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

• Experience with landing pages, campaign or website builders, CMS, donation or checkout flows.

• Hands-on experimentation, personalisation or conversion-optimisation work, including converting paid traffic after it reaches the landing page.

• Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, payments or marketing operations.

• Experience handling enterprise customer requests and GTM escalations.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Own outcomes, not tasks, and don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

• Can hold a wide context and still move quickly.

• Say no to a loud request when the data says something else matters more, and can explain why.

• Care as much about stability as about the next shiny experiment.

• Give and ask for candid feedback without ego.

• Get energy from aligning several teams around one shared goal.

• Keep sharpening your AI workflow because you want to, not because you were told to.

• Want your work to translate directly into more money reaching nonprofits.

Please note that final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Gross Total Compensation

€5.600—€6.100 EUR

Perks & Benefits

• 23 days of vacation, 14 public holidays, and 5 fully paid sick days.

• Private health insurance for you and your family.

• Mental health support with therapy sessions for you and your partner.

• Sports reimbursement to help you stay active and feel your best.

• Fully remote work.

• Generous home office stipend to set up a comfortable, productive workspace.

• Coworking reimbursement for days when you'd rather work alongside other people.

• Annual professional development stipend to support your growth.

• English learning programs to help you communicate with confidence across our global team.

• Charitable giving program with company matching for your donations to registered non-profits.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

• Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.***

jobs.title: Growth manager
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
• Understand. Build deep knowledge of your product, its business model, and the key levers driving growth.

• Analyze. Use AI, automation, and advanced analytics to explore high-performing campaigns, identify patterns in user and product data, and generate actionable insights.

• Ideate. Turn insights, experiment results, competitor research, and AI-assisted exploration into hypotheses and identify opportunities to improve growth and monetization.

• Test. Design and run rigorous experiments with real users, partnering closely with designers, engineers, and analysts to bring ideas to life and iterate quickly based on results.

• Scale. Roll out winning ideas broadly, and use learnings from each experiment to shape the next cycle of discovery and testing.

What we look for
• Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.

• Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.

• Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.

• Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
• Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.

• An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.

• All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.

• Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Sobre Nosotros

En Homeclub, gestionamos más de 1.500 apartamentos completamente equipados, decorados profesionalmente y diseñados pensando en la comodidad y el estilo de vida de nuestros clientes. Comenzamos en España y actualmente estamos expandiéndonos a Estados Unidos y Latinoamérica.
Creemos en un mundo lleno de posibilidades, donde la ubicación es flexible y la vivienda no limita tus opciones. Únete a nosotros y forma parte de nuestra misión de redefinir el mercado de alquiler, llevando nuestra visión desde Madrid al resto del mundo.

Nuestra cultura

En Homeclub, promovemos una cultura que valora el aprendizaje continuo y el crecimiento personal, empoderando a cada miembro del equipo para que comparta nuevas ideas y asuma el control de su desarrollo profesional.
Nuestro modelo de trabajo híbrido se adapta a las necesidades individuales, y creemos en la importancia de celebrar juntos, ya sea a través de eventos después del trabajo o reconociendo cada logro, grande o pequeño.

Lo que harás

• Ser dueño del canal digital y de sus resultados: definirás los KPIs con el director de cada área afectada y, contribuirás, con las áreas que los poseen, a la retención de propietarios y a las extensiones de estancia.

• Construir una sola hoja de ruta: recogerás los problemas y objetivos de cada director de área, priorizarás por impacto en esos KPIs y explicarás qué entra, qué no y por qué.

• Hacer visible el cambio en tus primeros 90 días: desde las primeras semanas lanzarás quick wins, lo que hoy más frena a huéspedes y propietarios y se arregla rápido, y a la vez fijas el punto de partida de los KPIs.

• Gestionar el producto en producción: vigilarás la salud del producto (disponibilidad, errores, embudo de conversión), priorizarás los bugs, planificarás releases y versiones de la app, seguirás la valoración en las tiendas y el feedback de los usuarios, mantendrás la documentación y retirarás lo que no se usa.

• Poner el listón de la experiencia: tú decides qué problema resuelve cada recorrido y qué nivel tiene que alcanzar para salir. Antes de construir, hablarás con huéspedes y propietarios, les verás usar el producto, mirarás los datos y validarás con usuarios reales.

• Liderar al Product Owner y trabajar con ingeniería. Te encargarás de decidir qué se construye, por qué y con qué nivel de experiencia, y respondes del KPI. Con el Product Owner conviertes esas decisiones en backlog y las llevas a producción junto a Diseño.

• Llevar la IA al producto: con el equipo de AI & Transformation, decides dónde se aporta valor real al canal y la lanzarás de forma responsable y transparente.

Acerca de ti

• Experiencia de al menos 4 años en producto digital, habiendo sido dueño de un producto o canal de cara a cliente desde negocio.

• Criterio de experiencia de uso. Has hecho research con usuarios, has decidido con prototipos y te manejas en Figma lo suficiente para proponer, no solo para comentar.

• Criterio con datos. Lees un embudo, defines KPIs, haces tus propias consultas y distingues una correlación de un efecto.

• Gestión de stakeholders.

• Español nativo e inglés profesional.

¿Por qué nosotros?

• Una oficina encantadora en el centro de Madrid.

• Un entorno de trabajo internacional; ¡contamos con más de 18 nacionalidades!

• En tu cumpleaños, te ofrecemos medio día libre.

• Cultura de autonomía, innovación, formación y feedback.

• Un ambiente de trabajo flexible y dinámico.

• Bebidas gratis: siempre tenemos té y café.

• Eventos after-work y una cultura interna increíble.

• Oportunidades de crecimiento interno.

• Descuentos en tiendas asociadas.

• Descuentos en nuestras propiedades para ti y tu familia.

________________________________________________________________

En Homeclub, creemos en crear un ambiente de trabajo positivo e inclusivo que empodere a nuestros miembros del equipo para tener éxito. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades laborales, sin importar raza, color, ascendencia, religión, sexo, origen nacional, orientación sexual, edad, ciudadanía, estado civil, discapacidad, género, identidad de género o expresión, o estatus de veterano. Nos esforzamos por ser un lugar de trabajo con más igualdad de oportunidades.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe , smart , and environmentally responsible .

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

About The Role

Join OLX and see how far you can go.

We are a large-scale consumer marketplace building AI-native product experiences across multiple markets. Trust and Safety is not a defensive function here - it is a strategic growth lever. A platform users trust converts better, retains longer, and earns stronger word of mouth. Fraud, abuse, and bad actors actively destroy the value we create; eliminating them is product work at its core.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the Trust & Safety product agenda end-to-end. You will define the strategy for how we detect and prevent fraud, protect user integrity, and keep our marketplace safe - while building systems that are intelligent, proportionate, and do not create friction for the millions of legitimate users who rely on us every day. AI is central to how you will do this: not as an add-on, but as the foundation of a new generation of proactive, signal-driven safety infrastructure.

This role can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland.

What You Will Do

• Own the Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap translating business risk and user insight into a clear, prioritised plan.

• Shift the function from reactive incident response to proactive, intelligence-driven fraud prevention: build the Risk Engine, data signals intelligence, anomaly detection, and investigation tooling that make this possible.

• Ship AI-native T&S product experiences: partner with Data Science and Engineering to design, prototype, and productionise real-time detection and decisioning systems using ML models, LLMs, and behavioural signals.

• Balance fraud mitigation with growth protection—ensuring T&S interventions do not unnecessarily create friction for legitimate users or throttle marketplace supply/demand. Make hard, evidence-based trade-off decisions.

• Define and track the right T&S success metrics: fraud loss rates, false positive/negative rates, time-to-resolution, user trust scores, and financial exposure. Communicate impact in business terms to senior leadership.

• Partner closely with Engineering leads, Data Science, Legal, Compliance, and Operations—holding shared accountability for outcomes and navigating competing priorities.

• Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities to measure fraud rates, detection model performance, and contributor/user impact at scale.

• Establish business cases quantifying fraud losses and ROI of prevention investments; secure resources and drive prioritisation grounded in data.

• Ensure products and strategies meet local and regional compliance, legal, and security requirements across all markets.

• Apply AI to how you operate as a PM: faster threat analysis, synthetic user research on abuse patterns, AI-assisted spec writing, automated experimentation pipelines—whatever moves the needle on velocity.

• Represent Trust & Safety at the leadership level, presenting strategy, risk posture, and results clearly to executive audiences.

What We Are Looking For

• Significant product management experience in the digital sector: consumer facing platform, marketplace, mobility, e-commerce, classifieds, fintech, or similar high scale environment.

• Proven experience owning trust related products or problem spaces such as Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Risk, Identity & Verification, Marketplace Integrity, Account Security, Abuse Prevention, Payments Risk, or Compliance Technology.

• Track record of building scalable systems that proactively detect, prevent, and mitigate abuse, fraud, risk, or other trust related issues, rather than relying solely on manual or operational processes.

• Strong analytical and data driven mindset, with experience defining success metrics, evaluating impact, and making prioritization decisions based on evidence and measurable outcomes.

• Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex products in regulated or high-risk environments. Experience in vendor management and collaboration.

• Experience building, deploying, or working closely with machine learning, AI, risk scoring, decisioning, detection, recommendation, or automation systems. Hands-on experience with AI-powered trust or fraud products is a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to balance user experience, marketplace growth, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation, making thoughtful trade offs that protect both users and the business.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking ownership of complex problem spaces, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving strategy and execution across multiple teams.

• Strong core product muscle that transfers across fraud domains—you've stepped into unfamiliar threat vectors, oriented fast, and delivered. Domain specificity matters; rigid domain lock-in does not.

• Well versed in building, iterating core Data (Science) products at scale

Nice To Have

• Experience building trust, risk, fraud, or safety products across multiple international markets and regulatory environments.

• Familiarity with emerging regulations and industry trends affecting online platforms, digital marketplaces, payments, AI, and consumer trust.

If you're excited by the opportunity to solve complex trust challenges at scale and build products that make a meaningful difference to millions of users, we'd love to hear from you. This is a role for someone who enjoys tackling ambiguous problems, partnering across disciplines, and shaping the future of trust in a modern, AI-powered marketplace.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

jobs.title: Product Lead - Portfolio Midcore Games
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is fully remote as long as you can work within CET ±5h CET.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining the Midcore team from Live Studios. Our main mission is converting hypercasual titles into deep midcore games. The studio is also working on Ball Blast , Sniper Siege , Epic Plane , Gear Fight , Archery Clash , Path of Kings & Monster Survivors .

Role

As Product Lead, you will be one of the key product leaders of the studio, working closely with the Studio Director, Creative Director and the Production team to shape and execute the product vision for the game.

You Will

• Define and refine the product strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the studio team.

• Own prioritization and planning across key product areas (core gameplay improvements, meta progression, monetization, LiveOps).

• Create clear product specifications for new features, improvements, systems and experiments.

• Build and manage the A/B testing roadmap and ensure data-driven decision making.

• Work closely with Game Design on progression, economy, balancing, competitive systems, player goals and long-term motivation.

• Collaborate with the Creative Director to ensure that product direction supports both the gameplay vision and business objectives.

• Partner with Analytics to monitor performance, understand player segments, diagnose problems and identify growth opportunities.

• Act as a decisive product leader with a General Manager mindset, taking ownership of product, business and team-level decisions.

• Balance strategic vision with hands-on execution.

Profile

• 5+ years of experience in product management or lead game design roles within the mobile gaming industry.

• Proven experience scaling mobile games, launching major features or improving key KPIs is a strong plus.

• Experience with action, PvP, competitive or skill-based games is highly valued.

• Hands-on game design experience (especially around progression, economy, balancing, or player motivation), would be a significant advantage.

• Strong experience working on live mobile games, ideally with midcore or hybrid-casual-to-midcore products.

• Deep understanding of F2P game loops.

• Proven track record of owning product strategy, roadmap, prioritization and feature delivery for successful mobile games.

• Strong hands-on approach with the ability to balance strategic thinking and day-to-day execution.

• Excellent analytical skills and strong experience making data-driven decisions.

• Experience defining and running A/B tests, interpreting results and translating insights into product decisions.

• AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence, align and convince stakeholders.

• Strong ownership, high energy, collaborative mindset and ability to handle broad responsibilities beyond a narrow product scope.

• Fluent in English.

Benefits

• Best-in-class compensation

• Other benefits according to the country you reside

jobs.title: Product Manager (PM) - AI x EdTech - French fluent 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
This Isn’t Another Product Job.

It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

A chance to build an AI-native Product Department

You’ll be working with the most complex data in the world : the human mind.

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

• 🚀Ambition around AI field : Smart teammates driven to create an iconic, international product

• 🔥Impact : you strive to make a real difference in the company's growth, and not be a number in a big organization

• 😍Mission : knowing your greatness left a mark in people's lives, through technology and behavioral science

At Paradox, we believe that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

• Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

• Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

• Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS .

This is why we are looking for a PM to make Paradox a category-defining global brand loved for its product.

This is a full-time position from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Paris or Lisbon or remotely anywhere in the world.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox , we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them , one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently , and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.

It can translate insight into transformation , through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding .

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche - a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

OUR AI-NATIVE AMBITION 🤖

We want to build an AI-native company, with agents in every department doing the work alongside our people.

In product, that means building a self-learning AI for product management: a system that learns from every user signal, experiment and release, and gets sharper at deciding what to build next.

For our clients, it means a self-learning AI that serves them through psychology and coaching, and gets better at helping each person change with every interaction.

You won’t just use AI tools: you’ll help design the agents, loops and feedback systems that make Paradox learn faster than anyone else.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

As Product Manager , you’ll be the architect of a new category , transforming growth into a living ecosystem powered by AI, behavioral science, and design .

You won’t just build features, you’ll craft experiences that rewire behavior .

You’re the architect bringing clarity between vision and execution, the person who turns “we should build this” into “it’s live, here’s the data and tangible impact.”

Every product cycle you lead will integrate:

• Protocols : guided frameworks grounded in psychology that rewire perception, emotion, and action.

• Pods : human connection, accountability, and shared rituals.

• Loops : adaptive, AI-powered coaching cycles that evolve with each user.

• Personalization : experiences that feel uniquely theirs, every time.

Going from a successful personal brand, to an international tech-driven iconic brand, is far from easy. It will be messy, chaotic - requiring constant iterations on MVPs and innovation in tech. Therefore to achieve this here are :

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

• Make AI-native a way of building the company

• Translate the founder’s strategic vision into a clear product strategy.

• Build and maintain the roadmap that connects business goals, user outcomes, and technological innovation.

• Ensure every feature supports the evolution of the Paradox ecosystem: Loops, PX Agents, Protocols, Membership.

• User Understanding & Behavioral Insight

• Be obsessed with user problems : talk to users weekly, analyze patterns, and identify where transformation breaks.

• Turn insights from behavioral science, coaching psychology, and learning design into actionable product hypotheses.

• Design loops, feedback, and rituals that make growth tangible.

• build for both the heart (inspiration) and the brain (structure).

• Build, Ship, Learn Fast, create AI Loops

• Apply Lean Startup methodology and scientific thinking to validate ideas through MVPs, not opinions.

• Design experiments and measurable success metrics before building.

• Iterate on a weekly basis on new hypothesis

• AI Native Product Analytics & Impact Measurement

• Define and track product success metrics (activation, retention, transformation rates).

• Connect data to business KPIs, know how your product drives lifetime value, not just engagement.

• We don’t track metrics just for internal dashboards, we track them also to prove transformation.

• Help marketing leverage this data to fuel authentic, evidence-based storytelling — showing the world what real transformation looks like.

• Blend emotions (“open the heart of people”) with precision (“build loops, scoring, protocols”).

• Create a visceral experience that translates into emotions of inspiration, awe from users.

• Use a Science-backed, Cinematic, Contrarian style : Every product touchpoint should be grounded in behavioral science, expressed with cinematic beauty, and challenge conventions

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE 😍

Experience :

• 3–6 years as a Product Manager / Product Owner in EdTech, SaaS, or Consumer Tech.

• Bonus: experience in AI-driven products, learning design, or personal development platforms.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Healthcare Marketplace & AI
jobs.description:
Barcelona, Spain | Product Management Opportunity

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group is looking for a Senior Product Manager – AI-Powered Marketplace to join a fast-growing European technology company building an AI-powered workforce platform for the healthcare sector.

The company's core marketplace enables hospitals and healthcare organizations to cover workforce needs through verified professionals, while AI already supports operational workflows such as matching, shift recommendations, support automation, and candidate interactions.

About The Role

You will own a core multi-sided marketplace product end to end, working closely with company leadership and the marketplace business team.

This is a hands-on product role focused on outcomes rather than delivery management. You will work directly with users and enterprise customers, understand marketplace dynamics in depth, and design product and AI-driven solutions that reduce manual coordination across operational workflows.

The ideal candidate has already built and deployed AI agents in real production environments and understands how to use automation responsibly within operational processes.

Key Responsibilities

• Own a core marketplace product end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.

• Work directly with healthcare professionals, enterprise customers, and internal operational teams.

• Analyze supply, demand, liquidity, matching, incentives, and trust across a multi-sided marketplace.

• Identify operational workflows that can be improved or automated through AI.

• Design and deploy AI agents that reduce manual coordination and improve marketplace efficiency.

• Define product priorities based on user behavior, operational data, and measurable business outcomes.

• Partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders.

• Conduct direct user research and field visits when needed.

• Measure product performance and continuously improve marketplace outcomes.

• Operate with high autonomy in a small, founder-led product organization.

Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of Product Management experience working on marketplaces, platforms, or multi-sided products.

• Strong understanding of marketplace concepts including supply, demand, liquidity, matching, incentives, and trust.

• Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents into real operational workflows.

• Experience working directly and regularly with users and enterprise customers.

• Comfort conducting field research and translating operational problems into product solutions.

• Ability to own outcomes rather than simply manage tickets, roadmaps, or delivery processes.

• Strong analytical and product judgment.

• Ability to work effectively in a small, fast-moving organization with significant ownership.

• Fluent Spanish.

Particularly Relevant Experience

• Marketplaces involving supply-and-demand matching.

• Workforce, staffing, mobility, delivery, logistics, or similar operational platforms.

• AI agents used to automate real business processes.

• Products involving scheduling, matching, incentives, or operational coordination.

• High-growth technology companies with small product teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is best suited to a product leader who wants to stay close to users, data, engineering, and operational reality.

You should be comfortable making product decisions directly, testing them with users, and measuring their impact rather than operating primarily as a project coordinator or delivery manager.

Practical AI experience is important. The company is specifically looking for someone who has already put AI agents into production workflows and can discuss what worked, what failed, and how human oversight and product safeguards were handled.

Compensation

• Base salary between €70,000 and €100,000 gross annually, depending on experience.

• Equity participation.

Work Arrangement

This opportunity is based in Barcelona, Spain .

The exact on-site versus hybrid working arrangement is still being confirmed. Candidates should therefore consider this a Barcelona-based role rather than a remote-first opportunity.

Application

If your background aligns with this opportunity, please submit your application through this same channel .

Please include:

• Your updated CV or resume.

• Your gross annual compensation expectations in EUR.

• A brief example of an AI agent or AI-enabled operational workflow you have personally helped launch into production.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

In this role, you will

• Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.

• Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.

• Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.

• Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.

• Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.

• Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

Background & Experience

What you need to be successful

• 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.

• High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.

• Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

Technical & Domain Skills

• Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.

• Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.

• Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.

• Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

Traits

• Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.

• Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.

• Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

What’s In It For You

• Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.

• Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.

• A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.

• An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who We Are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

Equal Opportunities

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

jobs.title: AI Solution Product Owner
jobs.description:
• Location: Barcelona

About The Job

Sanofi is an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across over 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccines to protect millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

Digital is driving Sanofi's ambition to become the first biopharma powered by AI at scale - accelerating how we discover, develop, and deliver breakthrough medicines and vaccines. Sanofi is rebuilding how it works with customers, suppliers, and colleagues, and AI and data are at the center of that transformation. As part of M&S Digital, you will build the products and platforms that make Manufacturing & Supply faster, leaner, and smarter, so medicines reach patients sooner.

About This Product

You will lead flagship Data and AI products that may range from topics such as AI for inspection readiness, agentic supply chain, and lab automation - taking them from the first idea through to scaled adoption across Manufacturing & Supply.

Your users are the global teams working in quality to make sure patients have the most reliable product; the scientists working on the shopfloor who make our medicines and constantly improve efficiency to make sure we have enough product to deliver into the hands of patients; and the supply chain teams who are looking to fundamentally reinvent our delivery chain, reduce lead time, and secure supply.

Your job is to give them capabilities that can scale and create meaningful impact: products that turn world-class AI and data into everyday working tools for the people who make our medicines.

Mains Responsibilities

Own flagship products and their impact

• You are a proven product builder: you have taken products to production before, and you will do it again here. You are accountable for end-to-end product outcomes that create user and business value, from ideation to deployment and scaled adoption across Sanofi.

Contribute to product vision and validate priorities

• Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements: collect user needs and translate them into a prioritized backlog, with a clear what and why for every feature

• Analyze market trends, data, and user preferences to predict future product performance and demand, have clear understanding of the product moat for your own product, and chart the path to strengthen it

Run delivery with your pod

• Own and maintain the product backlog for your scope; prioritize based on value, learning, feasibility, and dependencies

• Co-create solutions with the tech lead. Work with developers through Jira and Confluence, define sprint goals aligned with desired outcomes, and run agile ceremonies.

• Protect delivery focus by clarifying priorities and sequencing work effectively

Engage stakeholders transparently and constructively

• You build trust and alignment through clear communication and evidence-based discussion

• Discuss findings, business value, and scientific or operational risk credibly with senior leaders

• Align business expectations with product direction, and navigate a complex, process-heavy organization constructively

Improve operational efficiency and ways of working

• Increase developer velocity, shorten time-to-production, and make operations more efficient across M&S Digital's engineering ecosystem

• Promote agile product practices, identify opportunities to improve collaboration and delivery flow, and support a culture of learning, experimentation, and customer-centricity

• Contribute to a high-performance, inclusive team culture

Responsible AI

• Ensure the execution of AI Governance tasks and compliance with controls throughout the AI system lifecycle, including validation and post-deployment monitoring

• Meet all applicable quality, regulatory (Data Privacy, GxP), and cybersecurity requirements

• Maintain adherence to these standards across all AI products in your scope

About You

Experience and domain

• You have demonstrated experience delivering products before - this is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. You have personally taken at least one product from concept to a deployed capability that real users rely on.

• 5+ years in product, data science, applied science, or a technical product role with Progressively broader scope, with a consistent record of shipping rather than prototyping

• A background in tech, biotech, pharma or a related industry, with a strong understanding of life sciences, AI, or both

• Strong product sense and a point of view of your own. You bring ideas, not just execute

AI and technical depth

• You have demonstrated experience shipping AI into production: AI you built or led is live in the hands of users in a high-priority business use case - not a proof of concept, a deck, or a sandbox

• You are an AI builder, not just an AI user: you prototype with LLMs and agent tools yourself and hold your team to the same standard

• You can engage deeply with data scientists and engineers on method, architecture, and trade-offs, and you bring technical curiosity and a solid understanding of data and AI concepts

First-principles thinking

• You bring original thinking grounded in facts and science

• You can frame complex problems in a solvable way and bring clarity

Execution and builder mentality

• Clear priorities, disciplined product thinking, and a bias toward action in complex, ambiguous environments

• Strong attention to detail, and focus when executives, users, peers, and developers all want something at once

Influence and business fluency

• You have directed or coordinated technical teams - developers, designers, business stakeholders - and earn trust through technical credibility

• You can discuss findings, business value, and scientific or operational risk with senior leaders, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences

• You navigate complex, process-heavy organizations and align product strategy to business needs

User focus

• A real desire to ask open-ended questions and find the root cause of user pain

• Knowledge of user experience design tools and techniques, and you use them to design, build, and refine products that are positively perceived and accessible to all users

Mindset

• Comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy; the scope of the role will be shaped in part by you

• Adaptability and an innovation mindset: you pivot quickly based on feedback and champion new approaches

• Mission-driven: you care about getting medicines to patients faster.

Language

• Fluent in English

Pursue Progress . Discover Extraordinary .

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Preply is an AI-native company, and the AI Platform is the foundation that underpins all of our AI initiatives. We’re building it to power AI product features for learning and the marketplace, personalising the experience for our tutors and learners, and to be the single place for teams at Preply to build agentic systems and workflows. It will be pivotal in helping Preply move fast, automate and scale.

As the first product manager on the AI Platform, you’ll define the mission, vision and strategy across traditional ML, LLM and agentic systems. This is a new, greenfield role: a great opportunity to make a product impact on a foundational platform. You’ll make sure we build safely and responsibly, with the platform setting the standards, governance and guardrails for how Preply builds with AI.

The role focuses on building the product roadmap with multiple engineering teams, helping other product teams build faster, and measuring the platform’s impact on how fast Preply builds, automates and scales with AI.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define the mission, vision, strategy, and product roadmap for the AI platform across traditional ML, LLM, and agentic systems, working with multiple engineering teams

• Increase the return on investment in ML and LLMs, and set the direction for building and scaling agents across internal and external workflows

• Provide product teams with a trusted foundation to build, learn, and ship AI safely at scale

• Implement safeguards and controls, including standards, governance, and guardrails for building, to ensure safe shipping

• Reduce the cost of building and running AI across the company

• Demonstrate and increase the ROI of AI investments, showing impact on business metrics and delivering platform metrics around speed, safety, activity, and cost

• Collaborate with engineering managers and the engineering, data, and product chapters to identify opportunities and pain points, and understand the experience of teams building on the platform

What You Need To Succeed

• Technical platform experience across ML, GenAI, and agentic platforms, including gateways, models, tools, memory, governance, and security

• Ability to set the direction for how agents are built and scaled across internal and external workflows

• Experience shipping AI and ML systems from a product, technical, or engineering background

• Excellent product sense in the fast-changing AI domain, with a drive to do product work, not just building

• Leading AI fluency, using AI to transform personal work and helping others do the same

• Proven ability to influence and align senior engineering, data, and business stakeholders, with credibility among data and engineering teams

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience in platform, AI, or ML engineering before moving into product

• Experience in tech or AI-native businesses, such as e-commerce, fintech, or B2B SaaS with critical AI features

Why you will love it at Preply

• An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com

jobs.title: Product Manager - B2B SaaS
jobs.description:
One of our clients in the foodtech industry is looking for a Product Manager with 3 + years of experience.

💰Salary 40-60k
📍 Hybrid in Barcelona (at least two days per week at our office in Poblenou)
🏝️ Vacation & perks : All AI tooling that you wish to experiment with, a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, flexible working hours, a bright modern office, PayFlow, and many more (see below)

Check out their job description below:

We are the market leader solution for point of control in restaurants, handling all back-office vital operations like product management, inventories, purchases, price tracking, document conciliation, bank conciliation, paychecks, clocking in/out, P&L reports, etc.

Not only we have a system of record that helps operate restaurants with control and clarity, but we are also the leaders in offering AI Agents, starting with Fina. They work 24/7 doing the heavy, tedious work that our customers don't have time to do well.

This is no AI hype. Our customers obtain visible value from our AI Agents, both in money and time saved. We are becoming strategic partners in the design of their businesses.

👉 Our mission is to empower millions of restaurateurs to level up their business.
👉 Our vision is to lead the market through innovation, strong relationships and by becoming the go-to tech partner for restaurant success.

👀 We are backed by Y Combinator, the accelerator behind Airbnb and Twitch. We are growing fast with support from top-tier investors like JME, Decelera, Extension Fund, Wayra, and Zone2Boost.

➡️ Why are we hiring?

We are hiring because our ambitions are increasing: more customers, more AI automation, and a relentless focus on delivering value at scale.

Here, a PM is an uncertainty resolver who bridges the gap between complex AI technology and real-world restaurant needs. As we scale, we are looking for someone who has already lived the operational challenges, metrics, and business dynamics of a B2B SaaS. We need a creative PM with exceptional judgment to lead large initiatives independently and maintain a direct pulse on our customers.

If you’re excited by full ownership and building an AI-native product before we fully evolve from startup to scale-up, this is the right moment to join.

➡️ About our Product Managers

Here, we don't believe in "feature factories." As a PM here, you are the DRI (Directly Responsible Individual) for your area.

• You won’t be writing specs: Our Product Engineers own the technical specs and execution. You will focus on the "Why" and the "What." You’ll talk to customers, look at the data, and collaborate with engineers to decide what not to build.

• Prototyping is your superpower: We favor action. You’ll spend a significant part of your time prototyping and validating ideas (think Peter Yang: idea in the morning, prototype at noon, customer validation by lunch).

• AI-native mindset: You don't just "add AI" to a feature; you rethink user flows assuming AI is the core engine. You are the brain that shapes the AI’s output with criteria and context.

• Customer Proximity: Many of our restaurants are based right here in Barcelona. You’ll be just a step away from the people using what you build.

➡️ About how we create product

• Shape the Team: We are currently a small, focused team (Ingrid, Gemma and Andrea). You will have the unique opportunity to help shape the Product organization from the ground up.

• Radical Simplicity: We favor a single way of doing things to avoid over-engineering. We prioritize simple solutions and proven patterns over unnecessary complexity.

• High Ownership: We work as DRIs. While engineers own the stability and execution, you own the discovery and the ultimate success of the initiative.

• Agile Execution: We apply a Lean model (prototype, launch, learn). A 3-day prototype in Figma, Magicpath, or NoCode tools delivers more value to us than a 3-week spec.

➡️ What You’ll Do

• Strategy & Vision: Align product discovery with business goals, making data-driven and user-centered decisions.

• Fast Iteration: Prioritize solutions into small, actionable releases. You will ideate, prototype, launch, and repeat until the problem is solved.

• Direct Customer Feedback: Join customer meetings and dive into their workflows to ensure we are moving the needle.

• AI Orchestration: Define how our AI agents interact with our systems, starting small and scaling based on real-world observation.

• Full Ownership: Responsible for the entire lifecycle of an initiative—from the first "Why" to monitoring its adoption and impact.

• Lead the Bar: Demand excellence in the user experience. You will ensure we ship fast without compromising the core value of the product.

Example objectives for your first months:

• Group Vision Discovery: Lead the discovery for our "Restaurant Groups" vision to drive growth in Weekly Active Users (WAU).

• Kickstart Major Initiatives: Launch large-scale initiatives like "Orders" alongside engineering, proposing iterative solutions to solve complex problems fast.

➡️ What You Need To Bring

• 3-5 years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS: You know what it takes to drive adoption, retain business customers, and build intuitive workflows for complex B2B systems.

• Hunger & Curiosity: A natural drive to learn and experiment with cutting-edge AI models and tools. You are an early adopter by nature.

• Great Judgment: The ability to discard most ideas and choose only what aligns strictly with company objectives.

• Customer Love: A genuine passion for understanding what users actually need (and why they need it).

• Proactivity: We expect bottom-up action. Don't wait for a roadmap; if the product needs a change to provide value, make it happen.

• Problem-solving: A mix of analytical/data skills and design/UX intuition. You care about the "How it looks" as much as the "How it performs."

➡️ Why Join Us?

We are building something ambitious. This is a chance to leave your mark on an industry ripe for transformation. You’ll join a team where you have a real seat at the table in defining our product culture.
Our best perk is our environment: we empower the entire organization to be 10x more productive through AI. What a time to be alive!

➡️ What we offer?

• 💸 Salary: A competitive salary, which will increase as both you and us grow.

• 🏢 Office: A bright, modern office in Poblenou, Barcelona.

• 🏠 Hybrid Work: We spend at least 2 days per week at the office for high-bandwidth collaboration and trust-building. The other 3 days are for deep focus from home.

• 🪄 AI Tooling: Access to all the AI tools you wish to experiment with.

• 🧘 Urban Sports Club: Subsidized membership for yoga, HIIT, etc.

• 💰 Playflow: Enjoy tax benefits when spending part of your salary.

We move fast (usually wrapping up within a week):

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

About The Role

As a Lead Product Manager at Labhouse , you will be responsible for leading the product end-to-end , working closely with the CEOs to define, build, and scale our apps. Your mission will be to own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution , with a strong focus on driving revenue growth across our portfolio .

You will take full ownership of the product lifecycle — from ideation and validation to launch and optimization — combining strong product intuition, design sensibility, and analytical rigor . This role requires someone highly autonomous, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven , capable of defining KPIs, building dashboards, and making data-informed decisions.

You'll be responsible for:

• Work closely with CEOs to define new app opportunities and build products from scratch.

• Own the product roadmap of live apps, optimizing core features and improving key KPIs.

• Lead product development end-to-end, from ideation to post-launch optimization.

• Drive revenue growth across products through continuous experimentation and iteration.

• Define and implement KPIs, dashboards, and analytics frameworks to track performance.

• Gather and structure user feedback and customer support insights to inform product decisions.
