About You:

Academic background:

• Ideally, with a technical degree (Computer Science, Data, or Telecommunications Engineering), to feel comfortable building dashboards and working hands-on with data.

What Are We Looking For

• Experience building products from 0 to 1 and 1 to 100

• Experience in mobile development, preferably in mobile apps with subscription-based models, F2P games, or consumer products.

• Strong product sense and design intuition, with the ability to create experiences that drive user behavior.

• Hands-on mindset: not just defining product strategy, but personally driving its implementation and execution to grow revenue.

• Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to define KPIs, interpret data, and generate actionable insights.

• Solid analytical foundation: SQL, statistics, experimentation, and product metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, ARPU). Hands-on experience with analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel)

• Strong project management skills, able to prioritize high-impact initiatives, understand trade-offs, and mitigate risks.

• High level of ownership, autonomy, and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Passion for UI/UX and Apple-like product experiences.

• Good level of spoken and written English.

Communication:

• Solid level of spoken and written English.

• Clear, structured communicator who can simplify complex data into product narratives

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

Nice to Have:

• Experience building products from 0 to 1.

• Experience working closely with founders or in startup environments.

What we Offer:

• The opportunity to work side by side with serial entrepreneurs who've built and exited at the highest level

• A real path to becoming a product leader, mentored directly by the CEO

• A fast-moving, AI-native environment where shipping beats talking

• Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

• Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.

• Flexible working hours.

• Permanent contract with an attractive compensation package, above the market average

• A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.

Hiring Process

• TA Interview – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.

• Team Interview – Deep dive into your product thinking, experience, and fit with the team.

• Technical Case & Presentation– Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities.

• Final Interview – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.

You should Know:

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

jobs.title: Product Manager, New Ventures
jobs.description:
About Codeway

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

About The Role

Most product roles start with an existing product. This one starts with a blank page.

You’ll join a small, highly autonomous team building a brand-new greenfield AI product from scratch around image and video generation. There is no roadmap to follow, no playbook to copy, and no product-market fit yet. That’s exactly what makes this role exciting.

From day one, you’ll help define what we build, who we build it for, and why it deserves to exist. You’ll spend time talking to users, prototyping ideas, running experiments, evaluating the latest AI capabilities, and learning quickly from what works—and what doesn’t.

AI won’t be a feature you’ll add to an existing product. It will be the foundation of everything you build. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, growth, data, and our AI research teams to explore both frontier proprietary models and open-source technologies, turning breakthroughs in image and video generation into products that people genuinely love using.

This role is for builders.

People who enjoy creating clarity from ambiguity. Who are comfortable making decisions without perfect information. Who care as much about finding the right problem as building the right solution.

The roadmap isn’t written yet.

You’ll help write it.

What You'll Do

• Build a new AI product around image and video generation from zero alongside a small cross-functional team.

• Discover meaningful user problems through research, observation, and direct conversations.

• Turn emerging AI capabilities into simple, intuitive product experiences that solve real user needs.

• Build MVPs, launch quickly, validate ideas, and iterate relentlessly based on user feedback and data.

• Evaluate the latest image and video generation models, understanding their strengths, limitations, and where they create meaningful product opportunities.

• Design experiments that accelerate learning and help the team reach product-market fit faster.

• Work closely with engineering, design, growth, data, and AI research to ship continuously.

• Balance user value, technical feasibility, model capabilities, and business impact in every product decision.

• Help define the long-term direction of a product from its earliest days.

What You'll Bring

• You’ve built products from zero to one—whether at an early-stage startup, inside a larger company, or as a founder.

• You’re energised by ambiguity and enjoy creating structure where none exists.

• You naturally move between strategy and execution. You’re just as happy interviewing users or reviewing AI outputs as you are analysing experiments or defining the next milestone.

• You have exceptional product taste and a high bar for user experience. You care about the details because you know they’re often what make products feel magical.

• You’re deeply curious about AI, particularly image and video generation, and you’re excited by how rapidly the technology is evolving.

• You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, data, and AI research.

• You take ownership naturally and care far more about outcomes than outputs.

NICE-TO-HAVE

• Experience as a founder or founding Product Manager.

• Experience building AI-powered consumer products.

• Experience launching a new product from zero to one.

• Experience working closely with ML engineers or AI research teams.

• Personal projects exploring the latest AI models, creative tools, or emerging technologies.

What We Offer

• Competitive Compensation. Because great work deserves great pay.

• Full Private Health Insurance. Unlimited coverage.

• Free Breakfast & Lunch. Every day at Codebrew, our in-office coffee shop, with barista coffee and healthy snacks all day long.

• Meal & Transport Support. Monthly compensation that actually covers a proper lunch and your daily commute.

• A Top-Notch Office. In the iconic Edifici Estel, right in the heart of Barcelona.

• Flexible Schedule. We care about your impact, not about tracking your minutes.

• Top Tech Setup. From a high-end laptop to the software and gadgets that help you thrive.

• Wellbeing & Growth. Gym membership, English & Spanish course support, and a game corner for well-earned breaks.

• Pet Adoption Support. We cover your new pet’s essential vet costs in the first year.

• No Dress Code, Great People. A dynamic, talented, passionate team. Come as you are.

THE RECRUITING PROCESS

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

• Application: Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

• Talent & Culture Interview: Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

• Technical Interviews: You will meet with future team lead to go over your specialist capabilities in detail.

• Case Study: We will send you a case study and then you'll have the opportunity to present it to our team.

• Final Interview: A final interview with one of our senior leaders.

• Welcome Aboard! You are now a part of the team.

You can access detailed information on this matter from the "Candidate Information Notice" page at https://www.codeway.co . Codeway processes the personal data of job applicants in accordance with relevant legislation. • Support and mentor fellow product managers through thoughtful product discovery, metric-informed decision-making, and open feedback loops.

• Communicate domain strategy and insights with clarity, empathy, and transparency across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You Will Need

• A proven track record of nurturing complex tech products end-to-end with clear accountability for positive business outcomes.

• Your previous significant experience as a technical Product Manager is backed by supporting internal tools, data flows, and iterative experiments.

• You bring successful experience in working comfortably with data pipelines, API contracts, caching considerations, and system data exploration.

• You bring senior-level experience with hands-on AI agent orchestration, thoughtful prompt design, and developing AI-assisted prototypes.

• You thrive in collaborative, fast-moving spaces where teams ship early, learn together, and iterate using production signals.

• You can demonstrate your skills in connecting strategy, technical depth, and data modeling in an open environment free of red tape.

We offer you

About Kiwi.com

Kiwi.com is a leading global travel-tech company headquartered in the Czech Republic. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About the Job

Neptune Software is the AI execution layer for SAP. Enterprises are moving from software that records to software that acts — AI agents running routine work while people govern the exceptions. What stands in the way isn't the models; it's that the logic agents need to act on is locked inside SAP. Neptune runs inside the customer's own landscape and makes that logic executable by AI: agent-ready context, governed tools, and applications where agents act under the customer's own authorizations, with guardrails enforced by the platform — not by the prompt. With Naia, our AI layer, teams build from natural language and deploy agents on ECC today that carry to S/4HANA unchanged, always at Clean Core. SAP-certified, 500+ enterprises, fifteen years in production: we are where core business systems learn to act.

Location
Remote - Spain

Position
As a Product Manager, you will act as a conduit between our customers, all our internal teams, and the community at large. You will work with clients to understand their needs and desires and use your technical and communication skills to align them to internal workstreams within Engineering, Solution Consulting, and Marketing. In addition, you will work closely with our Customer Success department.

As a Product Manager, you will explore and develop product ideas, whether as a result of discussions with clients and partners, via market research, or by investigating open-source technologies. You will help craft, manage, and roll out comprehensive enablement material via marketing channels, community content, and social media.

You will be hands on with the products and services that our internal and external customers utilize, understanding its benefits and limitations, focusing on bringing the best out of every facet of the platform and the supporting ecosystem.

Responsibilities

• Thorough understanding of the overall market, leading vendors, and open-source technologies

• Work closely with stakeholders (customers, partners, and community) to understand needs and priorities

• Translate market and stakeholder needs into product requirements

• Collaborate with Engineering and Solution Consulting team on feature ideas to prioritize and bring potential solutions to life

• Drive the Business Development in close alignment with our Customer Success team as well as the Sales team

• Become the Company’s Product Advocate and outbound spokesperson via video content, podcasts, webinars, and written releases

• Co-own product specifications, requirements, and release plans

• Collect and synthesize inputs from Engineering, Sales, Marketing team, and the general market to lead business and products direction

• Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure quality product output, timeliness, and market requirements

• Drive and operate internal Project Management and Pre-Sales topics in collaboration with other teams in Neptune Software

• Nurture and grow developer (& partner) community, Neptune Heroes, Social Media presence Create internal and external technical enablement material and collaterals for internal (Pre-Sales) and external audiences (Academy, E-Learning, and Classroom-Training)

Qualifications

• Bachelor/Master’s degree in computer science or software product management

• 3 - 7 years of software product management or related experience

• Strong technical aptitude — comfortable with software architecture concepts and hands-on with AI tools; formal coding experience is helpful but not essential

• Exceptional strategic communications skills

• Experience with enterprise architecture

• A confident and trusted advisor who can provide accurate inside into market development and client needs

• Customer and service-oriented mindset and like to pass on knowledge and experience

• Networking is not a foreign concept, you have the ability to build effective working relationships and work closely with our global go-to-market team and local sales team, but also with our customers and partners

• Able to work both independently and as part of a team

• Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on mentality in a hyper-growth environment

• Strategic mindset, long-term-planning with passion for detail and excellence

• First-class written skills in English

• Comfortable working in Confluence and GitHub — documenting specs and decisions, and navigating repos, issues, and pull requests alongside Engineering

• Experience with low-code / no-code application platforms is a plus, not a requirement — we will train the right candidate

• SAP knowledge (ECC, S/4HANA, or ABAP/SAP development) is a plus, not a requirement

• Microsoft or cloud platform technology know-how is welcome

What we offer

• International work environment;

• Emerging and leading technology;

• Work on exciting projects for the largest companies in the world;

• The opportunity to be part of a success story.

• Competitive salary and benefits.

• Opportunity to build real things and make a difference by putting your code into production.

Please note
We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Preply is an AI-native company, and the AI Platform is the foundation that underpins all of our AI initiatives. We’re building it to power AI product features for learning and the marketplace, personalising the experience for our tutors and learners, and to be the single place for teams at Preply to build agentic systems and workflows. It will be pivotal in helping Preply move fast, automate and scale.

As the first product manager on the AI Platform, you’ll define the mission, vision and strategy across traditional ML, LLM and agentic systems. This is a new, greenfield role: a great opportunity to make a product impact on a foundational platform. You’ll make sure we build safely and responsibly, with the platform setting the standards, governance and guardrails for how Preply builds with AI.

The role focuses on building the product roadmap with multiple engineering teams, helping other product teams build faster, and measuring the platform’s impact on how fast Preply builds, automates and scales with AI.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define the mission, vision, strategy, and product roadmap for the AI platform across traditional ML, LLM, and agentic systems, working with multiple engineering teams

What You Need To Succeed

• Excellent product sense in the fast-changing AI domain, with a drive to do product work, not just building

• Leading AI fluency, using AI to transform personal work and helping others do the same

• Proven ability to influence and align senior engineering, data, and business stakeholders, with credibility among data and engineering teams

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience in platform, AI, or ML engineering before moving into product

• Experience in tech or AI-native businesses, such as e-commerce, fintech, or B2B SaaS with critical AI features

Why you will love it at Preply

• An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com

• Learning & Development budget and time off for self-development

• A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance

• Attractive relocation package to join the Preply Barcelona Hub if not already in Barcelona

• Access to free mental health support platforms

• Access to Gym-pass -partnered wellness and gym centres throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health

• Opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in

Our Principles

• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

• Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

• Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

• Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

• Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

• One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Agentic Platform & Enterprise Interfaces
jobs.description:
This is an in-office role based in Barcelona, ES, with a requirement to work a minimum of three days per week on-site . Remote or travel flexibility is not available.

Role Summary

AstraZeneca's scientists and clinicians increasingly work through agentic AI platforms and enterprise AI assistants. What decides whether those tools help is the layer around them: the skills people can use, the connectors that give them governed access to company data, and the way people get onboarded, supported and measured. We are seeking a Product Owner, Agentic Platform & Enterprise Interfaces, to own that layer for R&D.

You will be the day-to-day product owner of AISI's agentic platform for as long as it runs, and you will own the skills library, marketplace and data connectors that make AI assistants useful in R&D. You will make sure that access to data is governed, that costs and usage are visible, and that users are onboarded and supported well. As the platform landscape changes, you will keep the user experience and the governance consistent for the people who depend on it.

You will work with AI scientists and engineers, Enterprise AI platform and gateway teams, information security, architecture, data owners and external delivery partners. The role is hands-on and fast-moving. The ideal candidate is a product owner who is comfortable with technical detail, can say no clearly, and takes pride in how users experience the product.

Key Responsibilities

Platform and Interface Product Ownership

• Own the roadmap, backlog and release priorities for the R&D agentic platform and its interfaces, working with engineering leads on scope and sequencing.

• Decide what the platform should do itself, and what should move to enterprise assistants as they mature.

• Write clear product requirements, acceptance criteria and release notes, and keep decisions documented.

Skills, Marketplace And Connectors

• Own the skills library and marketplace: intake, quality review, publication, retirement and ownership of each skill.

• Own the connector roadmap, including connectors to enterprise data and systems built on open standards such as MCP. Prioritise requests against value, risk and engineering capacity.

• Set the criteria for approving connectors and skills, and work with security, architecture and data owners so that each one is reviewed before release.

Governed Data Access and Security

• Define with data owners and security how users get access to data through the platform, including approval flows and criteria for patient-related data.

• Make sure security findings are tracked to closure, for example weaknesses in how credentials, secrets or conversations are handled.

• Keep access, audit and retention requirements visible in the backlog and review them with Product Compliance.

User Onboarding, Access and Support

• Run the intake and onboarding process for new users and groups, including seat allocation and the weekly review of access requests.

• Work with support engineers and change partners on support queues, user communications and training.

• Handle requests from business areas in flight, and give each a clear answer and timeline.

Usage, Cost and Value

• Own the platform's usage and cost metrics, including model and token cost per session, and work with finance and platform teams on budgets and tiers.

• Define and report value measures and user stories that show what the platform delivers in R&D.

• Contribute to planning cycles with a clear view of run cost and options.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with AI scientists, engineers, Enterprise AI gateway and platform teams, security, architecture and business sponsors.

• Communicate clearly about what is shipping, what is blocked and why, including when a request has to wait.

Desired Profile

Experience

• 5 or more years of experience as a product owner or product manager of a technical platform, data platform, API or developer-facing product.

• Experience with LLM-based applications or agentic systems, including how skills, tools and connectors are managed.

• Working knowledge of APIs, integration patterns and, ideally, the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

• Experience managing user access, onboarding and support for an enterprise tool.

• Understanding of information security and data access governance, ideally in a regulated environment.

• Experience tracking usage and cost for cloud or AI services, and making product decisions from the data.

• Proven ability to prioritise a long request queue and communicate trade-offs clearly.

Desirable

• Experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences R&D.

• Familiarity with FinOps practices for cloud or model usage.

• Working knowledge of Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence).

jobs.title: Product Manager (BCN)
jobs.description:
Lexroom is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom .

We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.

Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

Why Lexroom ?

• Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

• Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.

• Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.

At Lexroom , we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

Role

You’ll own the product for two distinct but connected areas: one of our core AI product surfaces (such as legal research, drafting, practice workflows) and one of our international expansion markets across Europe.

That means doing the discovery work to understand what law firms actually need, shipping features that move retention and depth of use, and helping figure out what Lexroom means in a new market, from corpus coverage to onboarding to positioning.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: discovery, definition, delivery, and iteration.

• Run discovery: user interviews, behavioral data, support signal — enough to know what’s worth building before you commit the team.

• Turn insights from users, data, and internal stakeholders into a clear, actionable roadmap, and keep it up to date.

• Write specs that engineering can build from without a follow-up meeting, define user stories, and manage the backlog.

• Collaborate daily with engineering, design, and legal engineers to ship simple, high-impact features.

• Drive international expansion work: competitor analysis, market fit assessment, localization gaps, go-to-market coordination with sales and marketing.

• Own launch quality: brief stakeholders, define success metrics, close the feedback loop with sales, marketing, and customer success after shipping.

• Track what matters. Not vanity metrics — activation, retention, feature depth. Run experiments and use data to inform decisions.

What We’re Looking For

• 2–4 years as a Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS or early-stage startups.

• You’ve shipped high-quality features end-to-end in fast-paced environments and can point to the outcome, not just the output.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; confident working with product metrics.

• Comfortable working from ambiguous signals: you can turn a messy interview or a confusing data cut into a clear hypothesis.

• Fluent in English — both markets, both stakeholders. Italian language is a plus.

• Structured thinker. You write clearly, prioritize explicitly, and push back when something doesn’t add up.

• Self-starter attitude: you take ownership and don’t wait for permission.

• AI-native PM: you are able to build a working MVP using AI coding tools.

• Familiarity with product tooling (Linear, Figma, Notion, June, any analytics platform) is fine; we care more about judgment than tool fluency.

Bonus if you have: experience with legal tech, enterprise software, or a previous international market expansion.

What To Expect

• Scope: You’ll own a product area from day one, not assist on someone else’s roadmap.

• Team: Small squads, fast feedback, direct access to the founders and CTO.

Rewarding Your Contribution

We value excellence and share success:

Annual Salary Range: €45,000 – €80,000+ depending on seniority

• Stock option package: Your hard work will directly contribute to—and benefit from—our success.

Benefits That Matter

• Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Barcelona office.

• Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure peace of mind.

• Meal Vouchers: Daily support to make your lunch breaks easier.

• Performance Bonuses: Rewards tied directly to measurable results.

• Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.

At Lexroom , ambition meets discipline and purpose.

We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you

Compensation Range: €45K - €80K

• Define success metrics (accuracy, error or hallucination rate, time saved, adoption, cost per interaction) and establish evaluation frameworks with engineering and data science.

• Work with technical teams across the entire lifecycle: data requirements, build-or-buy decisions, prompt and RAG design, evaluation, monitoring and iteration.

• Ensure a responsible approach: data protection and GDPR, security, transparency towards the user, human oversight where needed, and alignment with the European AI Act and internal AI governance.

• Coordinate design, engineering, data and product teams to deliver the roadmap, both in the short and medium term.

• Drive synergies between products such as TS Facturas, SDS, Aplifisa and Asesor Excelente, and work with marketing, sales and support to ensure successful launches.

• Maintain a close relationship with customers and partners, validating AI results with real users.

What we are looking for

• More than 5 years of experience in product management in software companies, with a clear focus on business results. We especially value 2 or more years working with AI/ML features in production.

• Solid knowledge of AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, evaluation methods and trade-offs between accuracy, cost, latency and risk. You don’t need to code, but you should be able to speak as an equal with engineers.

• Familiarity with the technical stack of AI products: model APIs and cost management, vector databases, evaluation and observability frameworks, guardrails and security, and integrations with ERP and accounting systems.

• Experience in the ERP sector, with exposure to accounting, tax and payroll. Having applied AI to these processes would be a great plus.

• Knowledge of regulation: AI Act risk classification, DPIAs, Spanish electronic invoicing (Verifactu), and standards such as ISO 27001 or ISO 42001.

• Ability to analyse data, define KPIs and work with agile methodologies.

• Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills in multidisciplinary environments.

• Curiosity, a critical view of AI hype, and judgement to know when AI is the right answer and when it is not.

• Native Spanish essential and advanced professional English. Other languages, such as Italian, are a plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI)
jobs.description:
About Us

Luzia is Europe's fastest-growing AI consumer company, redefining conversational AI with cutting-edge LLMs and an unparalleled user experience. We're on a mission to make Luzia the go-to AI personal assistant for millions of users across Latin America.

⚡ 80M+ users worldwide in under 3 years

🌎 LatAm is 60%+ of our user base

🚀 Backed by Khosla Ventures, Prosus Ventures, A-Star, Monashees and more

The role

This is a hands-on role on an AI product. You will lead one of our product areas end to end: deciding what to build and what not to build, specifying agentic features with engineers, and putting them into production. There is no separate engineering manager layer, so you will own prioritisation for your area and understand how the system works, backend included, well enough to make the trade-offs yourself.

Responsibilities

• Own the roadmap for your product area, deciding what to build, what not to build and which KPIs it needs to move, using both qualitative insight and data.

• Work with Engineering, Design and Growth to turn AI capabilities into products that solve real user needs, specifying how a feature should behave, when it should call a tool or hand off to a person, and what it must never do.

• Set the team's priorities and make sure engineering effort goes to the work that matters most.

• Define how we know an AI feature is good enough to ship: the evaluation, the quality, latency and cost metrics, and the signal that tells us when a change has broken something.

• Write clear product requirements and documentation, and run experiments whose results change what we do next.

• Challenge assumptions, including the team's, and present your findings and recommendations to business leaders.

Requirements

• 4+ years building technology products, as a product manager or through an equivalent route such as product engineering or a technical founder role, including meaningful experience in a B2C consumer product.

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs, not only using them. You have shipped something where you chose the model, designed how it behaves, decided when it should call a tool or hand off to a human, and evaluated whether the output was good enough to release. You can explain what it cost, how you measured quality, and what you did when something changed underneath you.

• Technical enough to understand the full system behind a feature, backend included, and to hold your own in design and architecture discussions with engineers.

• A strong data mindset. You go to the data yourself, use the numbers in front of you to test a decision, and are comfortable with SQL and product analytics tools.

• You drive action rather than coordinate it. You are comfortable challenging ideas, pushing back with reasoning, and making a call when the information is incomplete.

• Proven ability to work autonomously and flexibly in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment, with a team spread across countries.

• Fluent English

Nice to have

• Background as a developer or technical lead before moving into product.

• Experience with conversational products, assistants or agents in a consumer setting.

• Experience with transactional or e-commerce products, including third-party API integrations.

• Solid eye for design and UX.

Working model

This is a hybrid role based in our Madrid office - you’ll combine working from our office and working from home

Equal opportunity

Luzia is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on what you build and how you think.

Ready to build with us?

Apply via the link below, attaching your CV in English. We read every application

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
The role and the team

As a Senior AI Product Manager (all genders), you'll help drive the vision for Lucanet's Intelligence Core and Lume and turn it into trusted, high-impact features for finance teams who cannot afford wrong answers. AI is already central to Lucanet, and the Intelligence Core and Lume, the shared AI capability our products and agents build on, is among the most advanced in the industry.

You'll work in a small, highly talented AI product team and coordinate AI initiatives across R&D, alongside Engineering, Delivery, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams. You lead through influence rather than formal authority. The team values pragmatic, collaborative people who stay comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy working at the fast-moving edge of AI. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.

What you'll do

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle for Lucanet's Intelligence Core and Lume, our shared AI capability.

• Prioritize AI features with data-driven frameworks, tie each to a business outcome, and review adoption after launch.

• Own the AI evaluation strategy, offline with curated datasets and benchmarks and online with live production quality signals.

• Define and mature LLMOps best practices across the agent and product lifecycle, and centralize AI product reporting.

• Run customer discovery and early-access programs with working prototypes to validate solutions before committing to a path.

• Coordinate AI initiatives across R&D and align Product, Engineering, Delivery, and go-to-market teams.

• Track the AI frontier, including models, research, tooling, and competitor launches, and turn it into concrete opportunities.

• Contribute to AI pricing and packaging and enable Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success with value-proposition briefs.

You'll report into the Product AI leadership team.

What You Bring

You have

• Owned the roadmap and lifecycle of an enterprise software product, from discovery to launch, using customer discovery and product analytics to reach measurable business outcomes.

• Working knowledge of modern AI/ML (LLMs, RAG, agents, agentic harness, prompt and context engineering, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs), with depth in at least one area such as Agent UX, LLMOps, or AI evaluation.

• Track the AI frontier (new model releases, research, tooling, techniques) and quickly judge what matters for finance use cases.

• Use LLMs and AI tools daily, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, to change how you work and turn ideas into working demos in hours.

• A pragmatic, collaborative, low-ego mindset: you're comfortable with ambiguity, lead through influence without formal authority, and keep learning at the fast-moving edge of AI.

• Advanced English (C1).

It's a plus if you also have

• A genuine passion for AI: you experiment with new models and tools, follow the field closely (papers, releases, communities), and form your own views on where it's heading.

Perks at work

• Flexible and hybrid working: our Lucaflex model lets you plan your working hours and location according to your needs and professional responsibilities.

• Remote work from another country: Work up to 90 days a year outside your home country, supported by our partner Workflex.

• Professional development budget: Get dedicated time, resources and budget to build the skills for your career path.

• Structured development process: quarterly catch-ups with your manager, built on clear expectations for impact, competence and influence.

• Paid volunteer days: Take the time to volunteer, alone or with your team, for causes you care about.

• Health and wellbeing support: Access company wellbeing programs, sport subsidies and mental health support through external partners.

• Paid vacation days: Take 28 days a year to rest, travel and recharge.

• Private health insurance: Access private health insurance coverage.

• Corporate discounts platform: Get exclusive discounts across travel, retail, technology, and more.

About Lucanet

Lucanet is the CFO solution platform for modern finance and tax teams, automating processes from consolidation and financial planning to tax compliance, ESG reporting, and cash management. More than 6,000 companies worldwide rely on our easy-to-use, out-of-the-box SaaS platform. We're PE-backed and growing across global markets. 

Behind the platform is a global team of 900+ people who care about doing the work well. We challenge each other to move fast without cutting corners and build solutions that change how finance and tax leaders operate. If you want your work to have real reach, and your growth is important to you, Lucanet is the right place for you.

Discover more about Lucanet as an employer.

Powered by uniqueness

Everybody is different here and we like it that way. We welcome people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, national origin, religion, age, and disability, exactly as they are. What you bring is what matters. If you need an adjustment to take part in our hiring process, let us know. See yourself in this role? We want to hear from you.

Please keep your CV focused on your experience and skills, rather than including your photo, age or marital status.

Learn more about our DE&I journey.

Data protection

Your personal data will be processed in accordance with GDPR requirements. Find out how we keep your data safe: Lucanet data protection policy.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agent Platform
jobs.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena runs customer experience for consumer brands through a connected multi-agent stack. As Product Manager, Core Agent Platform, you'll own the platform those agents run on, from its current capabilities to where it goes next. You'll own how we measure, test and improve agent performance, and how customers see it. You'll work directly with engineering, deployment and customers, and you'll be expected to build as well as specify.

What You'll Do

• Own the core agent platform end to end, including the roadmap and the day-to-day product decisions.

• Build and ship the evaluation, testing and monitoring systems that make agent performance measurably better over time.

• Design and run structured experiments and A/B tests across agent workflows.

• Give customers clear visibility into how their agents are performing.

• Prototype your own ideas with coding agents, and ship them where you can, rather than waiting on a hand-off.

• Work with customers and our deployment team to understand what's working in the field and turn it into product.

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

• 3+ years as a PM in CX, ecommerce, helpdesk or AI automation.

• Technical fluency: you can explain how webhooks, OAuth and integrations work and have made product decisions around them.

• AI-native builder: you use tools like Claude, Cursor or v0 daily and have prototyped your own product ideas with them.

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

• You've run structured experiments or A/B tests and can say what the data did and didn't tell you.

• You've built dashboards or visibility features people actually relied on.

• You're confident with customers: you've sat in on calls, run demos, and know what end users really complain about.

• You act like the CEO of your product area: strong opinions, and a habit of building and talking to customers without being asked.

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

• Engineering background, or you've shipped production code yourself.

Not a Fit If:

• You wait to be told what to build.

• You want a narrowly scoped PM seat with a fixed roadmap handed to you.

• You're not comfortable being customer-facing or getting on a call to demo your own work.

• You'd rather stay behind the product than own the messy, ambiguous parts.

• You need a designer or engineer to turn your product vision into something people can click.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How We Hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
jobs.description:
About The Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

• Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

• Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

• Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

• Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

• Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

• Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

• Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

• Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

• Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

An ideal candidate has

• 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

• Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

• Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

• The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

• Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

• Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

• A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

• Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

• Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

• Hopper covers the cost of employee premiums for private medical and dental coverage

• Hopper also offers private life and accident coverage

• Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

• Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

• Unlimited PTO

• Hopper offers a monthly cash allowance for gym memberships and to cover home office expenses

• Carrot Cash travel stipend

• Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

• Open communication with management and company leadership

• Small, dynamic teams with massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, Co

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Gameloft

Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games.

There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures.

With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are.

If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game!

As Lead Product Manager for Asphalt Legends , you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.

You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.

YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets.

• Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars:
• Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU.

• Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs.

• Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential.

• Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions.

• Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence.

• Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization.

• 10+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console).

• Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles.

• Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.

• Excellent presentation and documentation skills , with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership.

• Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field.

An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken .

BONUS POINTS

• Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets.

• Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.

• Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.

• Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.

• Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!

• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!

• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!

• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!

• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.

• 25 vacation days per year

• Private medical health insurance

• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card

• Flexible work from home hybrid model

• Free language courses

• Birthday day off!

• 1 month of remote work

• Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

• Career-development opportunities.

• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).

• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!
Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, New Product Line- Hybrid
jobs.description:
Position Overview

As a Lead Product Manager based in our Barcelona office, you will have the opportunity to build and own a new product line at Baxter Planning, taking it from first customer insight to a scaled, revenue-generating product. You'll start from a capability already proven with an enterprise customer and use it to define a repeatable, multi-customer product. From there you'll set the vision, shape the roadmap, bring the product to market and grow it into a new pillar of our platform.

This is a leadership role with end-to-end ownership of an innovative product, reporting to the EVP of Product.

Scope And Responsibilities

• Vision and strategy: Set the product vision, target customers and long-term direction for a new pillar

• Discovery and validation: Work directly with customers to validate problems, value and willingness to pay before committing to a build

• Build and launch: Define the product and lead Engineering and Design from first release through pilots to general availability

• Commercialization: Shape pricing, packaging and go-to-market with Sales and Finance, and own the product's revenue outcomes

• Scale: Develop and maintain a dynamic, phased, evidence-based roadmap and decide what to build next and what not to build

• AI and platform: Decide where AI and automation create real customer value, and how the product connects across our platform

What Success Looks Like:

• 30 days- You understand our customers, the market and the existing capability, and you have a point of view on the opportunity

• 90 days- You have a validated product vision and first-release definition and MVP, built on discovery with multiple customers

• 6 months- The first customers are live on the productized release

• 12 months- You have paying customers, a clear revenue trajectory, and an evidence-backed roadmap for the next phase

What You'll Bring:

• 5+ years in B2B product management (or equivalent experience), including at least one new product or product line you built from zero to recurring revenue

• Enough technical depth to partner closely with Engineering on platform, API or data heavy products

• Commercial ownership: willingness-to-pay discovery, pricing and packaging, and accountability for revenue

• Evidence-led judgment. You validate before you scale and will recommend stopping when the evidence says so

• Clear, structured communication with executives, engineers and customers

jobs.description:
Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are building the premier ecosystem for European financial institutions to issue and distribute euro-denominated tokenized assets. We're hiring a Lead Technical Product Manager to own Vision Chain as a product: the foundation that Bitpanda's onchain products run on.
You'll own how the chain works and evolves, covering topics spanning proof systems, core protocol modifications, selecting the infrastructure providers, and more. You'll design and implement compliance, identity and privacy solutions into and on the chain, to satisfy the requirements of both financial institutions and developers. You'll work on this in collaboration with both internal and external product and engineering teams, as well as Bitpanda's Compliance, Legal and Data Protection teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product within a small, senior team.

What you’ll do

• Own Vision Chain at the infrastructure level, managing configuration choices (fee mechanism, block building logic, etc.), and modifications to the OP Stack, in collaboration with the OP Labs team.

• Manage infrastructure partnerships, owning the technical relationship with providers (RPC nodes, indexing, oracles, etc.).

• Collaborate with Compliance and Legal to implement regulatorily-compliant onchain transaction screening, identity, and privacy solutions.

• Run reliability, incidents and cost, and own developer documentation and partner technical onboarding until a developer relations lead joins.

• Coordinate with the other Vision Web3 product leads to ensure the chain’s technical roadmap supports the product roadmap being built on top of it.

Who you are

• 6+ years of product or engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on blockchain infrastructure (e.g., L1/L2, rollup-as-a-service, node infrastructure provider, account abstraction, or an exchange protocol team).

• Deep understanding of EVM rollup mechanics, including sequencing, fees, proofs, withdrawals, bridges, upgrade keys, and account abstraction.

• Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory needs into precise technical requirements and drive them to delivery through engineering teams and external partners without direct management.

• Experience partnering with Compliance, Legal, and Data Protection teams, possessing working knowledge of the EU crypto regulatory landscape (MiCA, DORA, AML/CFT, sanctions screening).

• Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills for internal teams, leadership, and external partners.

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

The role spans multi-agent architecture, platform integrations (e.g. Gemini Enterprise, Copilot Studio), lifecycle governance, security & privacy, and commercialization, ensuring our customers can confidently discover, purchase, and scale AI agents that drive real outcomes

Strategic Context:

Why now: Traditional SaaS growth is plateauing; customers expect outcome-based, intelligent services. Agentic AI is reshaping how work gets done; customers expect outcome-based solutions that are secure, compliant, and easy to adopt.

Opportunity : Vodafone can become the preferred partner for curated, enterprise-ready agents with integrated billing, governance, and lifecycle management—especially for SMEs that need simplicity and trust.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager

Seez is an AI-powered automotive technology company transforming how vehicles are bought and sold. Since 2016, we've been building scalable SaaS and digital retail solutions that help dealerships, OEMs, and marketplaces deliver smarter, more seamless car buying experiences. Our technology combines AI, data, and automation to power everything from intelligent vehicle discovery to next-generation conversational and generative AI tools.

We are seeking a highly technical and execution-focused Product Manager to lead the delivery and evolution of AI-enabled capabilities across our enterprise automotive SaaS platform. This role sits close to Engineering and Data Science and is ideal for someone who enjoys working hands-on with technical teams, experimenting with emerging AI capabilities, and translating real customer problems into scalable product solutions.

You'll work at the intersection of business needs and technical execution, helping shape how AI becomes embedded across dealership workflows and customer-facing digital experiences. We're looking for someone who is comfortable moving between discovery, prototyping, and delivery, and who can translate complex requirements into clear, actionable outcomes.

Job Key Responsibilities

• Understand the Market & Customer Problems: Stay close to customer workflows, industry trends, and partner feedback in the automotive space. Translate real operational pain points into scalable product opportunities, with particular focus on automation and AI-assisted workflows

• Drive Technical Product Delivery: Lead end-to-end delivery of platform features from discovery through rollout and iteration. Work closely with Engineering and Data to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with platform architecture

• Contribute to AI-Enabled Product Direction: Identify opportunities to introduce AI capabilities that improve efficiency, insight generation, and customer experience across the platform. Support early validation of ideas through lightweight experimentation and structured problem exploration before committing to full delivery cycles

• Partner Closely with Engineering: Act as a technical partner to Engineering rather than a coordination layer between teams. Participate in solution discussions, clarify trade-offs, and help define implementation approaches that balance speed, quality, and long-term platform maintainability

• Shape the Roadmap: Contribute to roadmap planning by identifying high-impact improvements that balance short-term delivery needs with long-term platform evolution

• Manage Parallel Initiatives: Coordinate multiple initiatives at once, aligning internal delivery timelines with customer expectations and platform priorities

• Own Product Performance: Define success metrics, monitor adoption, and use data to inform iteration and prioritisation decisions

Requirements

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE PARTY (MUST HAVES)

• Experience & Product Ownership: 3-4 years of proven experience as a Product Manager, ideally in startups or fast-paced environments, with a track record of owning features or products from ideation through launch and iteration

• Exposure to AI-Enabled Product Development: Experience working on products that incorporate automation, machine learning workflows, LLM capabilities, or data-driven decision systems. Comfort experimenting with modern AI tooling to validate ideas and improve workflows is strongly preferred. Practical product application matters most

• Strategic & Lifecycle Management: Skilled in setting a clear product vision, defining roadmaps, and managing the full product lifecycle — from discovery and prioritisation to delivery and optimisation

• Excellent Stakeholder Management: Builds strong relationships with internal teams and external clients. Proactively aligns expectations, manages feedback loops, and keeps stakeholders informed and engaged throughout the product lifecycle

• User-Centric & Data-Informed: Passionate about understanding user needs and turning insights into actionable solutions. Comfortable using data to inform decisions, validate assumptions, and measure success

• Structured Problem Solving: Excels at breaking down complex business or product problems into clear, prioritised tasks with practical, scalable solutions

• Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with product and collaboration tools like Figma, Jira, Notion, and analytics platforms

YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU'RE SOMEONE (GREAT-TO-HAVE)

• Automotive Industry Knowledge: Prior experience with automotive data and related technologies

• Innovation Champion: A spirit that challenges the status quo, encourages experimentation, and identifies opportunities to differentiate our products through innovative thinking

• Experience Working with AI Tooling: Hands-on exposure to prototyping workflows using modern AI tools, APIs, or automation platforms is a strong advantage

• Growth Mindset: Open to feedback, eager to learn, grow, and continuously improve

• Large-Scale Integrations: Experience building large-scale product solutions with complex third-party system integrations (e.g., payment gateways, internal systems) will be highly regarded

jobs.title: Product Lead for Cloud Services
jobs.description:
The challenge
We are looking for a Product Lead for Cloud Services to own the business and product direction of one of the foundations of Plenit: the infrastructure services our partners use to deliver technology to their customers.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role.

You will not spend most of your time managing a backlog or translating tickets for Engineering. Our engineering squads have strong technical leadership close to execution. Your job is to stay one level above and one step ahead: understand where the market is going, what our partners need, where the revenue opportunity is, what competitors are doing, and turn all of that into clear product and business priorities.

You will report directly to the CEO and act as the accountable owner for the Cloud Services business.

If the company sets a target for Cloud Services to generate a certain level of revenue, you will own the question of how we get there.

That means understanding whether the answer lies in a new product capability, a pricing change, better packaging, stronger adoption in Mexico, a competitive gap, a partner enablement problem, a reliability issue, or something we have not identified yet.

You will be highly exposed across the company and the market. You will work directly with the CEO, Sales, Partner Success, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Infrastructure teams, country teams, and our partners.

The engineering Team Leads will stay close to the squads and execution. You will make sure they receive the right problems to solve, with the right context, priorities, business rationale, and customer understanding behind them.

To do that well, you need to genuinely understand cloud infrastructure. You do not need to be the person configuring the hypervisor, but you should be able to sit with Infrastructure and Engineering leads, discuss compute, storage, networking, virtualization, backup, provisioning or capacity, understand the trade-offs, and make sound product decisions from them.

Expected outcomes and impact

• Own the product and business strategy for Plenit’s Cloud Services portfolio, directly aligned with company strategy and revenue objectives defined with the CEO.

• Translate commercial targets into concrete product, pricing, packaging, adoption, geographic, and go-to-market initiatives.

• Understand the economics of the Cloud Services business: revenue, growth, margins, adoption, attach rates, churn, consumption, partner penetration, and profitability.

• Build and maintain a deep understanding of the cloud infrastructure market, including hyperscalers, sovereign cloud providers, regional competitors, MSP-focused platforms, and emerging infrastructure models.

• Continuously identify where Plenit should compete, where we should differentiate, and where simplicity can become a strategic advantage.

• Stay close to MSPs, ISVs, VARs, and IT resellers. Understand how they package infrastructure services, how they make money, what their customers ask for, and what stops them from growing their cloud business.

• Diagnose business performance across markets. If Cloud Services is underperforming in Spain, Mexico, or another geography, understand why and drive the right response across Product, Sales, Partner Success, Marketing, Pricing, or Operations.

• Identify and shape new Cloud Services capabilities across areas such as compute, virtualization, storage, networking, backup, disaster recovery, security, provisioning, automation, and infrastructure management.

jobs.title: Stablecoins Product Lead
jobs.description:
About Getnet

Getnet Platforms is part of Santander Payment Solutions and brings together a set of key platforms within Santander's global payments technology ecosystem. It includes software-as-a-service capabilities across the entire payments value chain, such as account-to-account processing, FX, SWIFT connectivity, fraud management and card processing infrastructure.

It enables financial institutions, non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) and payment service providers (PSPs) to operate, scale and evolve their payment capabilities across multiple rails, markets and regulatory environments, without the need to rebuild their core systems.

Proven at scale, including within Santander itself, these platforms provide a modular foundation that complements Getnet's global payment capabilities to support client growth through payments.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM

If you want to shape the future of financial solutions, this is the place!

At Getnet Platforms, your work connects to something bigger, creating a real impact across global teams and markets for our clients and communities.

Our people are our greatest strength. We combine growth opportunities, strong team connections, and a culture that supports your well-being and sense of belonging, so you can develop, contribute, and feel valued. With flexibility and autonomy built into how we work, you'll have the space to focus, collaborate, and perform at your best.

Here, your impact matters, your growth is supported, and your experience is designed to help you thrive.

What You'll Do

• Define and evolve the global stablecoin product roadmap, translating strategic priorities and business opportunities into clear product requirements, functional specifications and implementation plans.

• Lead stablecoin initiatives from definition through implementation, establishing project plans, milestones, deliverables and timelines.
