• Define and track product KPIs, measure progress against objectives and drive continuous improvement and adoption across markets.

What We're Looking For

We are in search of a Stablecoins Product Lead to join our team in Madrid, Spain , with the following qualifications and background:

Professional Experience

• At least 8 years of experience in product management, project or programme management, or business development within banking, payments, fintech or digital financial services.

• Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional projects from definition through implementation, coordinating multiple stakeholders and delivering against agreed milestones.

Education

Languages

• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Hard Skills

• Knowledge of stablecoins, blockchain technology, digital wallets, custody models, payment flows and relevant regulatory considerations.

• Advanced PowerPoint skills for producing executive presentations, recommendations and decision papers.

Soft Skills

• Ownership and accountability.

• Critical thinking and problem-solving.

• Stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Organization and prioritization.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

From having their phone buzz as their first payment comes in to quickly resolving customer issues on-the-go, the Stripe mobile app is a critical lifeline for founders and business owners around the world. Our team is responsible for both the app platform and user-facing experiences. We collaborate closely with every product team to represent, shape, and enhance what it means to be mobile. The next chapter of our mobile efforts will take the quality bar to even greater heights and redefine mobile money movement.

We’re hiring a passionate product leader to shape the strategy, amplify its impact across the company, and accelerate Stripe’s mission to help internet businesses grow faster.

What you’ll do

As the product manager on the Mobile team, you will be accountable for making the mobile app indispensable for startup founders and business owners. How do we get every YC founder to use the app? How can we increase usage across different geographies? How can we get more product teams to contribute to the app? In other words, your role is to ensure founders and business owners are more successful when they use the mobile app.

Responsibilities

• Deeply understand the needs of founders and business owners and identify the unique superpowers mobile can deliver for them

• Articulate the mobile strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and furiously execute to deliver user value

• Craft powerful product experiences with surprisingly great details

• Steer the broader organization to understand and build for mobile use cases

• Collaborate with the go-to-market team to ensure the mobile app is discoverable and compelling

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

• 8+ years of product management or product-focused founder experience

• Persistence and a whatever-it-takes approach to ensure that your product is successful

• Strong understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles and best practices

• Technical familiarity with mobile development, cross-platform architectures, and machine learning

• Ability to collaborate with engineering and design across time zones (PST, EST, CET)

Preferred Qualifications

• Founder background, or experience in a very early stage company environment

• Built award-winning mobile apps in the past

• Believe that fast software is the best software

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $214,300 - $321,500. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
jobs.description:
Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers.
The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do

• Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.

• Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.

• Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.

• Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.

• Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are

• 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.

• You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.

• Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.

• Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.

• Nice to haves:

• hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch

• knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.
Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Preply Pro and Strategic Projects
jobs.description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

The role

This is an opportunity at Preply to lead the launch of Preply Pro - our AI-first freemium experience - and to own the strategic, cross-cutting projects that move the whole business forward.

You will lead a portfolio of high-leverage initiatives that span multiple squads and tribes. These are the problems that matter most to Preply but don't sit neatly inside one team - commercial, cross-functional, and often ambiguous. It's some of the highest-visibility work at Preply and a core part of how we turn strategy into shipped, measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who combines depth in product building with sharp commercial instincts, exceptional stakeholder management and disciplined execution - comfortable operating without a dedicated squad, and energised by bridging the gap between product management and program management to get big, ambiguous things over the line.

What you'll be doing day to day

• Own the Preply Pro launch end to end. Strategy, roadmap, execution, and commercial results for one of Preply's most important bets - across squads, learners and tutors, web and mobile.

• Lead the commercial story. Own the business case, pricing and packaging, and the metrics that prove Pro is working. You bring commercial judgement to every prioritization call, not just product craft.

• Work across squads and tribes. The highest-impact work rarely lives in one team. You'll shape and drive initiatives that cut across multiple squads and tribes, aligning people who don't report to you around a shared outcome.

• Manage stakeholders like a pro. Keep senior stakeholders across Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance and Ops aligned and moving - building trust, surfacing trade-offs early, and driving decisions without formal authority.

• Stay close to the customer. Keep deep empathy for learners and tutors at the centre of every decision, so every strategic bet solves real problems people feel.

• Execute with discipline. While having access to product resources, you will operate without a dedicated squad - bridging product and program management to turn ambiguous, cross-functional work into clear plans, owners, and shipped results.

• Go into the data yourself. Pull your own analyses on how learners and tutors interact with Preply to guide decisions. Especially on Pro, what drives conversion and retention, and where the experience is falling flat.

What you'll need

• Senior product craft. Substantial experience building and launching consumer-facing, mobile-first products. You have a keen eye for design and care about the details of a delightful experience.

• Strong commercial acumen. You are energized by driving user and business outcomes - pricing, packaging, conversion, retention, unit economics - and can build and defend the business case for a launch like Preply Pro.

• Deep customer empathy. You are genuinely curious about the learners and tutors who use Preply, and bring that into every prioritization call.

• Deeply data-driven. You go into the data yourself, find the signal, and build a point of view from scratch. You're comfortable with experiment design and reading A/B results without fooling yourself.

• Stakeholder management & influence. You build trust fast and align senior stakeholders across functions who don't report to you, turning competing priorities into shared decisions.

• Strong communication. You can turn complex, ambiguous work into a clear point of view that drives decisions at the leadership level.

• Disciplined execution. You turn ambiguous, cross-functional work into clear plans, owners, milestones and shipped outcomes - bridging product and program management.

• Comfort with ambiguity. You can make fuzzy things measurable and drive alignment on what good looks like - and you're comfortable delivering without a dedicated squad, borrowing and influencing resources to get there.

• Experience launching or scaling monetization related products

Our Principles

• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

• Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

• Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

• Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

• Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

• Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

• Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

• Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

• One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin,

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
We're proud to be ranked as the 12th fastest growing startup on the Sifted 250 list! 🚀

👉Read about it here

Product Lead

Location: Ireland, UK, Spain or Portugal - Remote first

About Kota

Kota is the only broker that runs employee benefits for you. Combining health cover, pensions, protection, spend cards, and flexible perks with HRIS integrations, Kota replaces spreadsheets, manual admin, and once-a-year broker calls with one connected system - backed by a team of benefits experts behind every recommendation.

Kota powers benefits for more than 100,000 employees, across companies from fast-growing scale-ups to global HR and payroll platforms.

Investors include Eurazeo, EQT Ventures, Northzone, Frontline Ventures, 9Yards, and Plug and Play Ventures. The Kota team includes experts who previously led at global financial services firms and fintechs such as Airwallex, Stripe, Bolt, Revolut - as well as insurance and benefits providers such as Aviva, Allianz, AXA, and Smart Pension.

The Role

We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.

You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.

That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.

What You'll Do

• Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built

• Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets

• Shape and lead 6-week cycles for new features and provider integrations

• Simplify insurer onboarding, plan setup, premium management and benefit workflows

• Translate compliance and underwriting complexity into flows people complete

• Work across the whole business. Support, success, sales and operations all have a stake in what you own

• Help shape what the product areas become as we add products and enter new markets

• Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it

What We're Looking For

• Ideally product experience at lead, staff or principal level. If you are a strong senior product person and the rest lines up then this could work

• An entrepreneurial streak. You've founded something, worked at an early-stage startup, or spent time in engineering before moving into product

• You've owned the vision and strategy for an area, not just executed against someone else's

• Comfortable with fluid scope. You've picked up an unfamiliar domain before and become useful quickly

• Genuine AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in how you work, not just aware of them. We're an AI native company and this is part of the job, not a nice to have.

• Genuine cross-business collaboration. You've worked with support, success and sales, not only with engineers and designers with the occasional customer call

• You come from an environment with a high quality bar. It usually shows in the product itself

• Clear, concise communication, spoken and written, focused on value and outcomes rather than process

• Scale-up experience, roughly Series A to D. Seed-stage experience on top of that is a plus

• Comfortable managing people, or ready to start

• Domain experience. Fintech or Insurtech is the closest match to what you'll work on, then HR tech, benefits, employee expenses or travel. Anything sold to an employer that employees then use. The business model matters more than the industry label: if you've had to serve both an HR buyer and the employees using the product, that's the experience we care about

Not every box needs ticking. We'd rather see someone strong on several of these and light on others than someone who technically matches everything.

Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things simple and respectful of your time.

• Screening call (30 mins) with our talent team: your background, what you're looking for, and the practicalities

• Competency interview (30 mins) with one of our Product Leads, covering how you work, what you've owned and how you make product calls

• Task session (60 mins) with our GM and Product Lead, working through a real problem together

• Call with founders (30 mins) with our CEO and CTO: our vision, and your thoughts on it

Our Values

• Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won’t jeopardise our how.

• Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

• Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

• Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team’s standards.

• Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm – now we do this everyday.

Kota Benefits

• Attractive stock options to share in the success of Kota

• Health Insurance

• Life assurance (country dependent)

• Up to 5% matched contribution to a Workplace Pension (country dependent)

• WFH stipend to support your home office needs

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

The best product leads don’t choose between building and coaching. They do both, in the same week.

Online Donations is how donors give to nonprofits through Fundraise Up: Checkout Modal & Elements, Campaign Pages, and Gift Cart. As Lead Product Manager, you own the long-term direction of this product line, run a product area yourself, and make a team of 2–4 Product Managers stronger. Your work shapes how fast and easily millions of donors can give, and how much more nonprofits raise because of it. About 70% of your time is hands-on product work; the other 30% is leading people and the team.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the long-term strategic roadmap for Online Donations, built together with your PMs, and make sure their quarterly plans ladder up to it. Present and defend it with the Director of Core Products & Platform, the VP of Product, and cross-functional partners.

• Own a product area end to end: discovery, specs, delivery, and metrics (conversion, adoption, GPV, reliability).

• Write the cross-team specifications no single PM can own alone, making scope, dependencies, sequencing, and risks explicit, and set the bar for spec quality on your team.

• Step in for any PM during vacation, overload, or a critical launch so their area keeps moving at the same quality.

• Coach 2–4 Product Managers through weekly 1:1s, concept and spec reviews, growth plans, and performance reviews, and take part in hiring and onboarding new PMs.

• Build a continuous discovery culture: talk to nonprofits and donors regularly, run market and competitor analysis, and make sure roadmap decisions trace back to evidence.

• Own your team’s operating rhythm (planning, spec reviews, demos, retros) and improve predictability, cycle time, and review rounds over time.

• Help your PMs align across Engineering, Design, Analytics, and neighbouring teams, and set up how they work with GTM (Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support) on launch readiness, enablement, and feedback loops.

• At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research, synthesis, spec writing, and communication, and helping your PMs adopt AI-enabled workflows.

Skills And Qualifications

• 6+ years in Product Management

• 2+ years leading or mentoring Product Managers, ideally including running performance reviews

• A strong individual track record: products you owned end to end, with measurable results

• Excellent spec writing, including complex specs that span several teams or systems

• Hands-on continuous discovery: regular customer interviews, market and competitor analysis, and turning insights into decisions

• Experience building and managing a long-term strategy and roadmap across several related products

• Proven ability to drive cross-team initiatives without formal authority, including work with GTM teams on launches and enablement

• Experience setting up team processes (planning, rituals, delivery tracking) and improving them based on results

• Strong analytical mindset: you define metrics and make data-informed decisions

• Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, designers, and leadership

• Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

• Experience in B2B SaaS or high-growth technology companies

• Experience with online donations, fundraising, payments, or checkout products — conversion-focused flows used by end customers

• Experience with platform or API products

• Experience using AI in day-to-day product work

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Still love writing the hard spec yourself, even when you lead a team

• Measure your success by how much less your PMs need you over time

• Talk to customers because you want to, not because a process says so

• Switch between your own work and someone else’s without losing quality or patience

• Give direct feedback and ask for it in return

• Spot a dependency early and fix it before it becomes a release-day surprise

• Care more about the outcome than about who gets credit

• Keep trying new tools and better ways of working, AI included

Please note that final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

jobs.title: Responsable de Producto (Technical Product Manager)

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

World Courier moves time-critical, life-saving pharma shipments across the globe, and our customer portal is where customers experience that service. You will own the product that reshapes how customers interact with us. This is a high-visibility role with full product accountability: you will lead the evolution of a live global platform into a next-generation, AI-enabled, multi-market digital experience.

Why this role matters

Customer portals are central to how customers interact with World Courier—placing orders, tracking shipments, and accessing critical logistics information. This role ensures that our customer portals evolve into integrated, consistent, and user-centric digital experiences, reducing reliance on manual interactions and enabling scalable, self-service capabilities across regions and markets.

Many customer interactions still happen by email and phone. You will make digital the preferred channel through an intuitive, scalable self-service experience. Your success will be measured by customer satisfaction and by the growth of self-service adoption.

What You’ll Own

• Product ownership: You will have full accountability for the vision, backlog and outcomes of our customer portal products, working closely with the business Product Manager and the Product Group Manager.

• Squad leadership: You will lead a multidisciplinary squad of business analysts, engineers, design and QA in an agile setup. You will set direction, prioritize by customer and business value, and keep delivery continuous.

• Product scope: You will take our live global portal into new markets and channels, and into a reimagined user experience.

• AI-enabled experience: You will identify and deliver practical AI use cases that improve customer experience and efficiency, applying responsible AI principles in a regulated industry.

• Collaboration: You will partner with peer Product Owners and integration teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer journeys.

What Success Looks Like

• Higher customer satisfaction (NPS).

• A measurable shift from manual to self-service interactions.

• Successful launch of new markets, channels and capabilities.

• Visible AI-driven improvements to customer and operational outcomes.

• Continuous value delivery with strong stakeholder alignment.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in product ownership or management, with a strong track record in agile environments.

• Experience leading cross-functional squads without formal line management.

• Proven delivery of customer-facing digital products such as portals or web and mobile applications.

• Hands-on experience shaping or delivering AI-enabled features, turning emerging capabilities into practical outcomes.

• Strong stakeholder management across executives, business and technology teams in a global, matrixed organization.

• Comfort working across cultures and time zones.

• Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, pharma or logistics is highly desirable.

• Agile or product certifications (CSPO, SAFe PO or similar) are a plus.

• English proficiency at C1 level or higher (written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

Why join us

• Own a flagship, high-visibility product with real decision-making authority.

• Join a re-imagined, product-led IT function driving digital transformation.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Project Overview:
The Product Manager owns the end-to-end Software CRM product vision and roadmap across the CRM++ value stream, including:

• Single CRM Consolidation

• Entitlements

• Sales Compensation

• WXP Hardening

• Master Data

• SFDC R&M

This is a generalized role, as the detailed delivery plan has not yet been finalized. The Product Manager is expected to set strategic direction, drive prioritization as the roadmap evolves, and adapt the product strategy as business needs and delivery plans become clearer.
Key responsibilities include defining Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) for cross-program initiatives, aligning business outcomes with technical solution architecture, and leading end-to-end product governance through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and steering committee updates with L3/L4 Sponsors.

The role also involves coordinating roadmap alignment with the Program Manager and driving cross-organizational product strategy alignment across Digital, EO, HPS, CO, Print, Software Sales, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy & Multi-Cloud Roadmap

• Platform Vision: Align business objectives, such as accelerating deal velocity and reducing customer support resolution times, with appropriate Salesforce cloud solutions.

• Multi-Cloud Strategy: Define how Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Revenue Cloud (CPQ) work together within the enterprise architecture.

• Feature vs. Buy vs. Standard Evaluation: Determine when to leverage standard Out-of-the-Box (OOTB) functionality, purchase third-party AppExchange solutions, or invest in custom Apex/LWC development.

2. Technical Strategy & AI/Automation Governance

• Agentic & AI Workflows: Define the strategy for implementing Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder, to automate multi-step business processes.

• Data Architecture Strategy: Partner with Enterprise Architects to leverage Data Cloud or external data lakes/warehouses, ensuring clean, real-time data flows into Salesforce and enabling unified operational reporting.

• Technical Debt Reduction: Govern custom code, legacy workflows, and Apex triggers while driving the transition toward standard platform automation, such as Flow Orchestration, to reduce release and maintenance overhead.

3. Stakeholder Management & Value Realization

• Executive & Business Alignment: Translate complex business requirements into scalable platform capabilities, acting as the primary liaison between business units (Sales, Support, Marketing, and Operations) and IT/Engineering.

• ROI & Value Tracking: Measure post-release business outcomes, including lead-to-opportunity conversion, user adoption, time-to-close, and platform cost per user.

• Trade-Off Negotiation: Balance competing priorities across revenue-generating and operational teams, translating strategic objectives into actionable MVPs and implementation phases.

4. Release Management & Ecosystem Alignment

• Salesforce Release Strategy: Evaluate Salesforce platform releases, identify high-value features, plan sandbox regression testing, and incorporate relevant capabilities into the product backlog.

• Vendor & AppExchange Governance: Manage third-party SaaS vendors, AppExchange licenses, and integrations connected to the Salesforce environment.

• License & Capacity Planning: Monitor platform limits, including API calls, storage, custom objects, and license allocations, to optimize total cost of ownership (TCO).

5. Agile Backlog & Delivery Supervision

• Epic & User Story Definition: Structure high-level epics, user journeys, and technical dependencies for Salesforce developers, architects, and administrators.

• Sprint Execution Oversight: Collaborate closely with Salesforce Product Owners and Scrum Masters during sprint planning, backlog refinement, and acceptance validation.

Job Requirements

• 7+ years of Product Management / Salesforce product experience in enterprise SaaS environments, with demonstrated Principal-level product thinking.

• Deep, hands-on Salesforce platform expertise covering Funnel Management, Forecasting, Renewals, Entitlements, Master Data, and WXP (Partner/Subscription ecosystem).

• Deep end-to-end Software CRM ecosystem expertise.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, including Lead-to-Cash processes and capabilities.

• Strong enterprise product management skills, including roadmap prioritization, trade-off analysis, and frameworks such as MoSCoW and RICE.

• Proven experience managing multiple VP-level stakeholders and presenting to L3/L4 Sponsors and steering committees.

• Data-driven decision-making skills and experience working with Salesforce dashboards, Tableau, and Excel forecasting models.

• Understanding of adjacent enterprise platforms and processes, including:

• WXP (Subscription)

• SAP OTC

• MDM/MADO

• CPQ/IQ

• Neuron

• Contractual and Transactional Selling

Nice to Have:

• AI/ML product experience, particularly Agentforce, Einstein, and Generative AI use cases in Sales and Service.

• HP or Fortune 100 technology industry experience in enterprise-scale CRM/Salesforce Product Management.

• SAFe or Scaled Agile Product Management certification.

Benefits:
General benefits:

• Hybrid work model combining office & remote work (2-3 days from the office in Sant Cugat del Vallès)

• Attractively located office with collaboration spaces

• Onsite parking space for employees

Lifestyle benefits:

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Real Estate
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe , smart , and environmentally responsible .

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX And See How Far You Can Go.

The Opportunity

OLX is looking for a Principal Product Manager to drive high-impact, zero-to-one initiatives across our Real Estate business (otodom.pl, imovirtual.com and storia.ro). This is a builder role focused on creating new value - not a people-management role. It's well-suited for someone who thrives on building new things, moving fast, and navigating a complex organisation to turn ideas into impact.

You'll lead 2–3 special initiatives in parallel, each scoped over 6–24 months. These could range from developing AI-driven capabilities and new monetisation models to building new product features that drive growth. We're hiring for mindset, not a fixed checklist.

You'll join the product leadership team and contribute to strategic direction across the area. The focus is on building, pushing, and delivering new value, complementing a team that excels at running and optimising the core business.

This role reports to the Director of Product and can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland. Remote work is possible within these countries.

What You'll Do

• Lead zero-to-one initiatives from concept to market validation to scaled delivery - own the vision, strategy, and execution.

• Build with AI as a daily lever - prototypes, agent-augmented workflows, AI-powered discovery and experimentation.

• Run lean experiments to prove product-market fit fast, with minimal bureaucracy.

• Present and defend your concepts to senior stakeholders - building alignment through evidence and conviction.

• Navigate a matrixed organisation: identify opportunities to move quickly, build coalitions, and drive progress without waiting for perfect alignment.

• Own the business case: connect product decisions to revenue and margin impact.

• Raise the bar for product craft across the team - set the standard through your work, share methods and examples, and act as a role model for what high-quality product thinking looks like in practice.

What We're Looking For

• 8+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of building and launching new products from zero to one - not just optimising what exists.

• AI native - you build with AI in your personal and professional life.

• Entrepreneurial DNA - uncomfortable with "business as usual," driven to create new value.

• Fast and execution-driven - moves at pace, ships quickly, and creates momentum rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

• High product craft - rigorous discovery, lean experimentation, strong narratives, data-driven decision-making.

• Strong executive presence - able to defend a concept to senior directors and build alignment.

• Business and financial acumen - unit economics, P&L thinking, ROI-informed decisions.

• Ability to drive multiple initiatives in parallel with minimal oversight.

• Marketplace or two-sided marketplace experience is a plus.

• Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.

• Willingness to travel approximately every two months.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Payments Platform
jobs.description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!

Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.

What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!

Who We Are

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.

Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.

With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager for Payment Orchestration and Connectivity to help build the intelligence and connectivity at the core of Flywire's global payments platform.

This is a senior and highly influential individual contributor role for a payments platform leader who understands how to route and optimise money movement across card networks, processors, acquirers, banks and global payment rails.

The initial mandate is to build smart routing and optimisation across payment acceptance. The broader charter spans reusable connectivity and orchestration capabilities across pay-ins and bank payments through to payouts.

This is a strategic platform role. Partnering with senior leaders across the business, you will build a connected end to end three year vision and strategy for the platform. You will identify and evaluate opportunities across payment methods, rails, processors and banks. From there you will build the business case for investment and advise leaders on where the greatest customer and commercial impact lies. In close partnership with engineering, you will shape the product and architecture strategy for routing, provider connectivity, normalised APIs and payment lifecycle visibility.

You will turn complex payment economics and performance data into clear priorities and a platform roadmap grounded in what customers need. Your work will influence multiple product teams and help build capabilities that scale across markets and business models as well as payment flows.

You bring deep experience in payment processing and provider connectivity, including cards and bank rails such as ACH or SEPA. You can move comfortably between commercial strategy and technical architecture. You are able to influence senior stakeholders and make sound investment decisions when things are complex or ambiguous.

What You'll Do

Strategy and Roadmap: Own the routing and orchestration roadmap. Partner with domain PMs to shape an integrated platform roadmap that connects shared capabilities, dependencies and sequencing across acceptance, pricing, onboarding, risk and payouts, recommending cross domain tradeoffs where needed.

Smart Routing: Build intelligent routing that improves authorisation rates, reliability, conversion and processing economics.

Global Connectivity: Shape scalable connectivity across processors, acquirers, card networks and banks, covering rails such as ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments and other regional systems.

Platform Architecture: Establish normalised payment APIs with consistent lifecycle states and provider outcomes across card and bank payments.

Orchestration: Extend common orchestration capabilities across both pay-ins and payouts over time.

Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Treasury, Operations and Commercial teams to deliver a resilient global payments platform.

Qualifications

Who we're looking for:

Product Leadership: A senior, hands on product leader who has built payment processing, orchestration, routing or gateway platforms at scale.

Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of how money moves end to end, including acceptance, settlement, refunds, returns, reconciliation and payouts.

Integration Experience: A proven track record integrating with processors, acquirers, card networks, banks and alternative payment providers.

Payment Rails Knowledge: Strong knowledge of card payments alongside bank rails such as ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, wires or real time payment networks.

Platform and Data Mindset: Strong platform thinking, with the ability to turn fragmented provider and rail capabilities into consistent, reusable products. Metrics driven and experienced in using data and experimentation, including intelligent decisioning, to improve payment performance.

Influence and Execution: Able to set strategy and drive execution across multiple teams without relying on direct authority.

Language and Location: Professional fluency in written and spoken English. You must hold valid authorisation to work in Spain.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

• Competitive time off

• Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media

• Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates

• Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact

• Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)

Submit today and get started!

We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.

Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Principal Data Product Manager
jobs.description:
This role welcomes full remote or hybrid work arrangements. However, applicants must be based in Spain, Italy or France and have a work permit to be considered .

About Launchmetrics

Launchmetrics is the leading Brand Performance Cloud used by Fashion, Lifestyle and Beauty (FLB) executives to make smarter decisions around their branding efforts.

With over a decade of industry expertise, we have helped more than 1,200 customers create inspiring, impactful and measurable experiences.

Founded in NYC and with operating headquarters in Paris, we have employees in ten markets worldwide and offer support in five languages. We have been the trusted brand performance technology to brands worldwide such as Dior, Fendi, Shiseido, NET-A-PORTER and Adidas as well as industry partners like IMG, the Council of Fashion Designers of America, the British Fashion Council, and Camera Nazionale Della Moda Italiana.

How we work: pods and crafts

We recently moved our Product and Tech teams to a pod model, and it changes the shape of this job in ways worth understanding before you apply.

• A pod is a small group, 1 to 4 people, that owns a single mission end to end: from scoping and building through cleaning, enablement and watching adoption. Pods form around a mission and dissolve when it's done. Everyone is a pod owner, from the most junior person to the most senior, because ownership is the point.

• Your craft is your main area of expertise: Design, Tech, or Data. It's the discipline you go deep in.

• Your domain is your product-area home, the part of our software suite you know best. Pods change with every mission; your craft and your domain don't.

About The Role

We're looking for a Principal Data Product Manager with a Data expertise to own missions on our Data Collection and Enrichment Systems.

At Launchmetrics, the core of our Metrics value comes from the data we deliver through our SaaS solution. Our client buy data as much as they buy access to a platform.

The Data Collection and Enrichment domain is in charge of collecting the data, enriching it and making it accessible in an efficient and reliable manner to the other domains. If you like the idea of owning a problem end to end, care about data quality the way other people care about pixel alignment, and want to work on forward thinking and AI centric projects, this role is for you.

As a Principal Data Product Manager here, you'll own missions on that domain from scoping to adoption, and you'll be one of the references for building our Data strategy, with the support of our VP Product. You operate as a fully autonomous pod owner.

What You'll Do

• Talk to your users. A lot. Turn the needs of customers and internal teams into product requirements that can be measured, and work with engineers day to day to deliver them.

• Own missions end to end. Scope, build with the pod, enable and monitor adoption for Data Platform missions, keeping a clear source of truth so everyone can see where things stand.

• Master our data flow. Work across acquisition, enrichment (manual, rule-based and AI-based) and management (datalake, APIs) to make data delivery faster and more reliable.

• Measure what matters. Define the metrics and KPIs for adoption and performance of what you build, then actually analyse them and feed the learnings back into prioritisation.

• Keep an eye on the market. Stay close to the competitive landscape and where brand measurement is heading, and let that sharpen your thinking.

• Collaborate with stakeholders. Collaborate with engineers, business stakeholders and leadership, speaking the right language to each.

• Raise the bar around you. Contribute to shared tooling and processes, and help the data domain get sharper over time.

What We're Looking For

This role sits at the Principal stage of our framework. Concretely, that means:

• Experience. Around 5 and 10 years in product management or data management, ideally shipping alongside engineers in a SaaS environment.

• Deep in Data. You're fluent in SQL and comfortable with data modelling, pipelines and APIs. You understand the data lifecycle, from acquisition to delivery, and you can assess and improve the quality of what flows through it. A few years working on data, analytics or data-product problems alongside engineers.

• Business sense. You understand our industry and our customers well enough to know why one kind of data matters to them and another doesn't, and you're curious about the branding challenges fashion and luxury brands face.

• A real discovery instinct. You start from the problem, not the solution, and you're happy talking to users and turning fuzzy needs into something measurable.

• Self-sufficient across crafts. You're not a designer or a PM, but you can do enough product thinking and rough interface reasoning to keep a small pod moving without waiting for someone else.

• Clear and trusted. You communicate simply with both technical and business people, follow through on what you own, and people come to rely on you as the reference for your scope.

• Clear communication and fluent English. You can explain your thinking, you're comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and you're keen to learn. Our team is international; other languages are a welcome bonus.

WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW

In the Product team, people grow by going deeper in their craft and by expanding their scope across five stages (Junior, Mid, Senior, Principal, Lead), and by taking on modular add-on responsibilities (Ops, Client Representativity, Strategy, Management).

As a Principal Product Manager, you can already pick up the Ops add-on (owning a shared tool, or a Claude skill) and some Strategy responsibilities. We're looking for someone who can grow into leading our Data strategy, so there are a few more stages ahead. As it progresses, expect a deeper focus on Strategy, along with new areas like Management and Client Representativity.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

• Intro call with Talent Acquisition, to get to know each other (30 min).

• Meet & Greet with Hiring Manager on the team, the domain and the pod model.

• Brainstorming session with our PMs

• Data and Product case you prepare, then present to a couple of PMs: a real data problem, scoped and reasoned through.

• Team fit with the engineers and peers you'd build alongside.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE LAUNCHMETRICS

We're a company that prioritizes people, fostering a relaxed yet dynamic atmosphere. Our international team is filled with enthusiastic, motivated individuals who enjoy their work. Autonomy empowers our team members, allowing them to make a substantial difference in our business, for our customers, and within our organization. When you become part of our team, you'll have access to growth and advancement possibilities, including a learning and development allowance, a benefits package tailored to each location, and flexible work arrangements, along with support for establishing your home office and other perks.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're hiring a Product Manager to own partner integrations at ClickHouse . This role owns how ClickHouse shows up inside the platforms our customers already use: embedded, native experiences across the hyperscalers and developer platforms, and deeper technical integrations with strategic partners like dbt, Fivetran, Hex, and Sigma. There is a growing surface of partner work already in motion, and this role shapes where we invest in co-innovation opportunities.

This is one of the most cross-functional roles at ClickHouse. You'll work across multiple engineering teams, our partnerships and solutions teams, and the partners themselves to deliver meaningful co-innovation and integrations with complementary technologies. You'll own the technical side of our House Mates partner program and be the person who navigates the multi-org reality of getting an integration certified, listed, and live. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the specs, run the partner calls, drive certification processes, and coordinate across teams to get things over the line.

You Will

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ClickHouse's Cloud integrations with strategic partners

• Seek out complementary innovation opportunities with partners. Define what a "better together" integration looks like with each strategic partner, and drive it from joint roadmap through launch.

• Navigate the trade-offs of embedded integrations: billing and metering, identity and auth, security and data residency, and coordination across ClickHouse and partner teams.

• Project-manage complex, multi-org launches: marketplace listings, certification processes, partner co-marketing, and GA timelines across multiple organizations.

• Own the technical standards and certification criteria for integrations submitted through the House Mates partner program.

• Measure and communicate co-innovation business impact, adoption and product strategy to executive leadership.

• Represent ClickHouse externally at partner events and in joint content.

You Bring

• Experience shipping integrations into third-party platforms before: hyperscaler marketplaces, embedded or native integrations, ISV partnerships, or OEM/white-label work.

• An understanding of the trade-offs that make or break a partner integration, billing, auth, security, cross-team dependencies, and have made those decisions in the past.

• A strong project management lens and are comfortable owning a launch that depends on five teams across two companies.

• Patience and resilience with partners who are unresponsive or have their own competing priorities, and you find creative ways to keep things moving anyway.

• Technical ability to understand an integration end to end, from provisioning and auth to billing and data flow, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about APIs, architecture, and technical trade-offs.

• Energy and excitement for external-facing work: partner calls, customer conversations, and representing the product publicly.

• Hands-on and high ownership ability. You write the specs, run the partner calls, and stay close to the details.

• Comfort in ambiguity and fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience building partner integrations with hyperscalers and modern technology companies.

• Experience running or supporting a technology partner program.

• Background at a database or data infrastructure company; familiarity with ClickHouse or peers like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.

• Experience working in remote, multi-timezone environments.

Perks

• Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

• Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

• Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

• Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

• A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

• Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Compensation Range: $210K - $310K

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Product Lead | 100% Remote within Europe
jobs.description:
About Docplanner And Noa

Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets.

Within Docplanner, Noa Is On a Mission To Help People Live Longer, Healthier Lives. We Build AI That Works Alongside Doctors To

• Remove their administrative work.

• Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most.

• Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context.

We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care.

The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role.

About The Role

You’ll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—ensuring what we build fits clinical workflows and earns doctors’ trust.

This isn’t a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor clinical-product role. You will:

• Shape doctor-facing products by bringing real clinical needs and workflows into product decisions.

• Bring clinical judgment to what we build, including what is correct, useful and safe.

Because you’re a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you’ll help establish how clinical expertise informs Docplanner’s AI products.

You’ll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.

What you’ll do

Shape what we build

• Bring how doctors really work—their habits, workflows and administrative realities—into the product.

• Talk to doctors across specialties and working styles, and turn candid feedback into product decisions.

• Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to prioritise and ship improvements, then learn from how doctors use them.

Bring clinical judgment into the product

• Help define what correct, useful and safe looks like for our doctor-facing AI products.

• Review prompts, outputs, clinical templates and workflows, and identify clinically meaningful failure modes.

• Turn clinician feedback and evaluation findings into product and model improvements with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.

Keep it safe and scalable

• Work with Product, ML/LLM, Regulatory and the PRRC to align product intent, evidence, risks and controls.

• Build practical feedback loops with practising clinicians and our consultant-doctor network.

What we’re looking for

• A medical degree and at least 2 years of direct clinical practice. Active licensure and current practice are not required.

• Meaningful experience shaping and shipping a doctor-facing or clinical product, either as a clinical product leader or a clinician-founder/builder.

• You personally owned product decisions, worked directly with Product, Design and Engineering, and shipped something clinicians used.

• You’ve turned clinical problems into product decisions—not just provided advice, review or governance.

• You combine strong clinical judgment with doctor discovery, workflow understanding and a focus on trust and adoption.

• You communicate clearly and directly across clinical, product, technical, regulatory and leadership teams.

• You’re comfortable operating independently as a senior, hands-on contributor in a lean cross-functional team.

• You actively use generative AI and understand its potential and limitations. Hands-on experience with prompting, output review or AI-assisted development tools is valuable.

Bonus: Experience with ambient documentation, clinical templates, medical-knowledge systems, clinical coding or regulated Software as a Medical Device.

What success looks like after 6 months

• A clear, evidence-backed view of the priority doctor workflows and product opportunities Noa should address.

• Product improvements shipped based on doctor discovery, feedback and observed usage.

• Clear clinical quality expectations and feedback loops established with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.

Why join Noa at Docplanner

• Real impact at real scale: Your work reaches hundreds of thousands of doctors and their patients.

• Shape what comes next: You’ll influence what Noa and Docplanner’s AI products become—and whether doctors and patients trust them.

• Ship to learn: A feature in front of users beats another month of planning.

• Work flexibly: The role is 100% remote across eligible European locations, subject to local hiring arrangements.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Internal Developer Platform
jobs.description:
This is an internal developer platform role. It is not identity and access management, and it is not a customer-facing product.

You are starting from nothing. There is no platform today, no tooling chosen and no templates written. The first decisions about what gets built, what gets bought and what a golden path looks like are yours to make with the engineering team.

Agentic AI is part of the build, not a separate thing. The platform needs to be something AI agents can act on as well as people — what gets exposed to them, what doesn’t, and how that stays governed.

Please read this before applying. We’ve had a lot of applications from people doing adjacent work, and we’d rather save you the time.

This is not an identity role. If your background is SSO, authentication, access management, identity governance or identity providers, that’s a different discipline and a different team. We are hiring IAM engineers separately.

This is not a customer-facing product role. If you’ve owned a product sold to external customers, that isn’t this. Our "customers" are internal stakeholders and technical.

You should have shipped the thing developers actually use — a portal, a service catalogue, templates or scaffolders, SDKs, developer documentation — not only an operating model, a roadmap or an investment case for a platform somebody else built.

If you’ve run a developer portal, tell us which one and what you did with it. Backstage, Port, Cortex, Choreo or OpenChoreo, or something built in-house. Tell us what was in the catalogue and what a developer could do from it without asking anyone.

Tell us your adoption numbers. How many engineers used what you built, how that changed, and how long it took a team to get something running before and after. If you measure your work in features shipped rather than friction removed, we’re probably not a fit.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. We deliver award-winning enterprise software solutions through the use of embedded digital innovation and a single cloud-based platform to help businesses be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™.

At IFS, we're flexible, we're innovative, and we're focused not only on how we can engage with our customers, but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society's greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and accept that there are so many different perspectives in this world. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We're looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs.

If you want to change the status quo, we'll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

Our customers are internal and technical: developers, architects, platform engineers, system administrators

and implementation teams.

You'll understand their workflows, friction points and adoption barriers

deeply, build named relationships with the ones who matter most, and treat their day-to-day

experience — from APIs and SDKs to documentation and onboarding — as the truest measure of

whether the product is working.

Own the problem, the customer and the outcomes for a programme or product line — you set the what and the why, and partner with engineering and architects on the how.

• Live in your customers' world — lead discovery with developers, architects and platform

engineers, build deep named partnerships, and turn real evidence into a prioritised, outcomedriven roadmap.

• Advocate relentlessly for developer experience — API and SDK usability, documentation

quality, onboarding and adoption — as the measure of product success, and get ahead of

needs customers haven't yet named.

• Translate customer needs and business strategy into clear, testable requirements and

acceptance criteria the team can build against with confidence — and set the standard for

how that's done across the team.

• Make the prioritisation and trade-off calls that balance immediate customer value with longterm product health, drawing on technical trade-offs such as build vs buy, scalability and

extensibility without getting lost in them.

• Use AI as a force multiplier across discovery, analysis and documentation, and raise the bar

for how the team applies it — while the product judgement stays yours.

• Partner with architects and engineers as an equal, challenge assumptions constructively, and

be the product partner they seek out to make hard calls faster and with less friction.

• Coach and mentor other product managers, share what you learn, and lift the practice around

you rather than holding knowledge to yourself

Qualifications

• A genuine product mindset — you think in customer outcomes, adoption and business value,

not in features or technology for its own sake.

• Deep obsession with your customers — here, developers, architects and platform engineers

— and a track record of advocating for their experience and shifting product direction because

of it.

• Substantial product management experience in B2B enterprise, platform, developer or

infrastructure products, with a record of independently owning outcomes at programme or

product-line level.

• Proven customer discovery and co-creation skills, and the ability to turn real evidence into a

Clear Roadmap And Requirements Others Build Against.

• Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with engineering and architecture — you can read

APIs, schemas, logs and code to understand impact (writing production code is not required).

• Confidence making prioritisation and trade-off decisions, and the influence to align engineers,

architects and senior stakeholders without authority.

• Excellent communication — you translate technical complexity into business language and

business strategy into clear product direction, and present confidently to leadership.

• Experience coaching or mentoring other PMs, and setting standards the team adopts.

• An AI-first way of working, and the judgement to know where AI helps and where it doesn't.

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences.
