jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Document Domain
jobs.description:
PandaDoc is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Document Experience — redefining how professionals create, refine, collaborate on, and complete documents in an increasingly AI-driven world.
You’ll own the strategy and execution of PandaDoc’s core document experiences, shaping how structured content, collaboration, and intelligent assistance come together into cohesive workflows. Your work will help customers move faster from ideas to finalized agreements by making document creation more intuitive, adaptive, and connected.
This is a senior, hands-on role for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of user experience, platform systems, and applied AI. You’ll guide multiple squads, align cross-functional partners, and translate emerging technologies into scalable product systems — balancing exploration with disciplined delivery.
In this role, you will
• Lead high-impact initiatives across document creation, authoring and collaboration experiences.

• Shape cohesive end-to-end document workflows, ensuring users can move naturally from drafting to completion.

• Integrate AI capabilities directly into document experiences — including authoring, refinement, structure, and automation — with a focus on real user outcomes.

• Define product direction for modern document systems, blending structured content, intelligent assistance, and collaborative workflows.

• Partner closely with design, engineering, AI platform, and core platform teams on APIs, integrations, and data models that enable scalable experiences.

• Collaborate with other senior PMs to ensure consistent, connected journeys across PandaDoc.

• Drive continuous improvement through experimentation, customer feedback, and product telemetry.

• Shape the long-term direction of PandaDoc’s Document Domain, ensuring flexibility, coherence, and readiness for evolving AI-powered capabilities.

About You
• 7+ years of hands-on product management experience in B2B SaaS, ideally across document creation, productivity, collaboration, or content platforms.

• Proven experience owning complex user-facing domains end-to-end — from strategy through delivery and iteration.

• Familiar with document systems, structured content, and cross-format editing models (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or AI-generated content).

• Direct experience shipping AI-powered product features, including defining UX behavior, rollout strategies, and iteration based on real-world usage.

• Comfortable integrating AI into workflows thoughtfully, focusing on measurable user outcomes rather than standalone capabilities.

• Skilled in rapid discovery and iteration using prototypes, experiments, and AI-assisted tools.

• Demonstrated AI fluency — using AI for analysis, prototyping, and workflow automation, with strong judgment to translate ambiguous AI capabilities into dependable product experiences.

• Strong communicator who simplifies complexity, frames trade-offs clearly, and aligns cross-functional teams.

• Pragmatic and execution-oriented, balancing experimentation with prioritization and delivery discipline.

• Comfortable partnering with deeply technical teams on system design, APIs, and platform constraints.

Company Overview: PandaDoc empowers more than 67,000 growing organizations to thrive by taking the work out of document workflow. PandaDoc provides an all-in-one document workflow automation platform that helps fast scaling teams accelerate the ability to create, manage, and sign digital documents including proposals, quotes, contracts, and more. For more information, please visit https://www.pandadoc.com.
Company Culture: We're known for our work-life balance, kind co-workers, & creative virtual team-bonding events. And although our Pandas are located across the globe, we stay connected with the help of technology and ensure that everyone on our team feels, well, like a team.
Pandas work best when they're happy. We retain our talent by upholding our values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of our customers.
Check out our LinkedIn to learn more.
Benefits:
• Competitive salary. If you are based in Poland, the salary range is 31,000-40,000 PLN per month.

• Remote-first approach with the option for hybrid work from our offices in Kyiv, Warsaw, and Lisbon.

• We value long-term collaboration , whether through typical employment contract, employment of record or B2B arrangements. Be aware that contract type and benefits vary by location - feel free to clarify with our recruiters).

• Work schedule aligned with EU time zones.

• Honest, open culture that values constructive feedback.

• Professional and personal development within a collaborative, supportive team.

• Stable yet growing SaaS product offering an agile environment, ownership, start-up energy, and strong technical challenges.

PandaDoc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal treatment of all employees without regard to race, national origin, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, physical or mental disability or other basis protected by law.

EXTERNAL RECRUITERS
Approval Requirement
The use of external recruiters/staffing agencies requires prior approval from our HR Team. The HR Team at PandaDoc requests that external recruiters/staffing agencies not to contact PandaDoc employees directly in an attempt to present candidates. Complying with this request will be a factor in determining future professional relationships with PandaDoc.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces
jobs.description:
ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Principal Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will lead that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces.

What You Will Do

• Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for billing, from usage metering through invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition, working alongside the product managers and engineering leads of our metering and pricing, billing platform, and payments teams.

• Evolve our metering and pricing foundation into a single metrics pipeline that new products can reuse, where the same metric can be priced differently by product and tier, and only net-new metrics need code changes.

• Evolve our prepaid commit capabilities, with flexibility for customer-specific rate cards or metric-level discounts, contract changes and rollovers, and customer-facing balance visibility and spend alerts.

• Own our cloud marketplace strategy and integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking.

• Lead the evaluation of billing architecture, from build versus buy decisions and POCs through migration plans and a clear recommendation to senior leadership.

• Give Finance, Data, and Sales Ops systems they can trust, including ERP and revenue recognition sync, period close, audit controls, and SOX and SOC 2 readiness.

• Partner with product teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and Support to launch billing for new products and pricing models, and serve as the company's subject matter expert on how customers are billed.

• Mentor other product managers and help build the team.

About You

• 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product.

• Deep expertise in usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and in how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue.

• Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, entitlements, metering APIs, and disbursements.

• Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, marketplace, and partner channels, including dunning and delinquency flows, fraud detection, and payment notifications.

• Strong understanding of order-to-cash, including invoicing, payment processing, tax, multi-currency, ERP integration, and revenue recognition.

• Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor.

• A track record of designing and maturing a product area from v1 and leading complex programs across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to executives and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points

• Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company.

• Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself.

• Speaking or published thought leadership on usage-based pricing, billing, or cloud marketplaces.

Perks

• Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence/Product Lead
jobs.description:
Are you a builder who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from talking to real users, and wants to turn emerging agentic AI capabilities into a product people actually rely on?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What You’ll Do

NoPressure is an early-stage startup within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. We started by using AI-powered simulations to help people practice high-stakes workplace conversations. Now, we're exploring how agentic AI and real-world context can provide personalized, moment-of-need practice and support at work.

We’re looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence / Product Lead to partner with our technical founder. This is a 0→1 role where you’ll define our vision and venture strategy. You’ll figure out who our ideal customer is, identify high-value use cases, and validate key hypotheses through rapid experimentation. Working alongside a small, fast-moving engineering team, you will shape both the product and how it gets to market, turning early signals into something organizations want to adopt.

Day To Day, You Will

• Define the product and venture strategy, identifying key uncertainties and deciding what to test and build first.

• Conduct continuous customer discovery to understand real workplace workflows, pain points, and behaviors.

• Pinpoint the most compelling ideal customer profile (ICP) and initial use cases for growth.

• Design and run lightweight experiments, prototypes, and agentic experiences to test hypotheses before committing full engineering resources.

• Establish clear metrics and evaluate commercial and behavioral evidence to decide whether to iterate, double down, or pivot.

• Shape positioning, messaging, and early acquisition or sales motions to bring the product to initial customers.

• Monitor market shifts, emerging agent architectures, and competitor developments to uncover new opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with the technical founder and engineering team to move quickly from ideas to shipped prototypes.

What You’ll Bring

• A builder mindset that favors quick prototypes and direct learning over waiting for perfect requirements.

• Deep curiosity about how people build new skills and navigate challenging interactions at work.

• Comfort operating with high autonomy, speed, and decision-making under uncertainty.

• Strong discovery skills that separate genuine demand and observed behavior from polite validation.

• Clear, direct communication skills for pitching to and working with senior decision-makers.

• Strong collaboration habits when partnering closely with engineering teams on AI-native products.

What You’ll Need

• A Track record of taking products or ventures from initial ambiguity to launch and early market adoption.

• Hands-on experience building, launching, or experimenting with AI/agentic products or emerging technologies.

• Demonstrated experience in early customer acquisition, founder-led sales, positioning, or commercialization.

• Experience in L&D, coaching, sales enablement, HR tech, or behavior-change products.

• The technical fluency required to evaluate agentic workflows and work directly alongside software engineers.

• End-to-end ownership experience across strategy, discovery, product development, and go-to-market strategy.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means rapidly turning market ambiguity into actionable direction. You will establish a validated ideal customer profile and high-value use cases through real user evidence rather than assumptions. You’ll build an experimental cadence that uncovers genuine demand early, helping the team ship an agentic AI experience that users regularly rely on and organizations actively invest in.

Why join JetBrains?

• Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

• Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.

• Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Spain | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Spain.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

• Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints

• Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs

• Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity

• Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options

• Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

• 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership

• Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics

• Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools

• Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships

• Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.

• Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

• Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries

• Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud

• Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models

• Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products

• Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners

• Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 106,680 - EUR 128,016. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist (CRO)
jobs.description:
About Adnovation

At Adnovation we develop and create innovative B2C membership-based entertainment products. Our team specializes in digital advertising, customer acquisition, and monetization of traffic through the most reliable payment, security, and advertising partners. We are part of EXOGROUP, a set of companies made up of +200 talents and offering a wide range of services within the digital business landscape with headquarters in Barcelona and offices in Dublin, Porto and Valencia.

About The Role

We are hiring a mid-senior Performance Marketing Specialist (CRO) profile to own two closely connected areas: paid acquisition and conversion rate optimization. You will launch, run and scale our paid media campaigns, and you will turn user insight into experiments and optimizations that make every visit count.

This is a hybrid role. You don't need to be a veteran in both disciplines but it is important that you understand the deep connection between them. You will work side by side with product, development, content, paid and organic channels, data and design and will report directly to the Head of Performance.

Your Mission

Paid Media

• Campaign ownership: launch, manage, optimize and scale Social Ads campaigns (Meta, TikTok), driving results month after month.

• Go-to-market: co-build the marketing launch strategy for new products with the team, and own the paid advertising GTM strategy end to end, autonomously.

• Tracking & signals: create and implement ad pixels and server-side Conversions API setups for Meta and TikTok (we use Stape).

• Creative strategy: propose marketing angles, messages, scripts and hooks for our ads, working with our in-house design team. No need to produce the ads yourself, unless you want to.

• Attribution & analysis: understand the user journey across touchpoints and use attribution models to make sound budget and optimization decisions.

CRO & Experimentation

• Experimentation program: run CRO and experimentation processes on our web and app products.

• Test setup: build and launch experiments in Convert, and read results with statistical rigor.

• User insight: when A/B testing isn't possible, insights still are. Run user and market research, behavioral analysis, and qualitative and quantitative analysis to find what to improve and why in both our web & app products.

• Wireframing: create wireframes of new ideas, using AI tools to move faster.

Across both areas

• Work AI-first: use AI as a daily assistant across paid media and CRO tasks, not only for automation.

• Measure what matters with GA4 and Google Tag Manager, and share clear, actionable insights with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

Paid Media

• Paid Social experience: proven track record (around 3+ years) launching, managing, optimizing and scaling campaigns on Meta and TikTok.

• Pixels & Conversions API: hands-on experience creating and implementing ad pixels and CAPI setups on Meta and TikTok. Stape experience is a plus.

• Go-to-market: experience launching products from scratch and owning the paid strategy of the launch.

• Attribution: solid understanding of attribution models and the analytical skills to map the user journey.

• Creativity: a strong ability to come up with ad angles, messages, scripts and hooks.

CRO & Experimentation

• CRO & experimentation: proven experience running CRO processes and randomized controlled experiments on web and also mobile apps.

• Research & analysis: experience with user and market research, behavioral analysis, and qualitative and quantitative methods.

• Testing tools: experience with Convert, VWO or similar tools.

• Statistics: working knowledge of hypothesis testing applied to A/B tests. You don't need to be a data analyst.

• UX & behavioral science: a strong understanding of users and of behavioral analysis in digital environments.

Across both areas

• Analytics: GA4 and Google Tag Manager are a must. Experience with product analytics and using tools like Amplitude or Mixpanel, is also needed.

• AI power user: you already use AI daily to assist your work, not only to automate it. At EXOGROUP we are AI-first and we give you the tools for it.

• Technical basics: basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and familiarity with SDK integrations and other technical aspects of mobile apps.

• Languages: good written and spoken English.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Google Ads.

• Experience with programmatic advertising or other platforms such as Taboola, Outbrain, DV360 or ExoClick.

• Experience with high-risk products.

• Experience with Amplitude and RevenueCat.

• Ability to query data in Google BigQuery for paid media and CRO analysis.

Who You Are

• A team player: you will work closely with developers, product, content, paid media and organic channels, data and design, and you enjoy it.

• A clear communicator: you make yourself understood and can explain complex concepts simply to non-technical stakeholders.

• Analytical and a problem solver: data-driven for real, not just on paper.

• Detail-oriented: you have a sharp eye for detail, from a tracking setup to a test variant.

What You'll Find At Adnovation

We offer the opportunity for permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth, and a competitive salary!

Most of all, we offer a position in a team that thrives on being successful and being industry leaders and innovators. If you have a winning mentality, this position is for you!

Experience our benefits ;)

• Private health care insurance

• Flexitime and Summer Schedule

• Your Birthday off as a paid holiday

• Flexible compensation plan: travel, meals & childcare

• Pension Plan

• Subsidized Catering

• English, Portuguese & Spanish language lessons

• Additional internal and external trainings through our EXOGROUP University program

• Access to quality trainings through the Udemy platform

• Training budget & study leave

• Subsidized Well-Being Activities

• Calm App subscription

jobs.title: Head of Growth at Koalendar
jobs.description:
Koalendar helps businesses, schools, and organizations make appointment scheduling simple. We’re an independent, bootstrapped SaaS with a generous free plan and a self-serve upgrade model.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Growth to help more people discover Koalendar, experience its value, become paying customers, and stay with us.

You’ll work directly with me, the founder, combining customer insight, data, and experimentation to decide where we should focus and turn those decisions into shipped improvements.

# What you’ll own

• Own our acquisition strategy: identify the customer segments, messages, and channels that can bring Koalendar more paying customers sustainably.

• Grow effective channels and test new ones , including opportunities in SEO, paid acquisition, affiliates, partnerships, and communities. Decide where to invest and what to stop.

• Improve our positioning, campaigns, website, and landing pages to attract the right users and turn more visitors into signups.

• Develop ways for the product itself to drive acquisition through shared booking pages, referrals, and team invitations.

• Improve activation, free-to-paid conversion, retention, and expansion , starting with the biggest opportunities in the customer journey.

• Lead experiments across onboarding, lifecycle emails, pricing, and upgrade flows , working directly with the founder on product changes.

• Personally build and launch work within your skill set , and use agencies and freelancers to extend your execution with clear briefs and measurable goals.

• Measure acquisition costs, channel performance, conversion, retention, and revenue. Use the evidence to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

We expect you to choose a few meaningful priorities at a time and follow them through.

# What we’re looking for
You’ve helped scale a comparable SaaS. Ideally, you’ve played a significant role in growing a freemium or self-serve SaaS from around $1m to $10m+ ARR. Comparable experience counts, particularly with a bootstrapped business, small-business customers, or similar subscription economics. We want to understand what you personally contributed.

You still enjoy doing the work. You can show things you’ve analyzed, written, built, launched, and improved yourself. You have particular depth in product growth, lifecycle marketing, or conversion, with enough acquisition experience to direct specialists well.

You’re comfortable with data and customers. You can investigate funnels and cohorts independently, spot measurement problems, and understand what the numbers cannot tell you. You also talk to users and turn what you learn into better experiences.

You have commercial judgment. You understand how acquisition costs, conversion, pricing, retention, and expansion fit together. You’re thoughtful about spending in a bootstrapped company.

You’re curious, dependable, and easy to work with. You bring ideas, ask good questions, communicate clearly, and follow through. You can challenge the founder constructively and change your mind when the evidence changes.

We’d also love to hear about something you took the initiative to create or improve, inside or outside your day job.

# Why join

• Direct collaboration with a technical founder who can help turn ideas into product changes.

• Meaningful influence over the product experience and how the business grows.

• A useful product serving a broad range of real scheduling needs.

• Remote work, room for focused execution, and the opportunity to build a lean growth function.

# Your first 90 days
You’ll establish a reliable view of the funnel, speak with customers, agree on the biggest opportunities, and ship a focused set of improvements.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
⛵ About our Crew

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance to join our Product team in Barcelona.

🚤 The role

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our monetization and compliance roadmap . You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our revenue and contribution margin , while keeping the product compliant on tax and invoicing .

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with finance, data, legal and operations , with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers , 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

🛟 What floats your boat

• Build a point of view: you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).

• Vision & Roadmap: you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.

• Compliance by design: you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.

• Data-driven decisions: you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.

• Decision making: you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.

• Fail fast, learn fast: you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

🧭 What you bring aboard

• Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.

• You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.

• A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.

• Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.

• Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.

• You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.

• Fluent or bilingual in English.

🌊 Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)

• Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.

• Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.

• Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

🗺 The hiring journey

• HR call with Talent Acquisition,

• Interview with the Product team,

• Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.

• Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

⚓️ What awaits you on board

• 🎯 A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;

• 🌱 Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;

• 🏖 8 additional days off;

• 🍽 Lunch vouchers (Cobee);

• 💪 Gym partnerships (Wellhub);

• ⛵ PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;

• 🥐 Breakfast every Tuesday morning;

• 🏢 A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;

• 🎉 Team-building activities;

• 💻 Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

Contract: Permanent position

Start date: ASAP

🪝 Ready to join?

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all. 🌊

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Amenitiz is the all-in-one software behind 15,000 independent hotels in Spain, Portugal, France and Italy. In 2026 we shipped more than ever: POS, Ami and Conversations, fiscal compliance in five countries, and integrations with OTAs, revenue management systems and POS providers.

Our product surface grew faster than three PMs can carry. You'll be the fourth, and you'll own a part of it end to end: from the opportunity, to the code, to hotels using it and paying for it.




HOW PMS WORK HERE

Our PMs open the repo. They prototype with Claude Code in days, ship fixes and small changes themselves, and bring engineers the hard problems with a working prototype in hand.

They spend hours every week with hoteliers: on calls, on visits, in the Care queue. They read their own data in SQL and Mixpanel. And a release is only the start: a feature is done when hotels use it and we can see it in the numbers.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - One initiative from our 18-month product plan, from idea to adopted, measured hotel by hotel

 - The adoption number for everything you ship

 - A set of hotels you know by name, and the partnerships your initiatives need

 - Launch enablement for Care, Onboarding, Account Management, Sales and Marketing

 - 


YOUR FIRST YEAR

 - Month 3: your own changes in production, and a prototype in front of real hotels

 - Month 6: your first major release live, with an activation target set before launch and tracked from day one

 - Month 12: an initiative that measurably moved revenue for a set of hotels, and the next 6-month roadmap for your area, written by you

 - 


YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years as a PM in B2B SaaS, including an initiative you built from scratch and the adoption or retention number it moved

 - Software you built and shipped yourself: prototypes with Claude Code or similar, and fixes merged to production. You can show us something real users used

 - Real time with customers, especially small-business owners, and the instinct to bring back what they'd pay for

 - Experience defining activation, reading the funnel yourself and fixing drop-off in the product

 - Full professional English

 - A base in Barcelona, or the will to move here: we work office-first from Plaça de Catalunya
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - A background in hospitality, travel, payments or compliance

 - Spanish, French, Italian or Portuguese

 - LLM or agent features in production

 - Experience running a big product surface with a small team
   
   


WHY JOIN

 - Own a chapter of an 18-month plan, at 15,000 hotels in four countries

 - Build with AI the way most PMs only read about

 - Join a team of four PMs where every one of them ships

 - Work with a direct line to our CPO and CEO

 - Live and work in Barcelona




OUR PROCESS

 1. A 30-minute call with Talent Acquisition

 2. 60 minutes with Marco Riedl, our CPO

 3. A 90-minute working session where you build: you get a real initiative 48 hours ahead (prep takes under 4 hours), prototype part of it live with Claude Code, and show how you'd measure its adoption

 4. 45 minutes with the team

 5. 45 minutes with our CEO

You'll hear from us after every step, whatever the outcome.

jobs.title: Senior Affiliate & Referral Growth Manager
jobs.description:
At Amenitiz, we help more than 15,000 independent hotels, B&Bs and guesthouses across Spain, Portugal, France and Italy compete with the chains and the OTAs. We have an established sales team and customers who love what we do for their business. What we don't have yet is an affiliate or a referral program.

As our Senior Affiliate & Referral Growth Manager, you'll build both from zero. And you'll be measured on one thing: paying customers.

This is a role with real ownership and real impact. The channels are yours: your strategy, your partners, your playbook. Your results show up directly in new MRR, and you'll work with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance from day one. You're joining a well-funded scale-up at the right moment: big enough to have the customers and data to build on, small enough that what you build becomes how Amenitiz grows.


YOUR MISSION

 - Launch an affiliate and partner channel with the consultants, agencies, industry creators, publishers and communities that independent hoteliers already trust.

 - Build a customer referral motion with our Account Managers: the right moment to ask, the right incentive, and the proof that it works.

The Team:

Celonis Demo Engineering is the creative and technical engine of our Go-To-Market strategy. We are embarking on a high-stakes mission to build the Next-Gen Demo Factory - a world where AI agents and LLMs handle the heavy lifting of demo creation.

This transformation is critical not only to maintain our lead in Process Intelligence but to ensure Celonis wins the Enterprise AI market. By feeding operational business context to AI, we enable the world’s largest companies to industrialize AI and unlock real ROI. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Product Lead | 100% Remote within Europe
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCPLANNER AND NOA

Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets.

Within Docplanner, Noa is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We build AI that works alongside doctors to:

 - Remove their administrative work.

 - Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most.

 - Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context.

We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care.

The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—ensuring what we build fits clinical workflows and earns doctors’ trust.

This isn’t a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor clinical-product role. You will:

 - Shape doctor-facing products by bringing real clinical needs and workflows into product decisions.

 - Bring clinical judgment to what we build, including what is correct, useful and safe.

Because you’re a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you’ll help establish how clinical expertise informs Docplanner’s AI products.

You’ll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


SHAPE WHAT WE BUILD

 - Bring how doctors really work—their habits, workflows and administrative realities—into the product.

 - Talk to doctors across specialties and working styles, and turn candid feedback into product decisions.

 - Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to prioritise and ship improvements, then learn from how doctors use them.


BRING CLINICAL JUDGMENT INTO THE PRODUCT

 - Help define what correct, useful and safe looks like for our doctor-facing AI products.

 - Review prompts, outputs, clinical templates and workflows, and identify clinically meaningful failure modes.

 - Turn clinician feedback and evaluation findings into product and model improvements with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.


KEEP IT SAFE AND SCALABLE

 - Work with Product, ML/LLM, Regulatory and the PRRC to align product intent, evidence, risks and controls.

 - Build practical feedback loops with practising clinicians and our consultant-doctor network.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - A medical degree and at least 2 years of direct clinical practice. Active licensure and current practice are not required.

 - Meaningful experience shaping and shipping a doctor-facing or clinical product, either as a clinical product leader or a clinician-founder/builder.

 - You personally owned product decisions, worked directly with Product, Design and Engineering, and shipped something clinicians used.

 - You’ve turned clinical problems into product decisions—not just provided advice, review or governance.

 - You combine strong clinical judgment with doctor discovery, workflow understanding and a focus on trust and adoption.

 - You communicate clearly and directly across clinical, product, technical, regulatory and leadership teams.

 - You’re comfortable operating independently as a senior, hands-on contributor in a lean cross-functional team.

 - You actively use generative AI and understand its potential and limitations. Hands-on experience with prompting, output review or AI-assisted development tools is valuable.

Bonus: Experience with ambient documentation, clinical templates, medical-knowledge systems, clinical coding or regulated Software as a Medical Device.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER 6 MONTHS

 - A clear, evidence-backed view of the priority doctor workflows and product opportunities Noa should address.

 - Product improvements shipped based on doctor discovery, feedback and observed usage.

jobs.title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion

Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a platform-led product company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

• CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today

• Data and Analytics

• Design and Engineering

• Compliance and Risk

• Clients directly

What you’ll do

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows

• The path from spot client → Hedge-active → policy client, and every drop-off point along it

• Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them

• Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing

• Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

Decision Tools for Clients

• Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies

• Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training

• Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence

• Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

Tooling for CPMs

• Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks

• Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses

• Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

Repeat Hedging & Policy

• Turning a first hedge into a second and a third

• Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month

• Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

Experimentation & Measurement

• A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog

• Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas

• Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

What success looks like (12-18 months)

• Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift

• A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation

• CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result

• Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called

• More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc

• Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

What makes this role hard

• You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.

• It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations

• The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.

• Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.

• You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.

• You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

Who we are looking for

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

Must-have:

• 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end

• Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests

• Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them

• Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

Nice-to-have:

• Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes

• Experience in fintech or regulated financial products

jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

The opportunity

Location: Madrid - we will only consider candidates already based in Madrid or open to relocation.

Fever is growing through acquisition as well as organically - we expect to bring more companies into the Fever family over the next few years. Each one arrives with its own product, its own codebase, and its own way of doing things. This role exists to make sure that growth actually compounds instead of creating fragmentation: someone who can walk into an acquired company's stack, understand what's genuinely differentiated versus redundant, and drive the decisions that turn "two products" into "one better product."

Fever already operates at global scale, and acquisitions are how we grow even faster. Every company that joins makes the whole group stronger: together, we’re far more than the sum of our parts.

Every company that joins brings talented teams, strong products and deep expertise in its market. The opportunity is to connect them on one Fever platform, so that what one company builds can power all the others, and every new company gets the scale of Fever from its first day with us.

That’s what this role is about. You’ll shape how the Fever group scales as a platform: the vision and architecture for the capabilities our companies share, the playbook that helps every new company get up and running with Fever, and the hands-on work of making each integration a success. You’ll work across products, markets and teams spanning the whole group, close to the leadership decisions that shape where Fever goes next.

It’s a senior individual contributor role.

About the role

• Define the product vision and strategy for the Fever group platform: decide which capabilities (payments, invoicing, seating maps, access control, box office, point of sale and more) should become shared group services, and work with engineering to productize them so any group company can integrate.

• Own the integration playbook: the standard, prioritized path every acquired company follows to run on Fever’s shared services.

• Assess each acquisition feature by feature, produce a keep / kill / merge plan, and shape integration decisions with engineering leads on APIs, data models and migration.

• Run partner and customer migrations end to end, coordinating BD, account management, operations and support.

• Be the bridge between acquired teams and Fever’s product and engineering org in the first 6–12 months, and report integration progress to leadership.

About you

Basic skills and qualifications

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or similar, 5+ years in product management (ideally platform or technical products), and professional English.

• Deep technical fluency: comfortable with architecture, APIs and data models, and with trade-offs like consolidation, migration and build vs. reuse.

• Proven experience building a shared-services strategy and leading post-M&A or platform integration, including keep / kill / merge calls.

• Strong program management in ambiguous, cross-team settings with legacy systems.

• Clear communicator and analytical thinker, with high ownership and urgency.

Preferred skills and qualifications

•

• PM experience in a company that grew through acquisitions, ideally including M&A due diligence.

• Domain knowledge in ticketing, live entertainment or commerce (payments, access control, box office, seating).

• Prior hands-on experience as a backend or platform engineer.

• Track record of earning trust with acquired teams and managing change.

• Experience defining integration metrics and mentoring other PMs.

Benefits & Perks

• Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.

• Stock options.

• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader

• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences

• Home office friendly

• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.description:
As Product Director for the Use Case Tribe, you will lead with a clear and ambitious vision for the product organization that turns EcoVadis's strengths into new, market-leading products. The tribe owns our strategic use cases: regulatory due diligence, human rights due diligence, decarbonization, supply chain resilience and sustainable procurement. You will lead and empower a team of Product Managers and Experts, own the tribe's contribution to ARR, and be accountable for launching innovative products that customers buy, adopt and renew.
This is a dual leadership and execution role, not a management-only role. You will set the direction and build the team, and stay hands-on where it matters. We're looking for a high-agency leader who builds before they debate, uses AI to move at a different speed, and takes full ownership of outcomes while creating the space for their people to do the same.
The Use Case Tribe is also expected to be a model for the wider Product organization in how we choose what to build, communicate and work.
Our leadership philosophy
Our leaders are here to guide with a clear and ambitious vision while empowering teams through coaching. You'll play a key role in creating a culture where people are trusted to take accountability, own their growth, and drive impact, all while adapting your approach to meet the moment.
What you'll be doing

• Decide what is worth building and where to invest: Identify the right customer problems and market opportunities, challenge existing assumptions, and turn them into compelling product propositions.

• Allocate focus and investment: Prioritize across use cases, deciding where to invest, where to wait and where to stop, and make trade-offs on scope, sequencing and resourcing with engineering, design and commercial leaders.

• Set and champion the vision and roadmap: Define the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for our strategic use cases, and the path from parity to market leadership. Align stakeholders around it, communicating with clarity to all audiences.

• Own the commercial outcome: Be accountable for the tribe's ARR contribution together with frontline leaders. Set targets with the leadership team and track performance through leading and lagging indicators.

• Roll up your sleeves: Step in where the work needs you. That may mean unblocking a squad, sharpening a requirement, building a prototype, rewriting a business case, joining a critical customer or partner conversation, or taking on a use case directly when needed.

• Influence architecture across tribes: Work closely with engineering and product leaders in other tribes on shared platforms, data and integration choices. Make the case for the architectural direction our use cases need, and resolve cross-tribe dependencies.

• Drive launches and go-to-market: Partner with sales, marketing, customer success and partnerships to define positioning, pricing and packaging, enablement and launch plans, and to convert products into pipeline and revenue.

• Stay close to customers and the market: Spend real time with buyers, program owners and co-development accounts. Understand how competitors, regulators and partners are shaping the market, and bring that insight into decisions.

• Lead and grow the team: Hire, onboard and develop Product Managers and Experts through coaching and constructive feedback, so they own outcomes end to end.

• Raise AI and product maturity across EcoVadis: Pioneer new AI-first ways of working in the tribe and share them with other Product teams. Contribute to shared standards, practices and coaching that lift the overall capability of Product Management.

Who you are

• A builder and a leader: you are equally comfortable setting strategy and building a rough prototype that teaches the team something.

• Commercially minded: you connect product decisions to revenue, adoption and retention.

• Strong product sense: you have the judgment to know what's worth building and why.

• An AI-native operator: AI is part of how you work, and you're raising the AI fluency of the people around you.

• Customer-obsessed: you get your conviction from talking to real customers and industry stakeholders, testing assumptions and keeping an open mind.

• A multiplier: you make other people better, hire well and develop talent.

• Biased to speed: you move decisively with incomplete information, know which decisions are reversible, remain open to new information and update fast when you're wrong.

• A strong influencer without needing full control: you see building relationships across tribes as part of the craft.

• An exceptional communicator: you simplify complexity, tell a compelling story, and earn trust with people at all levels, including executives.

AI fluency we hire for
We expect you to operate at the AI-Fluent to AI-Native end of the spectrum. You don't just use AI for one-off tasks. You rebuild core product workflows around it: agents configured with product context, personas and prior research; machine-testable acceptance criteria; reusable workflows shared with the team. As a leader, you will help shift the team from feature author to outcome orchestrator, concentrating on strategic trade-offs and novel bets while agents carry more of the discovery and synthesis.

• Typically 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading Product Managers, with a track record of owning a significant B2B enterprise SaaS portfolio and its commercial results (ARR, revenue growth, adoption or retention).

• Experience launching new products from zero to one and scaling them, with real business and customer outcomes to point to.

• A proven ability to set a product strategy and roadmap, and to bring executives, engineers, sales and customers along with it.

• Strong technical fluency: you can discuss architecture, data and integration trade-offs credibly with engineering leaders, and prototype with AI tooling, LLM APIs and a scripting language (Python / JavaScript or equivalent) where it helps.

• Experience influencing across teams without direct authority, including shared platforms and data.

• Experience working with commercial teams on pricing, packaging and go-to-market.

• Comfort operating in a regulated, data-rich, sustainability or risk domain, or the curiosity and speed to get there fast.

• Fluent English (our primary working language).

In return for your expertise, we offer:

• Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment

• Flexible working hours

• Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing

• Access to professional mental health support

• Referral bonus policy

• Learning and development

• Sustainability events and community involvement

• Peer recognition program

• Employee-led resource groups

• Hybrid work organization (2 office days per week)

• Remote work from abroad policy

• Meals and Transportation Vouchers (Coverflex card)

• Dental Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance + Private He

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Spain.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

• Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap

• Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points

• Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities

• Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.

• Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Spain.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

Bonus Points

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Manager for one of our Strategic Use Cases, you will own that use case end-to-end — from the customer problem and the data it depends on, through prototype, roadmap and launch, to the outcome in the market. You will work alongside senior engineers and product experts to define the ambition, understand requirements and launch innovative new products.
This is a builder role, not a coordination role. We're looking for a high-agency generalist who prototypes before they debate, uses AI to move at a different speed, engages customers directly, and takes full ownership of outcomes — not output.
What you'll be doing

• Own the vision: Set and drive the aligned, end-to-end vision for your use case (regulatory due diligence, human rights due diligence, decarbonization or resilience)— what the customer experience should be, where the gaps are, and the sequence from parity to leadership.

• Understand the market: Understand the technical requirements of your use case, and how other competitors and customers are currently solving it. Take inspiration from everywhere, including partner discussions, conferences, webinars and other resources.

• Engage customers directly: Spend real time with buyers, program owners and co-development accounts. Validate problems and solutions first-hand; and build interest from customers and prospects.

• Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools to build working demos, spin up lightweight services and test your own assumptions before committing engineering. Show the team what's possible by doing it, not describing it.

• Drive the build forward: Work alongside engineering to unblock and drive the build forward, working across multiple areas of the product and platform, collaborating with other tribes and squads whilst executing independently or in partnership.

• Partner on go-to-market: Work hand-in-hand with the Strategic Use Case Leads and commercial teams to land what you build.

• Own the outcome: Define the measures of success, hold yourself and the circle to them, and lead clean persist / pivot / stop decisions.

Who you are

• A generalist builder at heart — you move fluidly between strategy, data, prototype and GTM, and you'd rather build a rough thing that teaches you something than debate a perfect thing that doesn't.

• An AI-native operator — AI is woven through how you work: discovery, analysis, prototyping, instrumentation and communication.

• Customer-obsessed — you get your conviction from talking to real customers, not from the building.

• Biased to speed — you move decisively with incomplete information, tell reversible decisions from irreversible ones, and update fast when you're wrong. Strong opinions, loosely held.

• Comfortable without full control — part of your use case's scope and experience will always be owned by other squads. You see managing that, as the craft.

• Mission-driven — you want your work to help guide all companies toward a sustainable world, and to help EcoVadis lead the market in getting there.

AI fluency we hire for
We expect you to operate at the AI-Fluent to AI-Native end of the spectrum: you don't just use AI for one-off tasks, you reconstruct core PM workflows around it — agents configured with your product context, personas and prior research; machine-testable acceptance criteria; reusable workflows you share with the squad. At the top of this ladder, the PM shifts from feature author to outcome orchestrator — concentrating on strategic trade-offs and novel bets while agents carry more of the discovery and synthesis.

• Typically 10+ years experience, including a track record owning a meaningful product area end-to-end in B2B enterprise SaaS, with real business and customer outcomes to point to.

• Enough technical fluency to build — you can prototype with AI tooling, LLM APIs and a scripting language (Python / JavaScript or equivalent) without waiting for engineering to validate every idea.

• An AI-native way of working that's already part of how you operate, not an aspiration.

• Comfort operating in a regulated, data-rich, sustainability or risk domain — or the curiosity and speed to get there fast.

• Sharp problem framing and communication — you walk into the room with a recommendation, not an open question, and you make engineering and design faster by reducing ambiguity.

• Be fluent in English (as our primary working language).

In return for your expertise, we offer:

• Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment

• Flexible working hours

• Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing

• Access to professional mental health support

• Referral bonus policy

• Learning and development

• Sustainability events and community involvement

• Peer recognition program

• Employee-led resource groups

• Hybrid work organization (2 office days per week)

• Remote work from abroad policy

• Meals and Transportation Vouchers (Coverflex card)

• Dental Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance + Private Health Insurance

• Paid employee volunteer day

• Paid moving day (1/year)

• Time off: 1 Community Service Day + 1 Personal Day

• Summer Hours in July and August (36 hours per week)

• Hybrid Monthly Allowance for electricity and Internet

Our hiring team looks forward to reviewing your resume, in English, with a guaranteed response to every application. A new job with purpose awaits you!
Don’t meet all criteria? Please apply anyway. We welcome diverse candidates and want to assess your skills and potential contribution to EcoVadis, regardless of your background.
Can the hiring process be adjusted to suit my needs? Yes. We want all candidates, including people with disabilities, people with long-term health conditions, and neurodiverse applicants, to feel confident demonstrating their potential. If you require adjustments, such as interview questions in advance, please inform the hiring team.
Our team’s strength comes from everyone’s uniqueness and is founded upon mutual respect. EcoVadis commits to equity, inclusion and reducing bias in our hiring processes. EcoVadis does not accept any form of discrimination based on characteristics such as color, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, parental status, or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. To reduce bias in hiring, applicants are encouraged to remove personal details such as photos, marital/parental status, religion, gender, postal code, university name/graduation date, past leave details, and nationality (instead, confirm eligibility to work in the job location).
Our recruitment processes do not include AI systems that make autonomous decisions impacting individuals’ rights without human oversight. Inputs and outputs of the system have been validated by humans and answers are based on algorithms that analyze previous data with which the system has been trained. We use SmartRecruit
