jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

In this role, you will

• Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.

• Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.

• Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.

• Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.

• Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.

• Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

What you need to be successful

Background & Experience

• 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.

• High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.

• Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

Technical & Domain Skills

• Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.

• Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.

• Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.

• Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

Traits

• Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.

• Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.

• Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

What’s in it for you

• Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.

• Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.

• A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.

• An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

You will work across the full EOR system, not only individual features, to understand how customer needs, country requirements, policies, data, operational processes, and technology interact. You will start with the customer problem and desired business outcome, use direct discovery and first-principles reasoning to identify root causes, and decide whether the best intervention belongs in product, process, policy, Operations, or a combination.



You’ll operate independently, making and communicating difficult trade-offs amid ambiguity. You will constructively challenge requested solutions, align senior stakeholders, and connect product decisions to measurable customer, operational, and commercial impact. You will also identify where AI and automation create real value, and where risk or customer needs call for a human in the loop.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the product vision, strategy, prioritization, and measurable outcomes for an EOR sub-domain.

 - Build a systems-level view of customer journeys, internal workflows, policy constraints, data flows, and exceptions across the EOR lifecycle.

 - Lead direct customer and operational discovery. Separate symptoms and feature requests from underlying problems, and evaluate product, process, policy, and operational interventions before choosing a solution.

 - Translate strategy into outcome-based roadmaps with clear decisions, learning plans, and success measures.

 - Work deeply with Operations and AI Engineers to improve scalability, exception handling, service quality, and cost-to-serve, not simply digitize existing processes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, using prototypes and technical insight to reduce risk early.

 - Constructively challenge and align senior stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market, and communicate strategy, trade-offs, and impact clearly in senior forums.

 - Contribute repeatable product practices that strengthen discovery, decision quality, and outcome ownership across the Product organization.




CORE REQUIREMENTS

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Monetization
jobs.description:
OUR VISION

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.



ABOUT US

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 850+ happy Pennylaners: we're now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 700,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!



WHY THIS POSITION IS OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE TO REACH OUR MISSION

At Pennylane, the product is at the heart of how we grow: it is where our customers discover value, adopt it, and decide to go further with us.

Every month, thousands of SMEs join Pennylane, on their own or through their accountant, and the e-invoicing reform is accelerating this momentum. Our ambition is that each of them quickly finds the value that fits their business, and grows with Pennylane as their needs evolve.

Helping SMEs discover, adopt and upgrade to the right plan is one of the biggest levers for Pennylane's growth in the coming years. As a product-led company, this happens in the product, at the right moment, for the right company. That is the job.

You'll shape this scope from the ground up, with a highly strategic role at the heart of our SME growth and a great opportunity to put your skills and ideas to good use.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - The free-to-paid journey for SMEs: how they discover paid value, when and where an upgrade is proposed, and how they buy (plan upgrade, additional seats, add-ons, opening a Pro Account).

 - The shared upgrade surfaces: paywalls, upsell moments and upgrade guidelines, for a consistent upgrade experience across the product.

 - A clear monetisation outcome: product-driven upgrades and MRR, with a baseline, targets and decision rules you define and steer.

We believe monetisation should come from delivering more value, not from restricting it.



HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE COMPANY AS A PM

As a Product Manager, you'll be part of a 100+ people Product organisation, supported by an engineering team of more than 300 people.

 - You'll spend an extensive amount of time understanding why SMEs pay, or don't. You will interview them, conduct user research and dig into our data yourself (SQL, Amplitude, Metabase) to understand where value is felt and where the upgrade journey breaks.

 - You'll run monetisation as an experiment-led practice: one cohort, one hypothesis, a metric and a stop criterion defined upfront. Weekly hypothesis testing rather than long shaping cycles. You scale, change or stop, and a negative result is still a result.

 - With those insights and the company's objectives in mind, you'll be empowered to define your OKRs and your roadmap.

 - You'll work hand in hand with a Product Designer and Product-centered engineers. You will start with small steps (we like the MVP approach!) and will follow-up on the implementation and future iterations. For us, achieving a common goal matters more than just building features.

 - You'll work closely with the PMs who own each product scope (invoicing, expenses, banking, etc.). They own their jobs to be done; you bring the monetisation lens and the shared upgrade surfaces, and help them place the right paid moment in their flows. Much of your impact comes from influence without authority.

 - You'll measure the impact of what we ship and to align on what we push, to whom, and when.
   


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM YOUR LIFE AT PENNYLANE



WITHIN ONE MONTH

 - You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week

 - You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers)

 - You'll understand our current funnel: where SMEs come from, which plans they are on, and what already converts today

 - You'll get a very deep knowledge of our Product organization, methods, and culture


WITHIN 3 MONTHS

 - You'll have built a clear view of the monetisation funnel on at least one priority segment

 - You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on upgrade moments, hand-in-hand with Product Designers and Engineers

 - You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR

 - You will have set up your continuous discovery routine and will be ready to build your roadmap


WITHIN 6 MONTHS

 - You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap

 - You'll have built a shared approach to upgrade surfaces, used by several squads

 - You'll keep having a strong impact via iterations on the solutions you've shipped

 - You'll share your learnings and playbooks so that other squads can run monetisation experiments on their own


AND BEYOND

The product team will double in size in two years. Which means you'll have:

 - Multiple opportunities to recruit and mentor new PMs

 - Increased responsibilities in project leadership, and in shaping how monetisation is organised as the team grows

 - Responsibilities to think of and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even smoother
   


WHAT DO WE DO TO MAKE YOUR WORK LIFE EASIER

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You'll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you'll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You'll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french

💻 You'll get the latest Apple equipment

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager AI -  — Studio Builder
jobs.description:
OUR VISION

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System for French SMEs and Accounting Firms — and soon, European ones.

We help entrepreneurs get rid of time-consuming accounting and financial tasks while giving them access to the information they need to make better decisions for their business.


ABOUT US

Pennylane is one of the fastest-growing Fintechs in France — and soon in Europe.

In five years, we have:

 - 💻 Built a groundbreaking accounting and financial platform for SMEs and accounting firms

 - 💰 Raised €225 million from leading investors, including Sequoia

 - 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grown from 7 co-founders to more than 850 Pennylaners

 - 🌍 Built an international and remote-friendly environment with more than 25 nationalities

 - 🤝 Earned the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms

 - 🚀 Reached more than 700,000 SMEs and 4,500 accounting firms in France


WHY THIS POSITION IS CRITICAL TO OUR MISSION

At Pennylane, Product is at the heart of how we create value for our customers.

We are now making a major bet on AI: not only to automate existing workflows, but also to fundamentally change how people interact with their financial software and extend what the product can do.

Our AI ecosystem is being built across several complementary layers:

 - A shared AI platform, or “harness”, that provides the foundations required to run reliable agents: context, memory, tools, skills, loops, guardrails and observability

 - Studio Coworker, a conversational product experience that helps users analyse information and take action inside Pennylane

 - Autopilot, which automates accounting and financial workflows to reduce manual data entry

 - Studio Builder, the product you will own, enabling users to build and deploy personalised apps, automations and agents on top of Pennylane

Studio Builder is our most ambitious AI product initiative.

The idea is simple but powerful: give customers the ability to extend Pennylane according to their own needs, without requiring them to build everything from scratch. Users should be able to describe what they want to achieve and rely on AI to create, configure and deploy the right experience directly within Pennylane.

This could unlock a new way to use financial software: more personalised, more extensible and increasingly capable of adapting to every company’s specific workflows.

As Senior Product Manager, AI, you will shape this product from the ground up. You will define the vision, understand where AI can create genuine customer value and turn a highly complex technical ambition into a simple, useful and scalable product experience.

You will join one of the key teams shaping the future of Pennylane.

You can also read more about Pennylane’s position at the intersection of AI, accounting and financial software in The New York Times https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/23/business/dealbook/pennylane-ai-accounting-france.html.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN


THE VISION AND STRATEGY FOR STUDIO BUILDER

You will define how Studio Builder should help customers create, personalise and extend Pennylane.

You will identify the most valuable use cases, understand where customers struggle today and establish a clear product strategy that balances ambition, usability and technical feasibility.


THE END-TO-END BUILDING EXPERIENCE

You will own the experience through which customers:

 - Define what they want to build

 - Configure the relevant data, context, tools and actions

 - Test and iterate on their app, automation or agent

 - Deploy it within Pennylane

 - Monitor its usage and improve it over time


THE FOUNDATIONS OF AN EXTENSIBLE AI PRODUCT

You will work closely with the AI platform team to ensure that Studio Builder makes the underlying capabilities of Pennylane accessible and useful to customers.

This includes thinking deeply about how users interact with:

 - Context and memory

 - Tools and skills

 - Agent loops and workflows

 - Guardrails and permissions

 - Reliability and observability

 - Deployment and iteration


A CLEAR PRODUCT OUTCOME

You will define the metrics that matter and establish how we measure success.

Depending on the stage of the product, this may include:

 - Activation and adoption of Studio Builder

 - Number and quality of apps, automations or agents created

 - Successful deployment and repeated usage

 - Customer value generated through personalised workflows

 - Reliability, trust and user satisfaction

 - Expansion of Pennylane’s product capabilities through customer-built experiences


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AS A PRODUCT MANAGER

You will work in a highly collaborative environment with Engineering, Product Design, AI specialists and other Product Managers.

You will:

 - Lead continuous discovery with SMEs, accountants and internal users

 - Turn complex customer problems into clear product opportunities

 - Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and OKRs

 - Explore and validate new ideas through prototypes, experiments and MVPs

 - Work closely with engineers and designers from problem discovery through implementation and iteration

 - Make AI concepts understandable and valuable for non-technical users

 - Build strong product narratives and communicate them clearly to customers, stakeholders and leadership

 - Balance long-term product ambition with pragmatic, incremental delivery

 - Collaborate with the teams building the shared AI platform, Studio Coworker and Autopilot

 - Develop strong product principles for building AI-powered experiences at Pennylane

 - Measure the impact of what you ship and use those learnings to guide future decisions

 - Influence without authority across a complex, fast-growing organisation

This is a hands-on product role. You will not only define what should be built — you will actively explore, prototype, test and help make the product tangible.

You will also have the opportunity to shape how Product at Pennylane approaches AI: how we build AI products, how we explain their value and how we create experiences that customers can trust.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT DURING YOUR FIRST MONTHS


WITHIN ONE MONTH

 - You will learn about Pennylane, our customers, our product and our vision during onboarding

 - You will build a strong understanding of the accounting and financial workflows we support

 - You will familiarise yourself with our AI ecosystem, including the shared AI platform, Studio Coworker, Autopilot and Studio Builder

 - You will meet key stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design and AI

 - You will speak with customers and internal users to understand the problems Studio Builder should solve

 - You will develop an initial view of the product opportunity and its main risks


WITHIN THREE MONTHS

 - You will have defined a clear view of the most important customer problems and use cases

 - You will have contributed to or shaped the Studio Builder product strategy

 - You will have identified the first key opportunities

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

• Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.

• Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:

• Predictable performance, even at scale

• Secure, compliant environments by default

• Real-time observability and profiling built in

• Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

• Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint.

Strategic judgment: Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.

•
Cross-functional execution: A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.

•
Data-driven approach: Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.

•
Developer and AI fluency: Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.

Bonus points

Dual-funnel experience: Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).

•
Global scale: Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Growth Strategy & Operations (PLG & Pricing)
jobs.description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.


MEET THE TEAM!

Organic Growth builds sustainable, compounding growth engines for Preply. Within the team, Product Led Growth and Pricing & Discounting are two strategic areas with the potential to unlock non-linear growth, improve learner lifetime value and strengthen the economics of our marketplace.

Product Led Growth already has a dedicated cross-functional product team, including Product, Design, Analytics and Engineering. Pricing and Discounting is the next area of strategic development, with further product investment planned as part of Preply's growth agenda.

You will report to the Senior Director of Organic Growth and take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs across both areas. In your first year, your priorities will be to accelerate the performance and strategic development of Product Led Growth, while defining Preply's Pricing and Discounting strategy, principles and investment priorities.

You will initially manage one analyst responsible for day-to-day Product Led Growth analytics, with the potential to grow the team as the scope develops. This high-visibility role offers the opportunity to scale an established growth engine while building Preply's approach to Pricing and Discounting from the ground up. It is a full-time role based in Barcelona, combining regular collaboration in our office with the flexibility to work remotely.



What you’ll be doing:

 - Own the business and product strategy for Product Led Growth and Pricing and Discounting, turning Preply's company priorities into clear choices, roadmaps and measurable commercial outcomes.

 - Take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs, including Product Led Growth NSGMV and share of NSGMV, incremental total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency.

 - Accelerate Product Led Growth by identifying and prioritising opportunities across referrals, advocacy, sharing, incentives and other product-led acquisition and retention mechanics.

 - Build Preply's Pricing and Discounting strategy across the marketplace, including our approach to tutor pricing, learner-facing prices, promotions, discounts, credits and incentives.

 - Develop business cases, proofs of concept and MVPs that allow Preply to validate opportunities before making deeper product or organisational investments.

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Finance and other Growth leaders to shape roadmaps, design experiments and balance learner value, tutor outcomes, growth, margin and marketplace health.

 - Own the performance and decision-making framework for the portfolio, ensuring teams have clear KPIs, reliable measurement and a regular cadence for reviewing progress and reallocating investment.

 - Use quantitative and qualitative insight to identify strategic and tactical growth opportunities, challenge assumptions and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.

 - Build alignment across senior stakeholders and communicate strategy, trade-offs, progress and recommendations with clarity and conviction.

 - Lead and develop the Product Led Growth analyst, setting a high bar for analytical quality, commercial impact and effective partnership with cross-functional teams.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

 - A clear, prioritised Product Led Growth plan that delivers measurable progress against NSGMV, share of NSGMV and efficiency targets.

 - An aligned Pricing & Discounting strategy with defined principles, priority opportunities and a sequenced roadmap covering both tutor and learner dynamics.

 - High-potential Pricing & Discounting opportunities validated through robust business cases, proofs of concept or MVPs, creating confidence in where Preply should invest next.

 - Demonstrable progress towards improving total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency through better pricing, discount and incentive decisions.

 - Strong confidence and alignment across Growth, Product, Finance, Data and senior leadership, supported by concise communication and transparent trade-offs.

 - A high-performing analyst with clear ownership, strong development and increasing impact on business and product decisions.




WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

 - 8 or more years of relevant experience in growth strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, monetisation, business operations or a related role within a product-led technology business.

 - Evidence of owning meaningful commercial KPIs for a growth area, business unit, channel or product, and of translating strategy into measurable business impact.

 - Strong commercial judgement and a solid understanding of lifetime value, margin, unit economics and the trade-offs involved in growing a two-sided marketplace.

 - Excellent strategic and critical thinking, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, make clear choices and move effectively from analysis to execution.

 - Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Data and Finance teams to shape roadmaps, design experiments and deliver complex cross-functional initiatives.

 - Strong analytical fluency and the ability to interrogate complex data, evaluate experiments and distinguish meaningful signals from noise. Hands-on SQL experience is helpful but not required.

 - Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to build alignment and communicate concise recommendations to senior leaders.

 - Experience leading, coaching or developing analytical talent, with the ability to create clarity and raise the quality of a team's work.

 - Practical fluency with AI tools, with evidence of using them to improve analysis, research, decision-making or operational workflows.


EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE VALUABLE:

 - Direct experience in pricing, monetisation, promotions, discounts, incentives or marketplace economics.

 - Experience in a consumer marketplace, subscription business, travel, e-commerce or another scaled digital product with complex pricing and lifetime value dynamics.

 - A background that combines structured strategy or consulting experience with hands-on operating ownership.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

As a product team, our goal is to improve the life of our students and our tutors, drive amazing learning outcomes for our learners and enable our tutors to financially thrive through the platform. And we want to do this all while generating business value for Preply so we can help even more people! We strongly believe that we can't achieve business success without our students' and tutors' success.

Preply is a product led company. As part of the product team, you will have a direct impact on the company's growth and strategy with high visibility to our C-suite and leadership team. You will be empowered to operate independently with a dedicated cross functional team to build amazing products and take them from inception to launch to scale!

With great power comes great responsibility. Our product managers have true end-to-end accountability for their area with varied areas of responsibility such as: setting the long term vision and strategy for the squad, conceptualizing the product(s), driving the daily execution with the team, launching and analyzing the impact of your product on our customers.

What you'll be doing:

Preply is one of the largest advertisers in the Education Tech space. Our marketing operations span dozens of languages, thousands of creatives, and multiple acquisition channels. To keep growing at this scale, we need world-class products that take marketing channels to levels of performance impossible to reach manually.

As the Senior Product Manager for MarTech Scale, you'll own the products that scale Preply's marketing channels far beyond what manual effort allows - across Paid Search, SEO, AI Search, Display (Meta, TikTok, etc.), Affiliates, and the next wave of channels yet to emerge.

You'll partner with engineering, data, and marketing teams to build products that efficiently drive new subscribers to Preply at unprecedented scale.

Core Responsibilities:

 - Scale paid acquisition channels through Product
   
   - Own the SEM platform that posts and optimises millions of keywords - from discovery, through bidding, account structure, and ad copy generation. Push the team toward an always-on, data-driven automated scale of operations.
   
   - Build creative automation for Display channels - generating, tracking, testing and iterating on creatives, across dozens of languages and regions.
   
   - Build channel-management products for Display and Affiliates - automating bidding, account structure, partner onboarding, and reporting so the team can run dozens of campaigns and partners as one.
   
   - Partner with channel owners to identify the next leverage point - a new bidding model, account architecture, or feed strategy - and turn it into a Product.
   
   - Identify and build new acquisition channels (e.g., OpenAI Apps) before competitors do.

 - Power organic and AI Search
   
   - Lead the product behind a step-change in SEO, with a system that takes keyword opportunities and produces high-quality pages
   
   - Shape Preply's positioning in AI Search as discovery shifts from blue links to LLM answers - defining the content, structure, and signals that win on this new surface.
   
   - Continuously evolve the page-creation engine to stay ahead of evolving search behaviour, ranking systems, and AI search tools.

 - Make landing pages a conversion advantage
   
   - Own the Preply homepage, and the platform that powers bespoke landing pages across marketing channels. Deeply understand users’ intents from different marketing channels and match that to their landing experience.
   
   - Partner with the broader Growth Tribe to optimize the top of the funnel end-to-end - carrying marketing intent across the full conversion journey, not just the landing page.
   
   - Run a fast cycle of hypothesis, experiment, learning across geographies, audiences, and channels.

 - Make Preply Marketing AI-native
   
   - Make AI a first-class building block in the platforms you ship. From keyword and ad copy generation, to page creation, to creative automation - AI is the engine that makes scale possible. Architect for it from day one rather than retrofitting it later.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Billing (VAT)
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem https://www.perk.com/shadow-work-report.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com http://www.perk.com to learn more.






ABOUT THE ROLE

At Perk, we believe in empowering cross-functional teams that drive exceptional results for our customers and the company. We’re transforming how work gets done by eliminating tedious manual processes in travel, spend, and events.



As a Product Manager at Perk, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation by identifying opportunities, shaping product strategy, and leading execution. You’ll work closely with customers, stakeholders, and lean product development teams to build best in class solutions for our users. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the team and own the Billing product area.


Billing isn't just a back-office function for us; it's a strategic product area that directly impacts our ability to win in new markets and scale globally. Our billing platform enables finance teams to accurately analyse and forecast travel spend, the automation to streamline their accounting, and the accuracy to trust their financials. Thanks to our AI-powered invoice collection service and partner integrations, we help customers save thousands in VAT reclaims. We are on a mission to make complex financial operations feel effortless.



As the Staff Product Manager for Billing, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for a product that is the financial engine of our business. You will transform complex challenges—from international tax compliance to AI-powered invoice data extraction—into a seamless, scalable, and intelligent billing platform. This is a mission-critical role where you will directly shape our commercial strategy, enhance customer trust, and build a key pillar of our competitive advantage.



What You’ll Do

 - Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Spend ecosystem

 - Drive high-velocity execution with a world class team of making bold, fast bets informed customer feedback, data, market research, and deep intuition for how AI can reshape how teams operate

 - Use customer insights with technical possibilities, crafting intuitive user experiences that simplify the user experience

 - Help millions of employees and thousands of finance teams seamlessly manage expenses, cards, and invoice processing.

 - Prototype rapidly using tools like Claude and Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products.

 - Stay deeply plugged into AI research, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it creatively to Perk products

 - Empower Your Team: Lead with a servant-leadership approach help stay focused, remove distractions, and foster creativity and collaboration

What You’ll Need

 - Experience That Counts: Significant experience in a tech company, with proven capability as a Product Manager. Experience working on a Tax product is a strong plus. Bonus if you have experience in development, design, or business roles (though not a must).

 - Finance and accounting: You have a working knowledge of accounting reconciliation and finance operations.

 - Strong customer empathy and design thinking, with a passion to understand the entire expense lifecycle — from the moment of spend inception through automated reconciliation to final posting in the ERP system — and the specific friction points unique to complex accounting workflows

 - Fluency in data and how to make data-driven product decisions

 - Experience evaluating product decisions and prioritization trade-offs

 - Demonstrated ability to lead and influence small teams of engineers & designers toward a common goal

 - Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders and large cross-functional teams

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.

 - Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Bolt, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

What we offer

 - Competitive compensation including equity in the company

 - Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge

 - Health perks such as private healthcare or gym allowance depending on your location

 - "Flexible compensation plan" to help you diversify and increase the net salary

 - Unforgettable Perk events including travel to one of our hubs

 - Mental health support tool for your wellbeing

 - Exponential growth opportunities

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.



How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

 - Growth Mindset: You actively apply feedback from coaching sessions, continuously refining your messaging and cold-calling techniques.

Target Start Date: Tuesday 1st December 2026

 - Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

 - Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

 - Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

 - Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

 - Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

 - Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

 - Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

 - Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

 - Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

 - Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons

 - Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

 - Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 - First 6 Months (Onboarding & Probation): 5 days a week in our Barcelona office. This gives you hands-on coaching, real-time feedback on live calls, and direct access to your manager while you master the role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, CRM - MONOPOLY GO!
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager, CRM to join our MONOPOLY GO! game team in our Barcelona studio on a hybrid basis (3X in office), or remotely within the UK.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

What You’ll Do

We’re looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Product Manager to shape how Monopoly GO! connects with players throughout their journey, solving complex product challenges and creating communication experiences that are more relevant, timely, and valuable.

As Senior Product Manager for CRM, you’ll own the vision and roadmap for the capabilities, tools, and experiences that power communication throughout the player journey. You’ll identify player and business needs, translate them into product opportunities, and lead cross-functional teams to discover, build, and continuously improve scalable CRM solutions for a leading live-service mobile game.

Product Strategy

•

• Own and lead the CRM product roadmap and strategy across player-facing experiences and internal tooling, translating player, business, behavioural, and market insights into strategic priorities

• Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, reactivation, and player value, while shaping the future of CRM across push, email, in-game messaging, Live Activities, and emerging channels

• Champion relevant, contextual, personalised, and player-first communication experiences while serving as a senior product voice and CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation

Roadmap, Discovery and Innovation

•

• Lead discovery and ideation to identify player needs, team pain points, and opportunities to evolve CRM, while leading a cross-functional product area with dedicated software engineering resources

• Provide clear product direction, priorities, requirements, and success criteria to guide execution, and own delivery outcomes from discovery and prioritisation through development, launch, measurement, and iteration

• Evolve CRM capabilities including personalisation, automation, segmentation, decisioning, orchestration, and dynamic content

Performance and Continuous Improvement

•

• Partner with the analytics team to monitor and report on program effectiveness, using data-driven insights to recommend continuous improvement and keep players at the heart of every decision

• Lead structured testing strategies across A/B testing, cadence, segmentation, and channel mix, while championing a strong test-and-learn culture

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience in Product Management or a related product discipline

• Product experience in gaming is strongly preferred; experience in entertainment or mobile apps is also relevant

• Strong understanding of player lifecycle and contact strategy

• Analytical mindset and confidence using data to identify opportunities and guide decisions

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and comfort working in a fast-paced environment

• A player-first mindset and a drive to keep improving product and communication strategies

Bonus Points

• Hands-on experience with Braze or a similar marketing automation platform

• Experience with tools such as Looker

• Experience with live-service, casual, or social games

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Provider Experience
jobs.description:
Who we are: 
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.
We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.
Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


About the role
Rover is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the Provider Product Group inside our Global Provider Organization. In this role, you will own the product strategy and execution of Rover's multi-year provider roadmap: concentrating investment on our most successful providers while engaging our broader community of caregivers to strengthen marketplace depth and develop a high quality pipeline. 
You will lead four product teams working in service to our care providers, improving their experience and how they interact with the marketplace at every stage of their journey. This is a high-impact role that requires a unique blend of strategic vision and detailed-oriented, hands-on execution. You will set multi-year product direction and drive rigorous, experiment-led execution. The role carries direct accountability for supply-side revenue, provider retention, and new-customer booking growth.
This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Supply based in Barcelona, and partners closely with Data Science, Engineering, Design, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and the International Business Team.
As a people leader, you will manage a team of product managers based primarily in Barcelona and coordinate with cross-functional teams across Europe and the US.

* This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.


What you'll own
Execution is delivered hand-in-hand with cross-functional partners; your job is to define the vision and what good looks like, sequence the bets, hold the alignment, and make sure all investments reinforce each other through excellent execution.

• Product Strategy and Vision. Own the multi-year provider product vision: translating Rover's provider strategy into a sequenced product direction and owning the narrative that aligns leadership, product teams, and partners behind it.

• Roadmap and execution. Own the product side of the organization's OKRs and the roadmap that delivers them. Ship a steady cadence of well-crafted, experiment-validated launches, landed with quality and followed through after launch until the customer outcome is proven or the outcome is learned.

• The voice of the provider. You will be the advocate for what providers actually want and need to grow and run top quality businesses, grounding every roadmap decision in customer research, feedback, and marketplace data, and representing that voice credibly in every executive conversation, including when it's inconvenient.

• AI adoption. AI embedded in product features such as assisted tooling, intelligent messaging, personalization and education, as well as fostering AI in how the team works (AI-accelerated discovery, prototyping, execution), while building a culture of AI-native development as the default.

• Cross-functional leadership. Hold alignment across Core Product Teams, Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal and Trust & Safety, and across regions, so that product investments reinforce each other globally rather than fragmenting by service, brand or country.

• A team that sets the bar. Hire, coach and grow a team of product managers who combine judgment, customer centricity, inspiring craft and speed.

Minimum qualifications
• 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in marketplace, platform, or two-sided business contexts. Experience in the supply-side of the marketplace is a plus.

• 5+ years in people management or leadership roles, including managing senior product managers or leading cross-functional groups.

• Experience driving marketplace monetization — pricing, fee, or take-rate models — including designing, testing, and scaling pricing changes with measurable P&L impact.

• Track record of building retention, engagement, and loyalty strategies for a professional user segment (providers, sellers, hosts, drivers, or merchants).
Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering teams to create and execute on shared roadmaps and metrics, with rigorous experimentation practice (A/B frameworks, holdouts, long-horizon measurement).

• Clear and structured written and verbal communication style, with the ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and diverse teams to drive critical decisions.

• Highly proactive, comfortable operating with minimal guidance in uncertain and ambiguous business environments.

• Analytical rigour, with enthusiasm for modeling and measuring the impact of the initiatives you drive. Comfortable working with advanced analytical and visualization tools, such as Mode and Excel.

• Strong leadership skills and experience giving actionable feedback and coaching, and welcoming the same.

• Comfortable working across Europe (Central Time) and US (Pacific Time) timezones.

• Strong command of the English language (minimum C2 level). English is the official Rover language and is used every day with every stakeholder and communication.
Bachelor's degree.

Preferred qualifications
• Experience in online marketplaces with a meaningful supply side (gig economy, services marketplaces, accommodation, mobility, creator platforms, or similar).

• Experience with marketplace integrity problems: disintermediation and off-platform leakage, and incentive design that rewards loyal behavior.

• Experience building customer-centric tooling, business-management software, or 'operating system' products for independent entrepreneurs.

• Demonstrated success leading both 0-to-1 product bets and scaling existing product lines; comfort presenting to C-level and Board audiences.

• Master's degree.

Benefits of working at Rover:
• Competitive compensation

• Permanent contract

• Long-term incentive plan, with a company performance-based cash payout

• Pension Plan

• Meal tickets through Cobee

• 25 days paid time off, plus public holidays

You will be joining the Bookings group, focused on making it as easy as possible for pet parents to connect with a sitter and book care for their pet, and with a particular focus on growing Rover outside of North America.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a senior candidate that is not afraid to rock the boat. This role is about experimenting with dramatic product or business model changes, not minor optimisations.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Skills and experience

• A demonstrated obsession with driving business impact through improved user experience

• Strong analytical skills, particularly proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and common analytics tools (we use Amplitude and Mode). Even better: you are comfortable writing SQL

• You have developed and executed your roadmaps in alignment with the team charter and company goals

• You partner closely with Design and Engineering to deliver exceptional product experiences

• Experience consuming and understanding customer feedback via qualitative and quantitative sources

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX
 
We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.
 
We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.
 
Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.
 
Join OLX and see how far you can go.


About the Role
We are a large-scale consumer marketplace building AI-native product experiences across multiple markets. Trust and Safety is not a defensive function here - it is a strategic growth lever. A platform users trust converts better, retains longer, and earns stronger word of mouth. Fraud, abuse, and bad actors actively destroy the value we create; eliminating them is product work at its core.
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the Trust & Safety product agenda end-to-end. You will define the strategy for how we detect and prevent fraud, protect user integrity, and keep our marketplace safe - while building systems that are intelligent, proportionate, and do not create friction for the millions of legitimate users who rely on us every day. AI is central to how you will do this: not as an add-on, but as the foundation of a new generation of proactive, signal-driven safety infrastructure.
This role can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland.


What you will do:
•
Own the Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap translating business risk and user insight into a clear, prioritised plan.

•
Shift the function from reactive incident response to proactive, intelligence-driven fraud prevention: build the Risk Engine, data signals intelligence, anomaly detection, and investigation tooling that make this possible.

•
Ship AI-native T&S product experiences: partner with Data Science and Engineering to design, prototype, and productionise real-time detection and decisioning systems using ML models, LLMs, and behavioural signals.

•
Balance fraud mitigation with growth protection—ensuring T&S interventions do not unnecessarily create friction for legitimate users or throttle marketplace supply/demand. Make hard, evidence-based trade-off decisions.

•
Define and track the right T&S success metrics: fraud loss rates, false positive/negative rates, time-to-resolution, user trust scores, and financial exposure. Communicate impact in business terms to senior leadership.

•
Partner closely with Engineering leads, Data Science, Legal, Compliance, and Operations—holding shared accountability for outcomes and navigating competing priorities.

•
Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities to measure fraud rates, detection model performance, and contributor/user impact at scale.

•
Establish business cases quantifying fraud losses and ROI of prevention investments; secure resources and drive prioritisation grounded in data.

•
Ensure products and strategies meet local and regional compliance, legal, and security requirements across all markets.

•
Apply AI to how you operate as a PM: faster threat analysis, synthetic user research on abuse patterns, AI-assisted spec writing, automated experimentation pipelines—whatever moves the needle on velocity.

•
Represent Trust & Safety at the leadership level, presenting strategy, risk posture, and results clearly to executive audiences.

What we are looking for:
•
Significant product management experience in the digital sector: consumer facing platform, marketplace, mobility, e-commerce, classifieds, fintech, or similar high scale environment.

•
Proven experience owning trust related products or problem spaces such as Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Risk, Identity & Verification, Marketplace Integrity, Account Security, Abuse Prevention, Payments Risk, or Compliance Technology.

•
Track record of building scalable systems that proactively detect, prevent, and mitigate abuse, fraud, risk, or other trust related issues, rather than relying solely on manual or operational processes.

•
Strong analytical and data driven mindset, with experience defining success metrics, evaluating impact, and making prioritization decisions based on evidence and measurable outcomes.

•
Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex products in regulated or high-risk environments. Experience in vendor management and collaboration.

•
Experience building, deploying, or working closely with machine learning, AI, risk scoring, decisioning, detection, recommendation, or automation systems. Hands-on experience with AI-powered trust or fraud products is a plus.

•
Demonstrated ability to balance user experience, marketplace growth, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation, making thoughtful trade offs that protect both users and the business.

•
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking ownership of complex problem spaces, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving strategy and execution across multiple teams.

•
Strong core product muscle that transfers across fraud domains—you've stepped into unfamiliar threat vectors, oriented fast, and delivered. Domain specificity matters; rigid domain lock-in does not.

•
Well versed in building, iterating core Data (Science) products at scale

Nice to Have:
•
Experience building trust, risk, fraud, or safety products across multiple international markets and regulatory environments.

•
Familiarity with emerging regulations and industry trends affecting online platforms, digital marketplaces, payments, AI, and consumer trust.

If you're excited by the opportunity to solve complex trust challenges at scale and build products that make a meaningful difference to millions of users, we'd love to hear from you. This is a role for someone who enjoys tackling ambiguous problems, partnering across disciplines, and shaping the future of trust in a modern, AI-powered marketplace.

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

This is a builder role focused on creating new value - not a people-management role. It's well-suited for someone who thrives on building new things, moving fast, and navigating a complex organisation to turn ideas into impact.
 
You'll lead 2–3 special initiatives in parallel, each scoped over 6–24 months. These could range from developing AI-driven capabilities and new monetisation models to building new product features that drive growth. We're hiring for mindset, not a fixed checklist.
 
You'll join the product leadership team and contribute to strategic direction across the area. The focus is on building, pushing, and delivering new value, complementing a team that excels at running and optimising the core business. 
 
This role reports to the Director of Product and can be based in Spain, Portugal or Poland. Remote work is possible within these countries.

Lead zero-to-one initiatives from concept to market validation to scaled delivery - own the vision, strategy, and execution.
Build with AI as a daily lever - prototypes, agent-augmented workflows, AI-powered discovery and experimentation.
Run lean experiments to prove product-market fit fast, with minimal bureaucracy.
Present and defend your concepts to senior stakeholders - building alignment through evidence and conviction.
Navigate a matrixed organisation: identify opportunities to move quickly, build coalitions, and drive progress without waiting for perfect alignment.
Own the business case: connect product decisions to revenue and margin impact.
Raise the bar for product craft across the team - set the standard through your work, share methods and examples, and act as a role model for what high-quality product thinking looks like in practice.

8+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of building and launching new products from zero to one - not just optimising what exists.
AI native - you build with AI in your personal and professional life. 
Entrepreneurial DNA - uncomfortable with "business as usual," driven to create new value.
Fast and execution-driven - moves at pace, ships quickly, and creates momentum rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
High product craft - rigorous discovery, lean experimentation, strong narratives, data-driven decision-making.
Strong executive presence - able to defend a concept to senior directors and build alignment.
Business and financial acumen - unit economics, P&L thinking, ROI-informed decisions.
Ability to drive multiple initiatives in parallel with minimal oversight.

jobs.title: Technical Growth Lead
jobs.description:
About Tinybird
At Tinybird, we help developers and data teams take flight by unlocking the power of real-time data to build data products faster. With Tinybird, developers can easily ingest data from multiple sources, query it using the SQL they already know and love, and publish results as low-latency, high-concurrency APIs for their applications — all in minutes, not hours or days.

Our mission is to make real-time data accessible and actionable for every developer. Tinybird is loved by developers and trusted by data engineers at some of the world’s leading companies. We’re growing quickly and expanding our marketing team to amplify our reach and accelerate our demand engine.


About the Role
We're hiring a EU based growth lead to help drive expansion of our product suite. Thousands of developers try our products every quarter. Your job is to create much more of that demand, and to make sure the right people become real conversations with our sales team. This is a builder role, not a channel-management or pure strategy role. You'll work directly with our CEO, engineering, design, content, RevOps and sales.

What you'll do
•
Run the funnel. You own signups, activation, and qualified pipeline from developer-led sources. You'll build one weekly view from signup to activation to opportunity, report it, and act on it.

•
Make sure no hot lead goes cold. You'll define what "high intent" means with RevOps and sales, and build the scoring, routing and alerts so those leads get a human touch within one business day.

•
Ship something public every week. You'll partner with engineers and our content team on demos, examples, teardowns and build-in-public posts that ride what developers are talking about right now. You set the calendar and priorities, and you build and write a meaningful share yourself.

•
Get Tinybird into AI-native workflows. This is a new challenge for us and requires experimentation and the right ability to test and iterate. It means agent skills, MCP servers, plugins for Cursor, Claude and OpenAI, and showing up well in AI assistants' answers. You'll test, measure what drives signups, and double down or drop it quickly.

•
Run focused campaigns, one at a time. Each has a target list, an offer, and a sales follow-up.

•
Improve activation. You'll own the lifecycle emails and in-product nudges in HubSpot, with the goal of getting people to a first query, not just an open.

•
Reallocate fast. You'll shift time and budget toward what produces pipeline, reviewing monthly and adjusting within weeks.

Your first 90 days
•
A single, trusted signup-to-pipeline dashboard, reviewed weekly with sales and the CEO.

•
Routing and first-touch SLAs live, with the first-touch rate measured.

•
A weekly public shipping cadence running, and at least one targeted campaign launched with sales follow-up.

What you bring
•
You've owned a signup-to-pipeline or signup-to-revenue number at a developer-facing product (devtools, data, infrastructure, observability, security or similar), and you can tell us specifically what you changed and what happened.

•
You're technical enough to build. You write SQL, spin up a working demo, read an API reference, and use AI coding tools daily. Engineers take your work seriously because you ship it.

•
You've marketed to technical buyers, from individual developers up to platform and data leads.

•
You move fast and learn in public. Show us something you shipped in the last 90 days: an experiment, a demo, a campaign, a side project.

•
About 5+ years in growth, demand gen or developer marketing, with enough experience to work independently and enough appetite to still do the work yourself.

Nice to have

•
Experience with ClickHouse, Kafka, or analytics and real-time data infrastructure

•
